yasya me tvaṃ hṛṣīkeśa yathepsitam upasthitaḥ
āgatān pṛthivīpālān saṃprekṣyāha yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
kṛṣṇaṃ kamalapatrākṣaṃ sarvataḥ kāryasādhakam
pādāvanejanaṃ deyaṃ rājasūye mahākratau
na tādṛg dṛśyate mahyaṃ na ca bhūpaiḥ samāhṛtam
kṛṣṇa uvāca
kuto labhyaṃ mahābāho etasya ca dhanāgamam
mā viṣīdasva rājendra dhanasyārthe kathaṃ cana
haiḍimbaṃ preṣayiṣyāmi vibhīṣaṇam ariṃdamam
ānetuṃ rakṣasāṃ nāthaṃ dhanaughaparipūrtaye
tata āhūya haiḍimbaṃ bahumānapuraḥsaram
uvāca ślakṣṇayā vācā pūjayann iva mādhavaḥ
gaccha haiḍimba bhadraṃ te laṅkāyāṃ rakṣasāṃ patim
nivedayasva madvācā yad uktaṃ rākṣasaṃ prati
tat smṛtvā tvaṃ samāgaccha prasādaṃ mama ca smara
tato bhīmasutaḥ kṛtvā praṇāmaṃ kṛṣṇapādayoḥ
jagāma tvarito lokān draṣṭuṃ paulastyam añjasā
tataḥ sāgaram āsādya baddhaṃ rāmeṇa pādapam
tatra rāmeśvaraṃ devaṃ saṃpūjya vidhivat tadā
haiḍimbas tvarito lokān praviveśa nṛpājñayā
sa gato vāyuvegena laṅkāṃ dvāram upāsthitaḥ
sa pṛṣṭo dvārapālais tu kas tvaṃ ṣaṇḍākṛtiḥ kutaḥ
dvāḥsthān kāṃś cit samutkṣipya karṇābhyāṃ prāhasat tadā
durdṛśā rākṣasās tatra jāyante kurujāṅgale
bhaimasenis tadovāca dvārasthān krodhasaṃyutaḥ
kṛṣṇājñayāgataṃ māṃ ca nivedayata rākṣasāḥ
vibhīṣaṇāya vai śīghraṃ kāryārthaṃ rākṣasottamāḥ
tad uktam ākarṇya ca te paulastyāya nyavedayan
āhūya tam uvācedaṃ kiṃ kāryaṃ tan niśāmaya
sa sarvaṃ kathayām āsa kṛṣṇaproktaṃ tadāgrataḥ
vibhīṣaṇaś ca dharmātmā kṛṣṇājñāṃ śirasā dadhat
saṃsmṛtya rāmavacanaṃ kṛṣṇājñāṃ pālayat tadā
mandodaryai nivedyātha kṛṣṇarāmaprasādajam
kṛṣṇaṃ draṣṭuṃ gamiṣyāmi ājñāpaya nṛpātmaje
jagatsāraṃ ratnajātaṃ daśagrīvena rakṣitam
ānītaṃ vibudhādīṃś ca jitvā tac ca samṛddhimat
preṣayiṣyāmi tat sarvaṃ kṛṣṇaprītyai nṛpātmaje
paśyatobhayataḥ pādau ratnajaiḥ pūritair dhanaiḥ
indraprasthaṃ gata uta kṛṣṇaś cāsau mahāyaśāḥ
vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca
rākṣasā yādavendraṃ taṃ draṣṭuṃ gacchāma māciram
iti śrutvā vacas tasya vismitā vākyam abravīt
vibhīṣaṇa uvāca
mānuṣebhyaḥ kathaṃ rājan karaṃ datse vadasva me
śubhe kāraṇato dadmi na bibhemi kuto 'smy aham
purā rāmeṇa kathitaṃ mamāgre mayanandini
janma me yādave vaṃśe dvāpare samupasthite
sāhāyyaṃ pāṇḍavasyārthe kariṣyāmi tadā vraja
vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca
indraprasthe mahābāho darśanaṃ te karomy aham
ity uktvā sa yayau tatra yatra kṛṣṇaḥ surārihā
saṃpūjya kṛṣṇaṃ saṃśuddhaṃ paulastyaḥ paramo mahān
saṃpūjya rākṣasaṃ viṣṇur ity uvāca vibhīṣaṇam
vibhīṣaṇa uvāca
svāgataṃ te mahābāho kuśalaṃ te ca sarvadā
tava darśanato viṣṇo aśubhaṃ nāsti me kva cit
adya me svāgataṃ janma jīvitaṃ ca sujīvitam
idaṃ svarṇaṃ mayānītaṃ koṭiśo yadunandana
yajñārthaṃ dharmarājasya tavājñāṃ vacasāṃ dadhṛk
iti śrutvā vacas tasya tataḥ sphuritalocanaḥ
gantum ājñāṃ dadau laṅkāṃ paulastyāya mahātmane
vraja laṅkāṃ mahāvīra tulyaṃ balir ihāsura
iti śrutvā tato laṅkām agamad rāvaṇānujaḥ
pūjyamāno mahāvīrai rākṣaso bharatarṣabha
vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca
anujñātas tu kṛṣṇena pāṇḍavo bhrātṛbhiḥ saha
īhituṃ rājasūyāya sādhanāny upacakrame
tata ājñāpayām āsa pāṇḍavo 'rinibarhaṇaḥ
sahadevaṃ yudhāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ mantriṇaś caiva sarvaśaḥ
asmin kratau yathoktāni yajñāṅgāni dvijātibhiḥ
tathopakaraṇaṃ sarvaṃ maṅgalāni ca sarvaśaḥ
adhiyajñāṃś ca saṃbhārān dhaumyoktān kṣipram eva hi
samānayantu puruṣā yathāyogaṃ yathākramam
indraseno viśokaś ca pūruś cārjunasārathiḥ
annādyāharaṇe yuktāḥ santu matpriyakāmyayā
sarvakāmāś ca kāryantāṃ rasagandhasamanvitāḥ
manoharāḥ prītikarā dvijānāṃ kurusattama
tad vākyasamakālaṃ tu kṛtaṃ sarvam avedayat
sahadevo yudhāṃ śreṣṭho dharmarāje mahātmani
tato dvaipāyano rājann ṛtvijaḥ samupānayat
vedān iva mahābhāgān sākṣān mūrtimato dvijān
svayaṃ brahmatvam akarot tasya satyavatīsutaḥ
dhanaṃjayānām ṛṣabhaḥ susāmā sāmago 'bhavat
yājñavalkyo babhūvātha brahmiṣṭho 'dhvaryusattamaḥ
pailo hotā vasoḥ putro dhaumyena sahito 'bhavat
eteṣāṃ śiṣyavargāś ca putrāś ca bharatarṣabha
babhūvur hotragāḥ sarve vedavedāṅgapāragāḥ
te vācayitvā puṇyāham īhayitvā ca taṃ vidhim
śāstroktaṃ yojayām āsus tad devayajanaṃ mahat
tatra cakrur anujñātāḥ śaraṇāny uta śilpinaḥ
ratnavanti viśālāni veśmānīva divaukasām
tata ājñāpayām āsa sa rājā rājasattamaḥ
sahadevaṃ tadā sadyo mantriṇaṃ kurusattamaḥ
āmantraṇārthaṃ dūtāṃs tvaṃ preṣayasvāśugān drutam
upaśrutya vaco rājñaḥ sa dūtān prāhiṇot tadā
āmantrayadhvaṃ rāṣṭreṣu brāhmaṇān bhūmipān api
viśaś ca mānyāñ śūdrāṃś ca sarvān ānayateti ca
te sarvān pṛthivīpālān pāṇḍaveyasya śāsanāt
āmantrayāṃ babhūvuś ca preṣayām āsa cāparān
tatas te tu yathākālaṃ kuntīputraṃ yudhiṣṭhiram
dīkṣayāṃ cakrire viprā rājasūyāya bhārata
dīkṣitaḥ sa tu dharmātmā dharmarājo yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
jagāma yajñāyatanaṃ vṛto vipraiḥ sahasraśaḥ
bhrātṛbhir jñātibhiś caiva suhṛdbhiḥ sacivais tathā
kṣatriyaiś ca manuṣyendra nānādeśasamāgataiḥ
amātyaiś ca nṛpaśreṣṭho dharmo vigrahavān iva
ājagmur brāhmaṇās tatra viṣayebhyas tatas tataḥ
sarvavidyāsu niṣṇātā vedavedāṅgapāragāḥ
teṣām āvasathāṃś cakrur dharmarājasya śāsanāt
bahvannāñ śayanair yuktān sagaṇānāṃ pṛthak pṛthak
sarvartuguṇasaṃpannāñ śilpino 'tha sahasraśaḥ
teṣu te nyavasan rājan brāhmaṇā bhṛśasatkṛtāḥ
kathayantaḥ kathā bahvīḥ paśyanto naṭanartakān
bhuñjatāṃ caiva viprāṇāṃ vadatāṃ ca mahāsvanaḥ
aniśaṃ śrūyate smātra muditānāṃ mahātmanām
dīyatāṃ dīyatām eṣāṃ bhujyatāṃ bhujyatām iti
evaṃprakārāḥ saṃjalpāḥ śrūyante smātra nityaśaḥ
gavāṃ śatasahasrāṇi śayanānāṃ ca bhārata
rukmasya yoṣitāṃ caiva dharmarājaḥ pṛthag dadau
prāvartataivaṃ yajñaḥ sa pāṇḍavasya mahātmanaḥ
pṛthivyām ekavīrasya śakrasyeva triviṣṭape
tato yudhiṣṭhiro rājā preṣayām āsa pāṇḍavam
nakulaṃ hāstinapuraṃ bhīṣmāya bharatarṣabha
droṇāya dhṛtarāṣṭrāya vidurāya kṛpāya ca
bhrātṝṇāṃ caiva sarveṣāṃ ye 'nuraktā yudhiṣṭhire
vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca
sa gatvā hāstinapuraṃ nakulaḥ samitiṃjayaḥ
bhīṣmam āmantrayām āsa dhṛtarāṣṭraṃ ca pāṇḍavaḥ
prayayuḥ prītamanaso yajñaṃ brahmapuraḥsarāḥ
saṃśrutya dharmarājasya yajñaṃ yajñavidas tadā
anye ca śataśas tuṣṭair manobhir manujarṣabha
draṣṭukāmāḥ sabhāṃ caiva dharmarājaṃ ca pāṇḍavam
digbhyaḥ sarve samāpetuḥ pārthivās tatra bhārata
samupādāya ratnāni vividhāni mahānti ca
dhṛtarāṣṭraś ca bhīṣmaś ca viduraś ca mahāmatiḥ
duryodhanapurogāś ca bhrātaraḥ sarva eva te
satkṛtyāmantritāḥ sarve ācāryapramukhā nṛpāḥ
gāndhārarājaḥ subalaḥ śakuniś ca mahābalaḥ
acalo vṛṣakaś caiva karṇaś ca rathināṃ varaḥ
ṛtaḥ śalyo madrarājo bāhlikaś ca mahārathaḥ
somadatto 'tha kauravyo bhūrir bhūriśravāḥ śalaḥ
aśvatthāmā kṛpo droṇaḥ saindhavaś ca jayadrathaḥ
yajñasenaḥ saputraś ca śālvaś ca vasudhādhipaḥ
prāgjyotiṣaś ca nṛpatir bhagadatto mahāyaśāḥ
saha sarvais tathā mlecchaiḥ sāgarānūpavāsibhiḥ
pārvatīyāś ca rājāno rājā caiva bṛhadbalaḥ
pauṇḍrako vāsudevaś ca vaṅgaḥ kāliṅgakas tathā
ākarṣaḥ kuntalaś caiva vānavāsyāndhrakās tathā
draviḍāḥ siṃhalāś caiva rājā kāśmīrakas tathā
kuntibhojo mahātejāḥ suhmaś ca sumahābalaḥ
bāhlikāś cāpare śūrā rājānaḥ sarva eva te
virāṭaḥ saha putraiś ca mācellaś ca mahārathaḥ
rājāno rājaputrāś ca nānājanapadeśvarāḥ
śiśupālo mahāvīryaḥ saha putreṇa bhārata
āgacchat pāṇḍaveyasya yajñaṃ saṃgrāmadurmadaḥ
rāmaś caivāniruddhaś ca babhruś ca sahasāraṇaḥ
gadapradyumnasāmbāś ca cārudeṣṇaś ca vīryavān
ulmuko niśaṭhaś caiva vīraḥ prādyumnir eva ca
vṛṣṇayo nikhilenānye samājagmur mahārathāḥ
ete cānye ca bahavo rājāno madhyadeśajāḥ
ājagmuḥ pāṇḍuputrasya rājasūyaṃ mahākratum
dadus teṣām āvasathān dharmarājasya śāsanāt
bahukakṣyānvitān rājan dīrghikāvṛkṣaśobhitān
tathā dharmātmajas teṣāṃ cakre pūjām anuttamām
satkṛtāś ca yathoddiṣṭāñ jagmur āvasathān nṛpāḥ
kailāsaśikharaprakhyān manojñān dravyabhūṣitān
sarvataḥ saṃvṛtān uccaiḥ prākāraiḥ sukṛtaiḥ sitaiḥ
suvarṇajālasaṃvītān maṇikuṭṭimaśobhitān
sukhārohaṇasopānān mahāsanaparicchadān
sragdāmasamavacchannān uttamāgurugandhinaḥ
haṃsāṃśuvarṇasadṛśān āyojanasudarśanān
asaṃbādhān samadvārān yutān uccāvacair guṇaiḥ
bahudhātupinaddhāṅgān himavacchikharān iva
viśrāntās te tato 'paśyan bhūmipā bhūridakṣiṇam
vṛtaṃ sadasyair bahubhir dharmarājaṃ yudhiṣṭhiram
tat sadaḥ pārthivaiḥ kīrṇaṃ brāhmaṇaiś ca mahātmabhiḥ
bhrājate sma tadā rājan nākapṛṣṭham ivāmaraiḥ
vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca
pitāmahaṃ guruṃ caiva pratyudgamya yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
abhivādya tato rājann idaṃ vacanam abravīt
bhīṣmaṃ droṇaṃ kṛpaṃ drauṇiṃ duryodhanaviviṃśatī
asmin yajñe bhavanto mām anugṛhṇantu sarvaśaḥ
idaṃ vaḥ svam ahaṃ caiva yad ihāsti dhanaṃ mama
prīṇayantu bhavanto māṃ yatheṣṭam aniyantritāḥ
evam uktvā sa tān sarvān dīkṣitaḥ pāṇḍavāgrajaḥ
yuyoja ha yathāyogam adhikāreṣv anantaram
bhakṣyabhojyādhikāreṣu duḥśāsanam ayojayat
parigrahe brāhmaṇānām aśvatthāmānam uktavān
rājñāṃ tu pratipūjārthaṃ saṃjayaṃ saṃnyayojayat
kṛtākṛtaparijñāne bhīṣmadroṇau mahāmatī
hiraṇyasya suvarṇasya ratnānāṃ cānvavekṣaṇe
dakṣiṇānāṃ ca vai dāne kṛpaṃ rājā nyayojayat
tathānyān puruṣavyāghrāṃs tasmiṃs tasmin nyayojayat
bāhliko dhṛtarāṣṭraś ca somadatto jayadrathaḥ
nakulena samānītāḥ svāmivat tatra remire
kṣattā vyayakaras tv āsīd viduraḥ sarvadharmavit
duryodhanas tv arhaṇāni pratijagrāha sarvaśaḥ
sarvalokaḥ samāvṛttaḥ piprīṣuḥ phalam uttamam
draṣṭukāmaḥ sabhāṃ caiva dharmarājaṃ ca pāṇḍavam
na kaś cid āharat tatra sahasrāvaram arhaṇam
ratnaiś ca bahubhis tatra dharmarājam avardhayan
kathaṃ nu mama kauravyo ratnadānaiḥ samāpnuyāt
yajñam ity eva rājānaḥ spardhamānā dadur dhanam
bhavanaiḥ savimānāgraiḥ sodarkair balasaṃvṛtaiḥ
lokarājavimānaiś ca brāhmaṇāvasathaiḥ saha
kṛtair āvasathair divyair vimānapratimais tathā
vicitrai ratnavadbhiś ca ṛddhyā paramayā yutaiḥ
rājabhiś ca samāvṛttair atīvaśrīsamṛddhibhiḥ
aśobhata sado rājan kaunteyasya mahātmanaḥ
ṛddhyā ca varuṇaṃ devaṃ spardhamāno yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
ṣaḍagninātha yajñena so 'yajad dakṣiṇāvatā
sarvāñ janān sarvakāmaiḥ samṛddhaiḥ samatarpayat
annavān bahubhakṣyaś ca bhuktavajjanasaṃvṛtaḥ
ratnopahārakarmaṇyo babhūva sa samāgamaḥ
iḍājyahomāhutibhir mantraśikṣāsamanvitaiḥ
tasmin hi tatṛpur devās tate yajñe maharṣibhiḥ
yathā devās tathā viprā dakṣiṇānnamahādhanaiḥ
tatṛpuḥ sarvavarṇāś ca tasmin yajñe mudānvitāḥ
vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca
tato 'bhiṣecanīye 'hni brāhmaṇā rājabhiḥ saha
antarvedīṃ praviviśuḥ satkārārthaṃ maharṣayaḥ
nāradapramukhās tasyām antarvedyāṃ mahātmanaḥ
samāsīnāḥ śuśubhire saha rājarṣibhis tadā
sametā brahmabhavane devā devarṣayo yathā
karmāntaram upāsanto jajalpur amitaujasaḥ
idam evaṃ na cāpy evam evam etan na cānyathā
ity ūcur bahavas tatra vitaṇḍānāḥ parasparam
kṛśān arthāṃs tathā ke cid akṛśāṃs tatra kurvate
akṛśāṃś ca kṛśāṃś cakrur hetubhiḥ śāstraniścitaiḥ
tatra medhāvinaḥ ke cid artham anyaiḥ prapūritam
vicikṣipur yathā śyenā nabhogatam ivāmiṣam
ke cid dharmārthasaṃyuktāḥ kathās tatra mahāvratāḥ
remire kathayantaś ca sarvavedavidāṃ varāḥ
sā vedir vedasaṃpannair devadvijamaharṣibhiḥ
ābabhāse samākīrṇā nakṣatrair dyaur ivāmalā
na tasyāṃ saṃnidhau śūdraḥ kaś cid āsīn na cāvrataḥ
antarvedyāṃ tadā rājan yudhiṣṭhiraniveśane
tāṃ tu lakṣmīvato lakṣmīṃ tadā yajñavidhānajām
tutoṣa nāradaḥ paśyan dharmarājasya dhīmataḥ
atha cintāṃ samāpede sa munir manujādhipa
nāradas taṃ tadā paśyan sarvakṣatrasamāgamam
sasmāra ca purāvṛttāṃ kathāṃ tāṃ bharatarṣabha
aṃśāvataraṇe yāsau brahmaṇo bhavane 'bhavat
devānāṃ saṃgamaṃ taṃ tu vijñāya kurunandana
nāradaḥ puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ sasmāra manasā harim
sākṣāt sa vibudhārighnaḥ kṣatre nārāyaṇo vibhuḥ
pratijñāṃ pālayan dhīmāñ jātaḥ parapuraṃjayaḥ
saṃdideśa purā yo 'sau vibudhān bhūtakṛt svayam
anyonyam abhinighnantaḥ punar lokān avāpsyatha
iti nārāyaṇaḥ śaṃbhur bhagavāñ jagataḥ prabhuḥ
ādiśya vibudhān sarvān ajāyata yadukṣaye
kṣitāv andhakavṛṣṇīnāṃ vaṃśe vaṃśabhṛtāṃ varaḥ
parayā śuśubhe lakṣmyā nakṣatrāṇām ivoḍurāṭ
yasya bāhubalaṃ sendrāḥ surāḥ sarva upāsate
so 'yaṃ mānuṣavan nāma harir āste 'rimardanaḥ
aho bata mahad bhūtaṃ svayaṃbhūr yad idaṃ svayam
ādāsyati punaḥ kṣatram evaṃ balasamanvitam
ity etāṃ nāradaś cintāṃ cintayām āsa dharmavit
hariṃ nārāyaṇaṃ jñātvā yajñair īḍyaṃ tam īśvaram
tasmin dharmavidāṃ śreṣṭho dharmarājasya dhīmataḥ
mahādhvare mahābuddhis tasthau sa bahumānataḥ
vaiśaṃpāyanaḥ
tataḥ samuditā mukhyair guṇair guṇavatāṃ varāḥ
bahavo bhāvitātmānaḥ pṛthak pṛthag ariṃdamāḥ
ātmakṛtyam iti jñātvā pāñcālās tatra sarvaśaḥ
samīyur vṛṣṇayaś caiva tadānīkāgrahāriṇaḥ
sadārāḥ sajanāmātyā vahanto ratnasaṃcayān
vikṛṣṭatvāc ca deśasya gurubhāratayā ca te
yayuḥ pramuditāḥ paścād rājabhir na samaṃ yayuḥ
balaśeṣaṃ samuditaṃ parigṛhya samantataḥ
rājñāṃ cakrāyudhaḥ śaurir amitragaṇamardanaḥ
balādhikāre nikṣiptaṃ saṃmānyānakadundubhim
saṃprāyād yādavaśreṣṭho yajamāne yudhiṣṭhire
uccāvacam upādāya dharmarājāya mādhavaḥ
dhanaughaṃ purataḥ kṛtvā khāṇḍavaprastham āyayau
tatra yajñāgatān sarvāṃś caidyavakrapurogamān
bhūmipālagaṇān sarvān saprabhān iva toyadān
meghakāyān niḥśvasato yūthapān iva yūthapaḥ
balinaḥ siṃhasaṃkāśān mahīm āvṛtya tiṣṭhataḥ
tato janaughasaṃbādhaṃ rājasāgaram avyayam
nādayan rathaghoṣeṇābhyupāyān madhusūdanaḥ
asūryam iva sūryeṇa nivātam iva vāyunā
kṛṣṇena samupetena jaharṣe bhārataṃ puram
brāhmaṇakṣatriyāṇāṃ hi pūjārthaṃ sarvadharmavit
sahadevo viśeṣajño mādrīputraḥ kṛto 'bhavat
prabhavantaṃ tu bhūtānāṃ bhāsvantam iva tejasā
praviśantaṃ yajñabhūmiṃ sitasyāvarajaṃ vibhum
tejorāśim ṛṣiṃ vipram adṛśyam avijānatām
vayodhikānāṃ vṛddhānāṃ mārgam ātmani tiṣṭhatām
jagatas tasthuṣaś caiva prabhavāpyayam acyutam
anantam antaṃ śatrūṇām amitragaṇamardanam
prabhavaṃ sarvabhūtānām āpatsv abhayam acyutam
bhaviṣyaṃ bhāvanaṃ bhūtaṃ dvāravatyām ariṃdamam
sa dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇam āyāntaṃ pratipūjyāmitaujasam
yathārhaṃ keśave vṛttiṃ pratyapadyata pāṇḍavaḥ
jyaiṣṭhyakāniṣṭhyasaṃyogaṃ saṃpradhārya guṇāguṇaiḥ
ārirādhayiṣur dharmaḥ pūjayitvā dvijottamān
mahad ādityasaṃkāśam āsanaṃ ca jagatpateḥ
dadau nāsāditaṃ kaiś cit tasminn upaviveśa saḥ
tato bhīṣmo 'bravīd rājan dharmarājaṃ yudhiṣṭhiram
kriyatām arhaṇaṃ rājñāṃ yathārham iti bhārata
ācāryam ṛtvijaṃ caiva saṃyuktaṃ ca yudhiṣṭhira
snātakaṃ ca priyaṃ cāhuḥ ṣaḍ arghyārhān nṛpaṃ tathā
etān arhān abhigatān āhuḥ saṃvatsaroṣitān
ta ime kālapūgasya mahato 'smān upāgatāḥ
eṣām ekaikaśo rājann arghyam ānīyatām iti
atha caiṣāṃ variṣṭhāya samarthāyopanīyatām
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca
kasmai bhavān manyate 'rgham ekasmai kurunandana
upanīyamānaṃ yuktaṃ ca tan me brūhi pitāmaha
vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca
tato bhīṣmaḥ śāṃtanavo buddhyā niścitya bhārata
vārṣṇeyaṃ manyate kṛṣṇam arhaṇīyatamaṃ bhuvi
eṣa hy eṣāṃ sametānāṃ tejobalaparākramaiḥ
madhye tapann ivābhāti jyotiṣām iva bhāskaraḥ
asūryam iva sūryeṇa nivātam iva vāyunā
bhāsitaṃ hlāditaṃ caiva kṛṣṇenedaṃ sado hi naḥ
tasmai bhīṣmābhyanujñātaḥ sahadevaḥ pratāpavān
upajahre 'tha vidhivad vārṣṇeyāyārghyam uttamam
pratijagrāha tat kṛṣṇaḥ śāstradṛṣṭena karmaṇā
śiśupālas tu tāṃ pūjāṃ vāsudeve na cakṣame
sa upālabhya bhīṣmaṃ ca dharmarājaṃ ca saṃsadi
apākṣipad vāsudevaṃ cedirājo mahābalaḥ
śiśupāla uvāca
nāyam arhati vārṣṇeyas tiṣṭhatsv iha mahātmasu
mahīpatiṣu kauravya rājavat pārthivārhaṇam
nāyaṃ yuktaḥ samācāraḥ pāṇḍaveṣu mahātmasu
yat kāmāt puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ pāṇḍavārcitavān asi
bālā yūyaṃ na jānīdhvaṃ dharmaḥ sūkṣmo hi pāṇḍavāḥ
ayaṃ tatrābhyatikrānta āpageyo 'lpadarśanaḥ
tvādṛśo dharmayukto hi kurvāṇaḥ priyakāmyayā
bhavaty abhyadhikaṃ bhīṣmo lokeṣv avamataḥ satām
kathaṃ hy arājā dāśārho madhye sarvamahīkṣitām
arhaṇām arhati tathā yathā yuṣmābhir arcitaḥ
atha vā manyase kṛṣṇaṃ sthaviraṃ bharatarṣabha
vasudeve sthite vṛddhe katham arhati tatsutaḥ
atha vā vāsudevo 'pi priyakāmo 'nuvṛttavān
drupade tiṣṭhati kathaṃ mādhavo 'rhati pūjanam
ācāryaṃ manyase kṛṣṇam atha vā kurupuṃgava
droṇe tiṣṭhati vārṣṇeyaṃ kasmād arcitavān asi
ṛtvijaṃ manyase kṛṣṇam atha vā kurunandana
dvaipāyane sthite vipre kathaṃ kṛṣṇo 'rcitas tvayā
bhīṣme śāṃtanave rājan sthite puruṣasattame
svacchandamṛtyuke rājan kathaṃ kṛṣṇo 'rcitas tvayā
aśvatthāmni sthite vīre sarvaśāstraviśārade
kathaṃ kṛṣṇas tvayā rājann arcitaḥ kurunandana
duryodhane ca rājendre sthite puruṣasattame
kṛpe ca bhāratācārye kathaṃ kṛṣṇas tvayārcitaḥ
drumaṃ kiṃpuruṣācāryam atikramya tathārcitaḥ
bhīṣmake ca durādharṣe pāṇḍye ca kṛtalakṣaṇe
nṛpe ca rukmiṇi śreṣṭhe ekalavye tathaiva ca
śalye madrādhipe caiva kathaṃ kṛṣṇo 'rcitas tvayā
ayaṃ ca sarvarājñāṃ yo balaślāghī mahārathaḥ
jāmadagnyasya dayitaḥ śiṣyo viprasya bhārata
yenātmabalam āśritya rājāno yudhi nirjitāḥ
taṃ ca karṇam atikramya kathaṃ kṛṣṇo 'rcitas tvayā
bhīṣme śāṃtanave rājan sthite puruṣasattame
svacchandamṛtyuke tasmin kathaṃ kṛṣṇo 'rcitas tvayā
kṛpe ca bhāratācārye kathaṃ kṛṣṇo 'rcitas tvayā
aśvatthāmni sthite vīre sarvaśastraviśārade
kathaṃ kṛṣṇas tvayā rājann arcito yadunandanaḥ
drume kiṃpuruṣācārye kathaṃ kṛṣṇas tvayārcitaḥ
ayaṃ pārthād anavamo dhanurvede parākrame
ekalavye sthite rājan kathaṃ kṛṣṇas tvayārcitaḥ
bhagadatte mahāvīrye jayatsene ca māgadhe
kāliṅge ca sthite rājan kathaṃ kṛṣṇas tvayārcitaḥ
pūrvadeśādhipe vīre kausalendre bṛhadbale
virāṭe ca sthite vīre kathaṃ kṛṣṇo 'rcitas tvayā
bhīṣmake ca durādharṣe pāṇḍye ca kṛtadhanvani
nṛpe rukmiṇi ca śreṣṭhe dantavakre ca pārthive
śalye madrādhipe caiva kathaṃ kṛṣṇas tvayārcitaḥ
surāṣṭrādhipatau vīre mālave ca sthite nṛpe
kṛtakṣaṇe ca vaidehe kathaṃ kṛṣṇas tvayārcitaḥ
ayaṃ ca sarvarājñāṃ yo balaślāghī mahārathaḥ
jāmadagnyasya dayitaḥ śiṣyo viprasya bhārata
yenātmabalam āśritya jarāsaṃdho yudhā jitaḥ
taṃ karṇaṃ samatikramya kathaṃ kṛṣṇas tvayārcitaḥ
vindānuvindāv āvantyau kāmbhojaṃ ca sudakṣiṇam
sthite sālve ca rājendre kathaṃ kṛṣṇo 'rcitas tvayā
asmin pārthasakhe rājan gandharvāṇāṃ mahīpatau
sthite citrarathe vīre kathaṃ kṛṣṇas tvayārcitaḥ
bāhlīkaṃ sthaviraṃ vīraṃ kauravāṇāṃ mahāratham
saumadattiṃ mahāvīryaṃ somadattaṃ mahāratham
śakuniṃ saubalaṃ caiva sindhurājaṃ mahābalam
etān avamatān kṛtvā kathaṃ kṛṣṇo 'rcitas tvayā
naiva ṛtviṅ na cācāryo na rājā madhusūdanaḥ
arcitaś ca kuruśreṣṭha kim anyat priyakāmyayā
atha vāpy arcanīyo 'yaṃ yuṣmākaṃ madhusūdanaḥ
kiṃ rājabhir ihānītair avamānāya bhārata
vayaṃ tu na bhayād asya kaunteyasya mahātmanaḥ
prayacchāmaḥ karān sarve na lobhān na ca sāntvanāt
asya dharmapravṛttasya pārthivatvaṃ cikīrṣataḥ
karān asmai prayacchāmaḥ so 'yam asmān na manyate
kim anyad avamānād dhi yad imaṃ rājasaṃsadi
aprāptalakṣaṇaṃ kṛṣṇam arghyeṇārcitavān asi
akasmād dharmaputrasya dharmātmeti yaśo gatam
ko hi dharmacyute pūjām evaṃ yuktāṃ prayojayet
yo 'yaṃ vṛṣṇikule jāto rājānaṃ hatavān purā
adya dharmātmatā caiva vyapakṛṣṭā yudhiṣṭhirāt
kṛpaṇatvaṃ niviṣṭaṃ ca kṛṣṇe 'rghyasya nivedanāt
yadi bhītāś ca kaunteyāḥ kṛpaṇāś ca tapasvinaḥ
nanu tvayāpi boddhavyaṃ yāṃ pūjāṃ mādhavo 'rhati
atha vā kṛpaṇair etām upanītāṃ janārdana
pūjām anarhaḥ kasmāt tvam abhyanujñātavān asi
ayuktām ātmanaḥ pūjāṃ tvaṃ punar bahu manyase
haviṣaḥ prāpya niṣyandaṃ prāśituṃ śveva nirjane
na tv ayaṃ pārthivendrāṇām avamānaḥ prayujyate
tvām eva kuravo vyaktaṃ pralambhante janārdana
klībe dārakriyā yādṛg andhe vā rūpadarśanam
arājño rājavat pūjā tathā te madhusūdana
dṛṣṭo yudhiṣṭhiro rājā dṛṣṭo bhīṣmaś ca yādṛśaḥ
vāsudevo 'py ayaṃ dṛṣṭaḥ sarvam etad yathātatham
ity uktvā śiśupālas tān utthāya paramāsanāt
niryayau sadasas tasmāt sahito rājabhis tadā
vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca
tato yudhiṣṭhiro rājā śiśupālam upādravat
uvāca cainaṃ madhuraṃ sāntvapūrvam idaṃ vacaḥ
nedaṃ yuktaṃ mahīpāla yādṛśaṃ vai tvam uktavān
adharmaś ca paro rājan pāruṣyaṃ ca nirarthakam
na hi dharmaṃ paraṃ jātu nāvabudhyeta pārthiva
bhīṣmaḥ śāṃtanavas tv enaṃ māvamaṃsthā ato 'nyathā
paśya cemān mahīpālāṃs tvatto vṛddhatamān bahūn
mṛṣyante cārhaṇāṃ kṛṣṇe tadvat tvaṃ kṣantum arhasi
veda tattvena kṛṣṇaṃ hi bhīṣmaś cedipate bhṛśam
na hy enaṃ tvaṃ tathā vettha yathainaṃ veda kauravaḥ
bhīṣma uvāca
nāsmā anunayo deyo nāyam arhati sāntvanam
lokavṛddhatame kṛṣṇe yo 'rhaṇāṃ nānumanyate
kṣatriyaḥ kṣatriyaṃ jitvā raṇe raṇakṛtāṃ varaḥ
yo muñcati vaśe kṛtvā gurur bhavati tasya saḥ
asyāṃ ca samitau rājñām ekam apy ajitaṃ yudhi
na paśyāmi mahīpālaṃ sātvatīputratejasā
na hi kevalam asmākam ayam arcyatamo 'cyutaḥ
trayāṇām api lokānām arcanīyo janārdanaḥ
kṛṣṇena hi jitā yuddhe bahavaḥ kṣatriyarṣabhāḥ
jagat sarvaṃ ca vārṣṇeye nikhilena pratiṣṭhitam
tasmāt satsv api vṛddheṣu kṛṣṇam arcāma netarān
evaṃ vaktuṃ na cārhas tvaṃ mā bhūt te buddhir īdṛśī
jñānavṛddhā mayā rājan bahavaḥ paryupāsitāḥ
teṣāṃ kathayatāṃ śaurer ahaṃ guṇavato guṇān
samāgatānām aśrauṣaṃ bahūn bahumatān satām
karmāṇy api ca yāny asya janmaprabhṛti dhīmataḥ
bahuśaḥ kathyamānāni narair bhūyaḥ śrutāni me
na kevalaṃ vayaṃ kāmāc cedirāja janārdanam
na saṃbandhaṃ puraskṛtya kṛtārthaṃ vā kathaṃ cana
arcāmahe 'rcitaṃ sadbhir bhuvi bhaumasukhāvaham
yaśaḥ śauryaṃ jayaṃ cāsya vijñāyārcāṃ prayujmahe
na hi kaś cid ihāsmābhiḥ subālo 'py aparīkṣitaḥ
guṇair vṛddhān atikramya harir arcyatamo mataḥ
jñānavṛddho dvijātīnāṃ kṣatriyāṇāṃ balādhikaḥ
pūjye tāv iha govinde hetū dvāv api saṃsthitau
vedavedāṅgavijñānaṃ balaṃ cāpy amitaṃ tathā
nṛṇāṃ hi loke kasyāsti viśiṣṭaṃ keśavād ṛte
dānaṃ dākṣyaṃ śrutaṃ śauryaṃ hrīḥ kīrtir buddhir uttamā
saṃnatiḥ śrīr dhṛtis tuṣṭiḥ puṣṭiś ca niyatācyute
tam imaṃ sarvasaṃpannam ācāryaṃ pitaraṃ gurum
arcyam arcitam arcārhaṃ sarve saṃmantum arhatha
ṛtvig gurur vivāhyaś ca snātako nṛpatiḥ priyaḥ
sarvam etad dhṛṣīkeśe tasmād abhyarcito 'cyutaḥ
kṛṣṇa eva hi lokānām utpattir api cāpyayaḥ
kṛṣṇasya hi kṛte bhūtam idaṃ viśvaṃ samarpitam
eṣa prakṛtir avyaktā kartā caiva sanātanaḥ
paraś ca sarvabhūtebhyas tasmād vṛddhatamo 'cyutaḥ
buddhir mano mahān vāyus tejo 'mbhaḥ khaṃ mahī ca yā
caturvidhaṃ ca yad bhūtaṃ sarvaṃ kṛṣṇe pratiṣṭhitam
ādityaś candramāś caiva nakṣatrāṇi grahāś ca ye
diśaś copadiśaś caiva sarvaṃ kṛṣṇe pratiṣṭhitam
ayaṃ tu puruṣo bālaḥ śiśupālo na budhyate
sarvatra sarvadā kṛṣṇaṃ tasmād evaṃ prabhāṣate
yo hi dharmaṃ vicinuyād utkṛṣṭaṃ matimān naraḥ
sa vai paśyed yathādharmaṃ na tathā cedirāḍ ayam
savṛddhabāleṣv atha vā pārthiveṣu mahātmasu
ko nārhaṃ manyate kṛṣṇaṃ ko vāpy enaṃ na pūjayet
athemāṃ duṣkṛtāṃ pūjāṃ śiśupālo vyavasyati
duṣkṛtāyāṃ yathānyāyaṃ tathāyaṃ kartum arhati
vaiśaṃpāyanaḥ
evam ukte tu gāṅgeye śiśupālaś cukopa ha
sahadevaḥ
kruddhaṃ sunīthaṃ dṛṣṭvātha sahadevo 'bravīt tadā
nītipūrvam idaṃ sarvaṃ cedirāja mayā kṛtam
na me vimatir astīha kāraṇaṃ cātra me śṛṇu
sa pārthivānāṃ sarveṣāṃ guruḥ kṛṣṇo balena vai
tasmād abhyarcito 'rghyārhaḥ sarve saṃmantum arhatha
yo vā na sahate rājñāṃ kaś cit sabalavāhanaḥ
kṣipraṃ yuddhāya niryātu śaktaś ced atra me yudhi
tasya mūrdhni susaṃnyastaṃ rājñaḥ savyaṃ padaṃ mayā
evam ukto mayā hetur uttaraṃ prabravītu me
vaiśaṃpāyanaḥ
tato na vyājahāraiṣāṃ kaś cid buddhimatāṃ satām
mānināṃ balināṃ rājñāṃ madhye saṃdarśite pade
puṣpavṛṣṭir mahaty āsīt sahadevasya mūrdhani
evam ukte sunīthasya sahadevena keśave
svabhāvarakte nayane bhūyo rakte babhūvatuḥ
tasya kopaṃ samudbhūtaṃ jñātvā bhīṣmaḥ pratāpavān
ācacakṣe punas tasmai kṛṣṇasyaivottamān guṇān
sa sunīthaṃ samāmantrya tāṃś ca sarvān mahīkṣitaḥ
uvāca vadatāṃ śreṣṭha idaṃ matimatāṃ varaḥ
sahadevena rājāno yad uktaṃ keśavaṃ prati
vaiśaṃpāyanaḥ
tat tatheti vijānīdhvaṃ bhūyaś cātra nibodhata
tato bhīṣmasya tac chrutvā vacaḥ kāle yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
uvāca matimān bhīṣmaṃ tataḥ kauravanandanaḥ
vistareṇāsya devasya karmāṇīcchāmi sarvaśaḥ
śrotuṃ bhagavatas tāni prabravīhi pitāmaha
karmaṇām ānupūrvyaṃ ca prādurbhāvāṃś ca me vibhoḥ
vaiśaṃpāyanaḥ
yathā ca prakṛtiḥ kṛṣṇe tan me brūhi pitāmaha
evam uktas tadā bhīṣmaḥ provāca puruṣarṣabham
yudhiṣṭhiram amitraghnaṃ tasmin kṣatrasamāgame
samakṣaṃ vāsudevasya devasyeva śatakratoḥ
karmāṇy asukarāṇy anyair ācacakṣe janādhipa
śṛṇvatāṃ pārthivānāṃ ca dharmarājasya cāntike
idaṃ matimatāṃ śreṣṭhaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ prati viśāṃ pate
sāmnaivāmantrya rājendraṃ cedirājam ariṃdamam
bhīmakarmā tato bhīṣmo bhūyaḥ sa idam abravīt
bhīṣmaḥ
kurūṇāṃ cāpi rājānaṃ yudhiṣṭhiram uvāca ha
vartamānām atītāṃ ca śṛṇu rājan yudhiṣṭhira
īśvarasyottamasyaināṃ karmaṇāṃ gahanāṃ gatim
avyakto vyaktaliṅgastho ya eṣa bhagavān prabhuḥ
purā nārāyaṇo devaḥ svayaṃbhūḥ prapitāmahaḥ
sahasraśīrṣaḥ puruṣo dhruvo 'vyaktaḥ sanātanaḥ
sahasrākṣaḥ sahasrāsyaḥ sahasracaraṇo vibhuḥ
sahasrabāhuḥ sāhasro devo nāmasahasravān
sahasramukuṭo devo viśvarūpo mahādyutiḥ
anekavarṇo devādir avyaktād vai pare sthitaḥ
asṛjat salilaṃ pūrvaṃ sa ca nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ
tatas tu bhagavāṃs toye brahmāṇam asṛjat svayam
brahmā caturmukho lokān sarvāṃs tān asṛjat svayam
ādikāle purā hy evaṃ sarvalokasya codbhavaḥ
purātha pralaye prāpte naṣṭe sthāvarajaṅgame
brahmādiṣu pralīneṣu naṣṭe loke carācare
ābhūtasaṃplave prāpte pralīne prakṛtau mahān
ekas tiṣṭhati sarvātmā sa tu nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ
nārāyaṇasya cāṅgāni sarvadaivāni bhārata
śiras tasya divaṃ rājan nābhiḥ khaṃ caraṇau mahī
aśvinau karṇayor devau cakṣuṣī śaśibhāskarau
indravaiśvānarau devau mukhaṃ tasya mahātmanaḥ
anyāni sarvadaivāni tasyāṅgāni mahātmanaḥ
sarvaṃ vyāpya haris tasthau sūtraṃ maṇigaṇān iva
ābhūtasaṃplavānte 'tha dṛṣṭvā sarvaṃ tamonvitam
nārāyaṇo mahāyogī sarvajñaḥ paramātmavān
brahmabhūtas tadātmānaṃ brahmāṇam asṛjat svayam
so 'dhyakṣaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ prabhūtaḥ prabhavo 'cyutaḥ
sanatkumāraṃ rudraṃ ca manuṃ caiva tapodhanān
sarvam evāsṛjad brahmā tato lokān prajās tathā
tena tad vyasṛjat tatra prāpte kāle yudhiṣṭhira
tebhyo 'bhavan mahātmabhyo bahudhā brahma śāśvatam
kalpānāṃ bahukoṭyaś ca samatītā hi bhārata
ābhūtasaṃplavāś caiva bahukoṭyo 'ticakramuḥ
manvantarayuge 'jasraṃ saṃkalpā bhūtasaṃplavāḥ
cakravat parivartante sarvaṃ viṣṇumayaṃ jagat
sṛṣṭvā caturmukhaṃ devaṃ devo nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ
sa lokānāṃ hitārthāya kṣīrode vasati prabhuḥ
brahmā tu sarvabhūtānāṃ lokasya ca pitāmahaḥ
bhīṣmaḥ
tato nārāyaṇo devaḥ sarvasya prapitāmahaḥ
avyakto vyaktaliṅgastho ya eṣa bhagavān prabhuḥ
nārāyaṇo jagac cakre prabhavāpyayasaṃhitaḥ
eṣa nārāyaṇo bhūtvā harir āsīd yudhiṣṭhira
brahmāṇaṃ śaśisūryau ca dharmaṃ caivāsṛjat svayam
bahuśaḥ sarvabhūtātmā prādurbhavati kāryataḥ
prādurbhāvāṃs tu vakṣyāmi divyān devagaṇair yutān
suptvā yugasahasraṃ sa prādurbhavati kāryavān
pūrṇe yugasahasre 'tha devadevo jagatpatiḥ
brahmāṇaṃ kapilaṃ caiva parameṣṭhiṃ tathaiva ca
devān saptaṛṣīṃś caiva śaṃkaraṃ ca mahāyaśāḥ
sanatkumāraṃ bhagavān manuṃ caiva prajāpatim
purā cakre 'tha devādiḥ pradīptāgnisamaprabhaḥ
yena cārṇavamadhyasthau naṣṭe sthāvarajaṅgame
naṣṭadevāsuranare praṇaṣṭoragarākṣase
yoddhukāmau sudurdharṣau bhrātarau madhukaiṭabhau
hatau prabhavatā tena tayor dattvā vṛtaṃ varam
bhūmiṃ baddhvā kṛtau pūrvaṃ mṛnmayau dvau mahāsurau
karṇasrotodbhavau tau tu viṣṇos tasya mahātmanaḥ
mahārṇave prasvapataḥ śailarājasamau sthitau
tau viveśa svayaṃ vāyur brahmaṇā sādhu coditaḥ
tau divaṃ chādayitvā tu vavṛdhāte mahāsurau
vāyuprāṇau tu tau dṛṣṭvā brahmā paryāmṛśac chanaiḥ
ekaṃ mṛdutaraṃ viddhi kaṭhinaṃ viddhi cāparam
nāmanī tu tayoś cakre sa vibhuḥ salilodbhavaḥ
mṛdus tv ayaṃ madhur nāma kaṭhinaḥ kaiṭabhaḥ svayam
tau daityau kṛtanāmānau ceratur balagarvitau
tau purātha divaṃ sarvāṃ prāptau rājan mahāsurau
pracchādyātha divaṃ sarvāṃ ceratur madhukaiṭabhau
sarvam ekārṇavaṃ lokaṃ yoddhukāmau sunirbhayau
tau gatāv asurau dṛṣṭvā brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ
ekārṇavāmbunicaye tatraivāntaradhīyata
sa padme padmanābhasya nābhideśāt samutthite
āsīd ādau svayaṃ janma tat paṅkajam apaṅkajam
pūjayām āsa vasatiṃ brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ
tāv ubhau jalagarbhasthau nārāyaṇacaturmukhau
bahūn varṣāyutān apsu śayānau na cakampatuḥ
atha dīrghasya kālasya tāv ubhau madhukaiṭabhau
ājagmatus tam uddeśaṃ yatra brahmā vyavasthitaḥ
tau dṛṣṭvā lokanāthas tu kopāt saṃraktalocanaḥ
utpapātātha śayanāt padmanābho mahādyutiḥ
tad yuddham abhavad ghoraṃ tayos tasya ca vai tadā
ekārṇave tadā ghore trailokye jalatāṃ gate
tad abhūt tumulaṃ yuddhaṃ varṣasaṃghān sahasraśaḥ
na ca tāv asurau yuddhe tadā śramam avāpatuḥ
atha dīrghasya kālasya tau daityau yuddhadurmadau
ūcatuḥ prītamanasau devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum
prītau svas tava yuddhena ślāghyas tvaṃ mṛtyur āvayoḥ
āvāṃ jahi na yatrorvī salilena pariplutā
hatau ca tava putratvaṃ prāpnuyāva surottama
yo hy āvāṃ yudhi nirjetā tasyāvāṃ vihitau sutau
tayoḥ sa vacanaṃ śrutvā tadā nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ
tau pragṛhya mṛdhe daityau dorbhyāṃ tau samapīḍayat
ūrubhyāṃ nidhanaṃ cakre tāv ubhau madhukaiṭabhau
tau hatau cāplutau toye vapurbhyām ekatāṃ gatau
medo mumucatur daityau mathyamānau jalormibhiḥ
medasā taj jalaṃ vyāptaṃ tābhyām antardadhe tadā
nārāyaṇaś ca bhagavān asṛjad vividhāḥ prajāḥ
daityayor medasā channā sarvā rājan vasuṃdharā
tadā prabhṛti kaunteya medinīti smṛtā mahī
prabhāvāt padmanābhasya śāśvatī ca kṛtā nṛṇām
bhīṣmaḥ
prādurbhāvasahasrāṇi samatītāny anekaśaḥ
yathāśakti tu vakṣyāmi śṛṇu tān kurunandana
purā kamalanābhasya svapataḥ sāgarāmbhasi
puṣkare yatra saṃbhūtā devā ṛṣigaṇaiḥ saha
eṣa pauṣkariko nāma prādurbhāvaḥ prakīrtitaḥ
purāṇaḥ kathyate yatra vedaśrutisamāhitaḥ
vārāhas tu śrutimukhaḥ prādurbhāvo mahātmanaḥ
yatra viṣṇuḥ suraśreṣṭho vārāhaṃ rūpam āsthitaḥ
ujjahāra mahīṃ toyāt saśailavanakānanām
vedapādo yūpadaṃṣṭraḥ kratudantaś citīmukhaḥ
agnijihvo darbharomā brahmaśīrṣo mahātapāḥ
ahorātrekṣaṇo divyo vedāṅgaḥ śrutibhūṣaṇaḥ
ājyanāsaḥ snuvatuṇḍaḥ sāmaghoṣasvano mahān
dharmasatyamayaḥ śrīmān karmavikramasatkṛtaḥ
prāyaścittamayo dhīraḥ paśujānur mahāvṛṣaḥ
udgātṛhomaliṅgo 'sau paśubījamahauṣadhiḥ
bāhyāntarātmā mantrāsthivikṛtaḥ saumyadarśanaḥ
vedaskandho havirgandho havyakavyādivegavān
prāgvaṃśakāyo dyutimān nānādīkṣābhir ācitaḥ
dakṣiṇāhṛdayo yogī mahāsatramayo mahān
upākarmoṣṭharucakaḥ pravargyāvartabhūṣaṇaḥ
chāyāpatnīsahāyo vai maṇiśṛṅga ivocchritaḥ
evaṃ yajñavarāho vai bhūtvā viṣṇuḥ sanātanaḥ
mahīṃ sāgaraparyantāṃ saśailavanakānanām
ekārṇavajale bhraṣṭām ekārṇavagataḥ prabhuḥ
majjitāṃ salile tasmin svadevīṃ pṛthivīṃ tadā
ujjahāra viṣāṇena mārkaṇḍeyasya paśyataḥ
śṛṅgeṇemāṃ samuddhṛtya lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā
sahasraśīrṣo deveśo nirmame jagatīṃ prabhuḥ
evaṃ yajñavarāheṇa bhūtabhavyabhavātmanā
uddhṛtā pṛthivī devī sāgarāmbudharā purā
nihatā dānavāḥ sarve devadevena viṣṇunā
vārāhaḥ kathito hy eṣa nārasiṃham atho śṛṇu
yatra bhūtvā mṛgendreṇa hiraṇyakaśipur hataḥ
bhīṣmaḥ
daityendro balavān rājan surārir balagarvitaḥ
hiraṇyakaśipur nāma āsīt trailokyakaṇṭakaḥ
daityānām ādipuruṣo vīryavān dhṛtimān balī
sa praviśya vanaṃ rājaṃś cakāra tapa uttamam
daśa varṣasahasrāṇi śatāni daśa pañca ca
japopavāsas tasyāsīt sthāṇur maunavrato dṛḍhaḥ
tato damaśamābhyāṃ ca brahmacaryeṇa cānagha
brahmā prītamanās tasya tapasā niyamena ca
tataḥ svayaṃbhūr bhagavān svayam āgamya bhūpate
vimānenārkavarṇena haṃsayuktena bhāsvatā
ādityair vasubhiḥ sādhyair marudbhir daivataiḥ saha
radrair viśvasahāyaiś ca yakṣarākṣasakiṃnaraiḥ
diśābhir vidiśābhiś ca nadībhiḥ sāgarais tathā
nakṣatraiś ca muhūrtaiś ca khecaraiś cāparair grahaiḥ
devarṣibhis tapoyuktaiḥ siddhaiḥ saptarṣibhis tathā
rājarṣibhiḥ puṇyatamair gandharvair apsarogaṇaiḥ
carācaraguruḥ śrīmān vṛtaḥ sarvasurais tathā
brahmā
brahmā brahmavidāṃ śreṣṭho daityam āgamya cābravīt
prīto 'smi tava bhaktasya tapasānena suvrata
varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te yatheṣṭaṃ kāmam āpnuhi
hiraṇyakaśipuḥ
na devāsuragandharvā na yakṣoragarākṣasāḥ
na mānuṣāḥ piśācāś ca hanyur māṃ devasattama
ṛṣayo vā na māṃ śāpaiḥ kruddhā lokapitāmaha
śapeyus tapasā yuktā vara eṣa vṛto mayā
na śastreṇa na cāstreṇa giriṇā pādapena ca
na śuṣkeṇa na cārdreṇa syān na cānyena me vadhaḥ
nākāśe vā na bhūmau vā rātrau vā divase 'pi vā
nāntar vā na bahir vāpi syād vadho me pitāmaha
paśubhir vā mṛgair na syāt pakṣibhir vā sarīsṛpaiḥ
brahmā
dadāsi ced varān etān devadeva vṛṇomy aham
ete divyā varās tāta mayā dattās tavādbhutāḥ
sarvakāmān varāṃs tāta prāpsyase tvaṃ na saṃśayaḥ
evam uktvā sa bhagavān ākāśena jagāma ha
rarāja brahmaloke sa brahmarṣigaṇasevitaḥ
tato devāś ca nāgāś ca gandharvā munayas tathā
varapradānaṃ śrutvā te brahmāṇam upatasthire
devāḥ
vareṇānena bhagavan bādhiṣyati sa no 'suraḥ
tat prasīdasva bhagavan vadho 'sya pravicintyatām
bhagavan sarvabhūtānāṃ svayaṃbhūr ādikṛd vibhuḥ
bhīṣmaḥ
sraṣṭā ca havyakavyānām avyaktaprakṛtir dhruvaḥ
tato lokahitaṃ vākyaṃ śrutvā devaḥ prajāpatiḥ
provāca bhagavān vākyaṃ sarvadevagaṇāṃs tadā
avaśyaṃ tridaśās tena prāptavyaṃ tapasaḥ phalam
tapaso 'nte 'sya bhagavān vadhaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ kariṣyati
etac chrutvā surāḥ sarve brahmaṇā tasya vai vadham
svāni sthānāni divyāni jagmus te vai mudānvitāḥ
labdhamātre vare cāpi sarvās tā bādhate prajāḥ
hiraṇyakaśipur daityo varadānena darpitaḥ
rājyaṃ cakāra daityendro daityasaṃghaiḥ samāvṛtaḥ
sapta dvīpān vaśe cakre lokālokāntaraṃ balāt
divyalokān samastān vai bhogān divyān avāpa saḥ
devāṃs tribhuvanasthāṃs tān parājitya mahāsuraḥ
trailokyaṃ vaśam ānīya svarge vasati dānavaḥ
yadā varamadonmatto nyavasad dānavo divi
atha lokān samastāṃś ca vijitya sa mahābalaḥ
bhaveyam aham evendraḥ somo 'gnir māruto raviḥ
salilaṃ cāntarikṣaṃ ca nakṣatrāṇi diśo daśa
ahaṃ krodhaś ca kāmaś ca varuṇo vāsavo yamaḥ
dhanadaś ca dhanādhyakṣo yakṣaḥ kiṃpuruṣādhipaḥ
ete bhaveyam ity uktvā svayaṃ bhūtvā balāt sa ca
teṣāṃ gṛhītvā sthānāni teṣāṃ kāryāṇy avāpa saḥ
īḍyaś cāsmin makhavarair devakiṃnarasattamaiḥ
narakasthān samānīya svargasthāṃs tāṃś cakāra saḥ
evamādīni karmāṇi kṛtvā daityapatir balī
āśrameṣu mahābhāgān munīn vai saṃśitavratān
satyadharmaratān dāntān purā dharṣitavāṃś ca saḥ
yajñīyān kṛtavān daityān ayajñīyāś ca devatāḥ
yatra yatra surā jagmus tatra tatra vrajanty uta
sthānāni devatānāṃ tu hṛtvā rājyam apālayat
pañca koṭyaś ca varṣāṇi niyutāny ekaṣaṣṭi ca
ṣaṣṭiś caiva sahasrāṇāṃ jagmus tasya durātmanaḥ
etad varṣaṃ sa daityendro bhogaiśvaryam avāpa saḥ
tenāti bādhyamānās te daityendreṇa balīyasā
brahmalokaṃ surā jagmuḥ sarve śakrapurogamāḥ
devāḥ
pitāmahaṃ samāsādya khinnāḥ prāñjalayo 'bruvan
bhagavan bhūtabhavyeśa nas trāyasva ihāgatān
bhayaṃ ditisutād ghoraṃ bhavaty adya divāniśam
bhagavan sarvabhūtānāṃ svayaṃbhūr ādikṛd vibhuḥ
brahmā
sraṣṭā tvaṃ havyakavyānām avyaktaḥ prakṛtir dhruvaḥ
śrūyatām āpad evaṃ hi durvijñeyaṃ mayāpi ca
nārāyaṇas tu puruṣo viśvarūpo mahādyutiḥ
avyaktaḥ sarvabhūtānām acintyo vibhur avyayaḥ
mamāpi sa tu yuṣmākaṃ vyasane paramā gatiḥ
nārāyaṇaḥ paro 'vyaktād aham avyaktasaṃbhavaḥ
matto jajñuḥ prajā lokāḥ sarvadevāsurāś ca te
devā yathāhaṃ yuṣmākaṃ tathā nārāyaṇo mama
pitāmaho 'haṃ sarvasya sa viṣṇuḥ prapitāmahaḥ
niścitaṃ vibudhā daityaṃ sa viṣṇus taṃ haniṣyati
bhīṣmaḥ
tasya nāsti hy aśakyaṃ ca tasmād vrajata māciram
pitāmahavacaḥ śrutvā sarve te bharatarṣabha
vibudhā brahmaṇā sārdhaṃ jagmuḥ kṣīrodadhiṃ prati
ādityā vasavaḥ sādhyā viśve ca marutas tathā
rudrā maharṣayaś caiva aśvinau ca surūpiṇau
anye ca divyā ye rājaṃs te sarve sagaṇāḥ surāḥ
caturmukhaṃ puraskṛtya śvetadvīpam upasthitāḥ
gatvā kṣīrasamudre taṃ śāśvatīṃ paramāṃ gatim
anantaśayanaṃ devam anantaṃ dīptatejasam
śaraṇyaṃ tridaśā viṣṇum upatasthuḥ sanātanam
devaṃ brahmamayaṃ yajñaṃ brahmadevaṃ mahābalam
bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhaviṣyac ca prabhuṃ lokanamaskṛtam
devāḥ
nārāyaṇaṃ vibhuṃ devaṃ śaraṇyaṃ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ
trāyasva no 'dya deveśa hiraṇyakaśipor vadhāt
tvaṃ hi naḥ paramo dhātā brahmādīnāṃ surottama
utphullāmalapatrākṣa śatrupakṣabhayaṃkara
kṣayāya ditivaṃśasya śaraṇaṃ tvaṃ bhaviṣyasi
bhīṣmaḥ
devānāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā tadā viṣṇuḥ śuciśravāḥ
viṣṇuḥ
adṛśyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ vaktum evopacakrame
bhayaṃ tyajadhvam amarā abhayaṃ vo dadāmy aham
tad evaṃ tridivaṃ devāḥ pratipadyata māciram
eṣo 'haṃ sagaṇaṃ daityaṃ varadānena darpitam
brahmā
avadhyam amarendrāṇāṃ dānavendraṃ nihanmy aham
bhagavan bhūtabhavyeśa khinnā hy ete bhṛśaṃ surāḥ
viṣṇuḥ
tasmāt tvaṃ jahi daityendraṃ kṣipraṃ kālo 'sya mā ciram
kṣipraṃ devāḥ kariṣyāmi tvarayā daityanāśanam
tasmāt tvaṃ vibudhāś caiva pratipadyata vai divam
bhīṣmaḥ
evam uktvā tu bhagavān visṛjya tridiveśvarān
narasyārdhatanuṃ kṛtvā siṃhasyārdhatanuṃ tathā
nārasiṃhena vapuṣā pāṇiṃ niṣpiṣya pāṇinā
bhīmarūpo mahātejā vyāditāsya ivāntakaḥ
hiraṇyakaśipuṃ rājañ jagāma harir īśvaraḥ
daityās tam āgataṃ dṛṣṭvā nārasiṃhaṃ mahābalam
vavarṣuḥ śastravarṣais te susaṃkruddhās tadā harim
tair visṛṣṭāni śastrāṇi bhakṣayām āsa vai hariḥ
jaghāna ca raṇe daityān sahasrāṇi bahūny api
tān nihatya ca daityendrān sarvān kruddhān mahābalān
abhyadhāvat susaṃkruddho daityendraṃ balagarvitam
jīmūtaghanasaṃkāśo jīmūtaghananisvanaḥ
jīmūta iva dīptaujā jīmūta iva vegavān
devārir ditijo duṣṭo nṛsiṃhaṃ samupādravat
daityaṃ so 'tibalaṃ dṛṣṭvā kruddhaśārdūlavikramam
dṛptair daityagaṇair guptaṃ kharair nakhamukhair uta
tataḥ kṛtvā tu yuddhaṃ vai tena daityena vai hariḥ
saṃdhyākāle mahātejā bhavanānte tvarānvitaḥ
ūrau nidhāya daityendraṃ nirbibheda nakhair hi tam
mahābalaṃ mahāvīryaṃ varadānena darpitam
daityaśreṣṭhaṃ suraśreṣṭho jaghāna tarasā hariḥ
hiraṇyakaśipuṃ hatvā sarvān daityāṃś ca vai tadā
vibudhānāṃ prajānāṃ ca hitaṃ kṛtvā mahādyutiḥ
pramumoda harir devaḥ prāpya dharmaṃ tadā bhuvi
eṣa te nārasiṃho 'tra kathitaḥ pāṇḍunandana
bhīṣmaḥ
śṛṇu tvaṃ vāmanaṃ nāma prādurbhāvaṃ mahātmanaḥ
purā tretāyuge rājan balir vairocano 'bhavat
daityānāṃ pārthivo vīro balenāpratimo balī
tadā balir mahārāja daityasaṃghaiḥ samāvṛtaḥ
vijitya tarasā śakram indrasthānam avāpa saḥ
tena vitrāsitā devā balinākhaṇḍalādayaḥ
brahmāṇaṃ vai puraskṛtya gatvā kṣīrodadhiṃ tadā
tuṣṭuvuḥ sahitāḥ sarve devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum
teṣāṃ prasādaṃ cakre 'tha vibudhānāṃ haris tadā
prasādajaṃ tasya vibhor adityāṃ janma ucyate
aditer api putratvam etya yādavanandanaḥ
eṣa viṣṇur iti khyāta indrasyāvarajo 'bhavat
tasminn eva tu kāle tu daityendro vīryavān balī
aśvamedhaṃ kratuśreṣṭham āhartum upacakrame
vartamāne tadā yajñe daityendrasya yudhiṣṭhira
sa viṣṇur vāmano bhūtvā pracchanno brahmaveṣadhṛk
muṇḍo yajñopavītī ca kṛṣṇājinadharaḥ śikhī
palāśadaṇḍaṃ saṃgṛhya vāmano 'dbhutadarśanaḥ
praviśya sa baler yajñe vartamāne tu dakṣiṇām
dehīty uvāca daityendraṃ vikramāṃs trīn mamaiva ha
dīyatāṃ tripadīmātram ity avocan mahāsuram
sa tatheti pratiśrutya pradadau viṣṇave tadā
tena labdhvā harir bhūmiṃ jṛmbhayām āsa vai bhṛśam
sa śiśuḥ sadivaṃ khaṃ ca pṛthivīṃ ca viśāṃ pate
tribhir vikramaṇair etat sarvam ākramatābhibhūḥ
baler balavato yajñe balinā viṣṇunā purā
vikramais tribhir akṣobhyāḥ kṣobhitās te mahāsurāḥ
vipracittimukhāḥ kruddhā daityasaṃghā mahābalāḥ
nānāvaktrā mahākāyā nānāveṣadharā nṛpa
nānāpraharaṇā raudrā nānāmālyānulepanāḥ
svāny āyudhāni saṃgṛhya pradīptā iva tejasā
kramamāṇaṃ hariṃ tatra upāvartanta bhārata
pramathya sarvān daiteyān pādahastatalais tu tān
rūpaṃ kṛtvā mahābhīmaṃ jahārāśu sa medinīm
saṃprāpya divam ākāśam ādityasadane sthitaḥ
atyarocata bhūtātmā bhāskaraṃ svena tejasā
prakāśayan diśaḥ sarvāḥ pradiśaś ca mahābalaḥ
śuśubhe sa mahābāhuḥ sarvalokān prakāśayan
tasya vikramato bhūmiṃ candrādityau stanāntare
nabhaḥ prakramamāṇasya nābhyāṃ kila tadā sthitau
param ākramamāṇasya jānubhyāṃ tau vyavasthitau
viṣṇor amitavīryasya vadanty evaṃ dvijātayaḥ
athāsādya kapālaṃ sa aṇḍasya tu yudhiṣṭhira
tacchidrāt syandinī tasya pādād bhraṣṭātha nimnagā
sasāra sāgaraṃ sāśu pāvanī sāgaraṃgamā
jahāra medinīṃ sarvāṃ hatvā dānavapuṃgavān
āsurīṃ śriyam āhṛtya trīṃl lokān sa janārdanaḥ
saputradārān asurān pātāle vinyapātayat
namuciḥ śambaraś caiva prahlādaś ca mahāmanāḥ
pādapātābhinirdhūtāḥ pātāle vinipātitāḥ
mahābhūtāni bhūtātmā saviśeṣāṇi vai hariḥ
kālaṃ ca sakalaṃ rājan gātrabhūtāny adarśayat
tasya gātre jagat sarvam ānītam iva dṛśyate
na kiṃ cid asti lokeṣu yad anāptaṃ mahātmanā
tad dhi rūpam upendrasya devadānavamānavāḥ
dṛṣṭvā taṃ mumuhuḥ sarve viṣṇutejobhipīḍitāḥ
balir baddho 'bhimānī ca yajñavāṭe mahātmanā
virocanakulaṃ sarvaṃ pātāle vinipātitam
evaṃvidhāni karmāṇi kṛtvā garuḍavāhanaḥ
na vismayam upāgacchat pārameṣṭhyena tejasā
sa sarvam amaraiśvaryaṃ saṃpradāya śacīpateḥ
trailokyaṃ ca dadau śakre viṣṇur dānavasūdanaḥ
eṣa te vāmano nāma prādurbhāvo mahātmanaḥ
vedavidbhir dvijair etat kathyate vaiṣṇavaṃ yaśaḥ
bhīṣmaḥ
mānuṣeṣu yathā viṣṇoḥ prādurbhāvaṃ tathā śṛṇu
viṣṇoḥ punar mahārāja prādurbhāvo mahātmanaḥ
dattātreya iti khyāta ṛṣir āsīn mahāyaśāḥ
tena naṣṭeṣu vedeṣu kriyāsu ca makheṣu ca
cāturvarṇye ca saṃkīrṇe dharme śithilatāṃ gate
abhivardhati cādharme satye naṣṭe sthite 'nṛte
prajāsu kṣīyamāṇāsu dharme cākulatāṃ gate
sayajñāḥ sakriyā vedāḥ pratyānītāś ca tena vai
cāturvarṇyam asaṃkīrṇaṃ kṛtaṃ tena mahātmanā
sa eṣa vai yadā prādād dhehayādhipater varam
taṃ hehayānām adhipas tv arjuno 'bhiprasādayan
vane paryacarat samyak śuśrūṣur anasūyakaḥ
nirmamo nirahaṃkāro dīrghakālam atoṣayat
ārādhya dattātreyaṃ hi agṛhṇāt sa varān imān
āptād āptatarād viprād vidvān vidvanniṣevitān
ṛte 'maratvād vipreṇa dattātreyeṇa dhīmatā
varaiś caturbhiḥ pravṛta imāṃs tatrābhyanandata
śrīmān manasvī balavān satyavāg anasūyakaḥ
sahasrabāhur bhūyāsam eṣa me prathamo varaḥ
jarāyujāṇḍajaṃ sarvaṃ sarvaṃ caiva carācaram
prāśāstum icche dharmeṇa dvitīyas tv eṣa me varaḥ
pitṝn devān ṛṣīn viprān yajeyaṃ vipulair makhaiḥ
amitrān niśitair bāṇair ghātayeyaṃ raṇājire
dattātreyeha bhagavaṃs tṛtīyo vara eṣa me
yasya nāsīn na bhavitā na cāsti sadṛśaḥ pumān
iha vā divi vā loke sa me hantā bhaved iti
so 'rjunaḥ kṛtavīryasya varaḥ putro 'bhavad yudhi
sa sahasraṃ sahasrāṇāṃ māhiṣmatyām avardhata
sa bhūmim akhilāṃ jitvā dvīpāṃś cāpi samudriṇaḥ
nabhasīva jvalan sūryaḥ puṇyaiḥ karmabhir arjunaḥ
indradvīpaṃ kaśeruṃ ca tāmradvīpaṃ gabhastimat
gāndharvaṃ vāruṇaṃ dvīpaṃ saumyārṣam iti ca prabhuḥ
pūrvair ajitapūrvāṃś ca dvīpān ajayad arjunaḥ
sauvarṇaṃ sarvam apy āsīd vimānavaram uttamam
caturdhā vyabhajad rāṣṭraṃ tad vibhajyānvapālayat
ekāṃśenāharat senām ekāṃśenāvasad gṛhān
yas tu tasya tṛtīyāṃśo rājāsīj janasaṃgrahe
āptaḥ paramakalyāṇas tena yajñān akalpayat
ye dasyavo grāmacarā araṇye ca vasanti ye
caturthena ca so 'ṃśena tān sarvān pratyaṣedhayat
sarvebhyaś cāntavāsibhyaḥ kārtavīryo 'harad balim
āhṛtaṃ svabalair yat tad arjunasyāvamanyate
kāko vā mūṣiko vāpi taṃ tam eva nyabarhayat
dvārāṇi nāpidhīyante rāṣṭreṣu nagareṣu ca
sa eva rāṣṭrapālo 'bhūt strīpālo 'bhavad arjunaḥ
sa evāsīd ajāpālaḥ sa gopālo viśāṃ pate
sarvāṇy eva manuṣyāṇāṃ rājā kṣetrāṇi rakṣati
idaṃ tu kārtavīryasya babhūvāsadṛśaṃ janaiḥ
na pūrve nāpare tasya gamiṣyanti gatiṃ nṛpāḥ
yad arṇave prayātasya vastraṃ na pariṣicyate
śataṃ varṣasahasrāṇām anuśiṣyārjuno mahīm
dattātreyaprasādena evaṃ rājyaṃ cakāra saḥ
evaṃ bahūni karmāṇi cakre lokahitāya saḥ
dattātreya iti khyātaḥ prādurbhāvas tu vaiṣṇavaḥ
bhīṣmaḥ
kathito bharataśreṣṭha śṛṇu bhūyo mahātmanaḥ
yadā bhṛgukule janma yadarthaṃ ca mahātmanaḥ
jāmadagnya iti khyātaḥ prādurbhāvas tu vaiṣṇavaḥ
jamadagneḥ suto rājan rāmo nāma sa vīryavān
hehayāntakaro rājan sa rāmo balināṃ varaḥ
kārtavīryo mahāvīryo balenāpratimas tathā
rāmeṇa jāmadagnyena hato viṣamam ācaran
taṃ kārtavīryaṃ rājānaṃ hehayānām ariṃdamam
rathasthaṃ pārthivaṃ rāmaḥ pātayitvāvadhīd raṇe
jambhasya yajñahantā sa ṛtvijaṃ caiva saṃstare
jambhasya mūrdhni bhettā ca hantā ca śatadundubheḥ
sa eṣa kṛṣṇo govindo jāto bhṛguṣu vīryavān
sahasrabāhum uddhartuṃ sahasrajitam āhave
kṣatriyāṇāṃ catuḥṣaṣṭim ayutāni mahāyaśāḥ
sarasvatyāṃ sametāni eṣa vai dhanuṣājayat
brahmadviṣāṃ vadhe tasmin sahasrāṇi caturdaśa
punar jagrāha śūrāṇām antaṃ cakre nararṣabhaḥ
tato daśasahasrasya bhaṅktvā pūrvam ariṃdamaḥ
sahasraṃ musalenāghnan sahasram udakṛntata
caturdaśa sahasrāṇi kaṇadhūmam apāyayat
śiṣṭān brahmadviṣo jitvā tato 'snāyata bhārgavaḥ
rāma rāmety abhikruṣṭo brāhmaṇaiḥ kṣatriyārditaiḥ
nyaghnad daśa sahasrāṇi rāmaḥ paraśunābhibhūḥ
na hy amṛṣyata tāṃ vācam ārtair bhṛśam udīritām
bhṛgo rāmābhidhāveti yadākrandan dvijātayaḥ
kāśmīrān daradān kuntīn kṣudrakān mālavāñ śakān
cedikāśikarūśāṃś ca ṛṣīkān krathakaiśikān
aṅgān vaṅgān kaliṅgāṃś ca māgadhān kāśikosalān
rātrāyaṇān vītihotrān kirātān mārttikāvatān
etān anyāṃś ca rājendrān deśe deśe sahasraśaḥ
nikṛtya niśitair bāṇaiḥ saṃpradāya vivasvate
kīrṇā kṣatriyakoṭībhir merumandarabhūṣaṇā
triḥsaptakṛtvaḥ pṛthivī tena niḥkṣatriyā kṛtā
kṛtvā niḥkṣatriyāṃ caiva bhārgavaḥ sa mahāyaśāḥ
indragopakavarṇasya jīvaṃjīvanibhasya ca
pūrayām āsa saritaḥ kṣatajasya sarāṃsi ca
cakāra tarpaṇaṃ vīraḥ pitṝṇāṃ tāsu teṣu ca
sarvān aṣṭādaśa dvīpān vaśam ānīya bhārgavaḥ
so 'śvamedhasahasrāṇi naramedhaśatāni ca
iṣṭvā sāgaraparyantāṃ kāśyapāya mahīṃ dadau
tasyāgreṇānuparyeti bhūmiṃ kṛtvā vipāṃsulām
tataḥ kālakṛtāṃ satyāṃ bhārgavāya mahātmane
gāthām apy atra gāyanti ye purāṇavido janāḥ
vedim aṣṭādaśotsedhāṃ hiraṇyasyātipauruṣīm
rāmasya jāmadagnyasya pratijagrāha kāśyapaḥ
evam iṣṭvā mahābāhuḥ kratubhir bhūridakṣiṇaiḥ
anyad varṣaśataṃ rāmaḥ saubhe sālvam ayodhayat
tataḥ sa bhṛguśārdūlas taṃ saubhaṃ yodhayan prabhuḥ
subandhuraṃ rathaṃ rājann āsthāya bharatarṣabha
nagnikānāṃ kumārīṇāṃ gāyantīnām upāśṛṇot
rāma rāma mahābāho bhṛgūṇāṃ kīrtivardhana
tyaja śastrāṇi sarvāṇi na tvaṃ saubhaṃ vadhiṣyasi
cakrahasto gadāpāṇir bhītānām abhayaṃkaraḥ
yudhi pradyumnasāmbābhyāṃ kṛṣṇaḥ saubhaṃ vadhiṣyati
tac chrutvā puruṣavyāghras tata eva vanaṃ yayau
nyasya sarvāṇi śastrāṇi kālakāṅkṣī mahāyaśāḥ
rathaṃ varmāyudhaṃ caiva śarān paraśum eva ca
dhanūṃṣy apsu pratiṣṭhāpya rāmas tepe paraṃ tapaḥ
hriyaṃ prajñāṃ śriyaṃ kīrtiṃ lakṣmīṃ cāmitrakarśanaḥ
pañcādhiṣṭhāya dharmātmā taṃ rathaṃ visasarja ha
ādikāle pravṛttaṃ hi vibhajan kālam īśvaraḥ
nāhanac chraddhayā saubhaṃ na hy aśakto mahāyaśāḥ
jāmadagnya iti khyāto yas tv asau bhagavān ṛṣiḥ
bhīṣmaḥ
so 'sya bhāgas tapas tepe bhārgavo lokaviśrutaḥ
śṛṇu rājaṃs tathā viṣṇoḥ prādurbhāvaṃ mahātmanaḥ
caturviṃśe yuge cāpi mārkaṇḍeyapuraḥsaraḥ
tithau nāvamike jajñe tathā daśarathād api
kṛtvātmānaṃ mahābāhuś caturdhā viṣṇur avyayaḥ
loke rāma iti khyātas tejasā bhāskaropamaḥ
prasādhanārthaṃ lokasya viṣṇus tasya sanātanaḥ
dharmārtham eva kaunteya jajñe tatra mahāyaśāḥ
tam apy āhur manuṣyendraṃ sarvabhūtapates tanum
yajñavighnaṃ tadā kṛtvā viśvāmitrasya bhārata
subāhur nihatahas tena mārīcas tāḍito bhṛśam
tasmai dattāni śastrāṇi viśvāmitreṇa dhīmatā
vadhārthaṃ devaśatrūṇāṃ durvārāṇi surair api
vartamāne tadā yajñe janakasya mahātmanaḥ
bhagnaṃ māheśvaraṃ cāpaṃ krīḍatā līlayā param
tato vivāhaṃ sītāyāḥ kṛtvā sa raghuvallabhaḥ
nagarīṃ punar āsādya mumude tatra sītayā
kasya cit tv atha kālasya pitrā tatrābhicoditaḥ
kaikeyyāḥ priyam anvicchan vanam abhyavapadyata
yaḥ samāḥ sarvadharmajñaś caturdaśa vane vasan
lakṣmaṇānucaro rāmaḥ sarvabhūtahite rataḥ
caturdaśa vane taptvā tapo varṣāṇi bhārata
rūpiṇī yasya pārśvasthā sītety abhihitā janaiḥ
pūrvocitatvāt sā lakṣmīr bhartāram anugacchati
janasthāne vasan kāryaṃ tridaśānāṃ cakāra saḥ
mārīcaṃ dūṣaṇaṃ hatvā kharaṃ triśirasaṃ tathā
caturdaśa sahasrāṇi rakṣasāṃ ghorakarmaṇām
jaghāna rāmo dharmātmā prajānāṃ hitakāmyayā
virādhaṃ ca kabandhaṃ ca rākṣasau krūrakarmiṇau
jaghāna ca tadā rāmo gandharvau śāpavikṣatau
sa rāvaṇasya bhaginīnāsācchedaṃ ca kārayat
bhāryāviyogaṃ taṃ prāpya mṛgayan vyacarad vanam
tatas tam ṛśyamūkaṃ sa gatvā pampām atītya ca
sugrīvaṃ mārutiṃ dṛṣṭvā cakre maitrīṃ tayoḥ sa vai
atha gatvā sa kiṣkindhāṃ sugrīveṇa tadā saha
nihatya vālinaṃ yuddhe vānarendraṃ mahābalam
abhyaṣiñcat tadā rāmaḥ sugrīvaṃ vānareśvaram
tataḥ sa vīryavān rājaṃs tvarayan vai samutsukaḥ
vicitya vāyuputreṇa laṅkādeśaṃ niveditam
setuṃ baddhvā samudrasya vānaraiḥ sahitas tadā
sītāyāḥ padam anvicchan rāmo laṅkāṃ viveśa ha
devoragagaṇānāṃ hi yakṣarākṣasapakṣiṇām
tatrāvadhyaṃ rākṣasendraṃ rāvaṇaṃ yudhi durjayam
yuktaṃ rākṣasakoṭībhir bhinnāñjanacayopamam
durnirīkṣyaṃ suragaṇair varadānena darpitam
jaghāna sacivaiḥ sārdhaṃ sānvayaṃ rāvaṇaṃ raṇe
trailokyakaṇṭakaṃ vīraṃ mahākāyaṃ mahābalam
rāvaṇaṃ sagaṇaṃ hatvā rāmo bhūtapatiḥ purā
laṅkāyāṃ taṃ mahātmānaṃ rākṣasendraṃ vibhīṣaṇam
abhiṣicya ca tatraiva amaratvaṃ dadau tadā
āruhya puṣpakaṃ rāmaḥ sītām ādāya pāṇḍava
sabalaḥ svapuraṃ gatvā dharmarājyam apālayat
dānavo lavaṇo nāma madhoḥ putro mahābalaḥ
śatrughnena hato rājaṃs tato rāmasya śāsanāt
evaṃ bahūni karmāṇi kṛtvā lokahitāya saḥ
rājyaṃ cakāra vidhivad rāmo dharmabhṛtāṃ varaḥ
daśāśvamedhān ājahre jyotirukthyān ahargaṇān
nāśrūyantāśubhā vāco nātyayaḥ prāṇināṃ tadā
na vittajaṃ bhayaṃ cāsīd rāme rājyaṃ praśāsati
prāṇināṃ ca bhayaṃ nāsīj jalānalavidhānajam
paryadevan na vidhavā nānāthāḥ kāś canābhavan
sarvam āsīt tadā tṛptaṃ rāme rājyaṃ praśāsati
na saṃkarakarā varṇā na kṛṣṭakarakṛj janaḥ
na ca sma vṛddhā bālānāṃ pretakāryāṇi kurvate
viśaḥ paryacaran kṣatraṃ kṣatraṃ nāpīḍayad viśaḥ
narā nātyacaran bhāryā bhāryā nātyacaran patīn
nāsīd alpakṛṣir loke rāme rājyaṃ praśāsati
āsan varṣasahasrāṇi tathā putrasahasriṇaḥ
arogāḥ prāṇino 'py āsan rāme rājyaṃ praśāsati
ṛṣīṇāṃ devatānāṃ ca manuṣyāṇāṃ tathaiva ca
pṛthivyāṃ sahavāso 'bhūd rāme rājyaṃ praśāsati
sarve hy āsaṃs tṛptarūpās tadā tasmin viśāṃ pate
dharmeṇa pṛthivīṃ sarvām anuśāsati bhūmipe
tapasy evābhavan sarve sarve dharmam anuvratāḥ
pṛthivyāṃ dhārmike tasmin rāme rājyaṃ praśāsati
nādharmiṣṭho naraḥ kaś cid babhūva prāṇināṃ kva cit
prāṇāpānau samāv āstāṃ rāme rājyaṃ praśāsati
gāthām apy atra gāyanti ye purāṇavido janāḥ
śyāmo yuvā lohitākṣo mātaṅgānām ivarṣabhaḥ
ājānubāhuḥ sumukhaḥ siṃhaskandho mahābalaḥ
daśa varṣasahasrāṇi daśa varṣaśatāni ca
rājyaṃ bhogaṃ ca saṃprāpya śaśāsa pṛthivīm imām
rāmo rāmo rāma iti prajānām abhavan kathāḥ
rāmabhūtaṃ jagad idaṃ rāme rājyaṃ praśāsati
ṛgyajuḥsāmahīnāś ca na tadāsan dvijātayaḥ

pūrvāpakāriṇaṃ saṃkhye paulastyaṃ manujarṣabhaḥ
devagandharvanāgānām ariṃ sa nijaghāna ha
sattvavān guṇasaṃpanno dīpyamānaḥ svatejasā
evam eva mahābāhur ikṣvākukulavardhanaḥ
rāvaṇaṃ sagaṇaṃ hatvā divam ākramatābhibhūḥ
iti dāśaratheḥ khyātaḥ prādurbhāvo mahātmanaḥ
tataḥ kṛṣṇo mahābāhur bhītānām abhayaṃkaraḥ
aṣṭāviṃśe yuge rājañ jajñe śrīvatsalakṣaṇaḥ
peśalaś ca vadānyaś ca loke bahumato nṛṣu
smṛtimān deśakālajñaḥ śaṅkhacakragadāsidhṛk
vāsudeva iti khyāto lokānāṃ hitakṛt sadā
vṛṣṇīnāṃ ca kule jāto bhūmeḥ priyacikīrṣayā
sa nṛṇām abhayaṃ dātā madhuheti sa viśrutaḥ
sa śakrārjunarāmāṇāṃ kila sthānāny asūdayat
kaṃsādīn nijaghānājau daityān mānuṣavigrahān
ayaṃ lokahitārthāya prādurbhāvo mahātmanaḥ
kalkī viṣṇuyaśā nāma bhūyaś cotpatsyate hariḥ
kaler yugānte saṃprāpte dharme śithilatāṃ gate
pāṣaṇḍināṃ gaṇānāṃ hi vadhārthaṃ bharatarṣabha
dharmasya ca vivṛddhyarthaṃ viprāṇāṃ hitakāmyayā
ete cānye ca bahavo divyā devagaṇair yutāḥ
vaiśaṃpāyanaḥ
prādurbhāvāḥ purāṇeṣu gīyante brahmavādibhiḥ
evam ukto 'tha kaunteyas tataḥ pauravanandanaḥ

ābabhāṣe punar bhīṣmaṃ dharmarājo yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
bhūya eva manuṣyendra upendrasya yaśasvinaḥ
janma vṛṣṇiṣu vijñātum icchāmi vadatāṃ vara
yathaiva bhagavāñ jātaḥ kṣitāv iha janārdanaḥ

yadarthaṃ ca mahātejā gās tu govṛṣabhekṣaṇaḥ

tadā matimatāṃ śreṣṭha tan me brūhi pitāmaha
evam uktas tato bhīṣmaḥ keśavasya mahātmanaḥ
bhīṣmaḥ
mādhaveṣu tadā janma kathayām āsa vīryavān
hanta te kathayiṣyāmi yudhiṣṭhira yathātatham
yato nārāyaṇasyeha janma vṛṣṇiṣu kaurava
purā loke mahārāja vartamāne kṛte yuge
āsīt trailokyavikhyātaḥ saṃgrāmas tārakāmayaḥ
virocano mayas tāro varāhaḥ śveta eva ca
lambaḥ kiśoraḥ svarbhānur ariṣṭo 'tha kṣaraś ca vai
vipracittiḥ pralambaś ca vṛtrajambhabalādayaḥ
namuciḥ kālanemiś ca prahlāda iti viśrutaḥ
ete cānye ca bahavo daityasaṃghāḥ sahasraśaḥ
nānāśastradharā rājan nānābhūṣaṇavāhanāḥ
devatānām abhimukhās tasthur daiteyadānavāḥ
devās tu yudhyamānās te dānavān abhyayū raṇe
ādityā vasavo rudrāḥ sādhyā viśve marudgaṇāḥ
indro yamaś ca candraś ca varuṇo 'tha dhaneśvaraḥ
aśvinau ca mahāvīryau ye cānye devatāgaṇāḥ
cakrur yuddhaṃ mahāghoraṃ dānavaiś ca yathākramam
yudhyamānāḥ sameyuś ca devā daiteyadānavaiḥ
tad yuddham abhavad ghoraṃ devadānavasaṃkulam
tābhyāṃ balābhyāṃ saṃjajñe tumulo vigrahas tadā
tīkṣṇaiḥ śastraiḥ kiranto 'tha abhyayur devadānavāḥ
aghnan devān sagandharvān sayakṣoragacāraṇān
te vadhyamānā daiteyair devasaṃghās tadā raṇe
dudruvuḥ saṃpariśrāntāḥ kṣīṇapraharaṇā raṇe
trātāraṃ manasā jagmur devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum
etasminn antare tatra jagāma harir īśvaraḥ
dīpayañ jyotiṣā bhūmiṃ śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ
tam āgataṃ suparṇasthaṃ viṣṇuṃ lokanamaskṛtam
dṛṣṭvā mudā yutāḥ sarve bhayaṃ tyaktvā raṇe surāḥ
cakrur yuddhaṃ punaḥ sarve devā daiteyadānavaiḥ
tad yuddham abhavad ghoram acintyaṃ romaharṣaṇam
jaghnur daityān raṇe devāḥ sarve śakrapurogamāḥ
te vadhyamānā vibudhair dudruvur daityadānavāḥ
vidrutān dānavān dṛṣṭvā tadā bhārata saṃyuge
kālanemir iti khyāto dānavaḥ pratyadṛśyata
śatapraharaṇo ghoraḥ śatabāhuḥ śatānanaḥ
śataśīrṣaḥ sthitaḥ śrīmāñ śataśṛṅga ivācalaḥ
bhāskarākāramukuṭaḥ śiñjitābharaṇāṅgadaḥ
dhūmrakeśo hariśmaśrur nirdaṣṭhoṣṭhapuṭānanaḥ
trailokyāntaravistāraṃ dhārayan vipulaṃ vapuḥ
tarjayan vai raṇe devāñ chādayan sa diśo daśa
abhyadhāvat susaṃkruddho vyāditāsya ivāntakaḥ
tataḥ śastraprapātaiś ca devān dharṣitavān raṇe
athābhyayuḥ surān sarvān punas te daityadānavāḥ
āpīḍayan raṇe kruddhās tato devān yudhiṣṭhira
te vadhyamānā vibudhāḥ samare kālaneminā
daityaiś caiva mahārāja dudruvuḥ sahitā diśaḥ
vidrutān vibudhān dṛṣṭvā kālanemir mahāsuraḥ
indraṃ yamāgnivaruṇān vāyuṃ ca dhanadaṃ ravim
etāṃś cānyān balāj jitvā teṣāṃ kāryāṇy avāpa saḥ
tān sarvāṃs tarasā jitvā kālanemir mahāsuraḥ
dadarśa gagane viṣṇuṃ suparṇasthaṃ mahādyutim
taṃ dṛṣṭvā krodhatāmrākṣas tarjayann abhyayāt tadā
sa bāhuśatam udyamya sarvāstragrahaṇaṃ raṇe
roṣād bhārata daityendro viṣṇor urasi pātayat
daityāś ca dānavāś caiva sarve mayapurogamāḥ
svāny āyudhāni saṃgṛhya sarve viṣṇum atāḍayan
sa tāḍyamāno 'tibalair daityaiḥ sarvāyudhodyataiḥ
na cacāla harir yuddhe 'kampyamāna ivācalaḥ
punar udyamya saṃkruddhaḥ kālanemir dṛḍhāṃ gadām
jaghāna saṃyuge rājan sa viṣṇuṃ garuḍaṃ ca vai
sa dṛṣṭvā garuḍaṃ śrāntaṃ cakram udyamya vai hariḥ
śataṃ śirāṃsi bāhūṃś ca so 'cchinat kālaneminaḥ
jaghānānyāṃś ca tān sarvān samare daityadānavān
tasmin rājan raṇe daityās traya eva viniḥsṛtāḥ
virocano mayaś caiva svarbhānuś ca mahāsuraḥ
sarvān aśeṣān hatvā tu viṣṇur vai daityadānavān
vibudhānām ṛṣīṇāṃ ca svāni sthānāni vai dadau
dattvā surāṇāṃ suprītiṃ prāpya sarvāṇi bhārata
jagāma brahmaṇā sārdhaṃ brahmalokaṃ tadā hariḥ
brahmalokaṃ praviśyātha tatra nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ
paurāṇāṃ guhyasadanaṃ divyaṃ nārāyaṇāśramam
saṃpraviśya tadā devaḥ stūyamāno maharṣibhiḥ
sahasraśīrṣo bhūtvātha śayanāyopacakrame
ādidevaḥ purāṇātmā nidrāvaśam upāgataḥ
śete sukhaṃ sadā viṣṇur mohayañ jagad avyayaḥ
jagmus tasyātha varṣāṇi śayānasya mahātmanaḥ
ṣaṭtriṃśacchatasāhasraṃ mānuṣeṇeha saṃkhyayā
tataḥ kṛtayugatretādvāparānte bubodha saḥ
brahmādibhiḥ suraiś cāpi stūyamāno maharṣibhiḥ
utplutya śayanād viṣṇur brahmaṇā vibudhaiḥ saha
devānāṃ ca hitārthāya yayau devasabhāṃ prati
meroḥ śikharavinyastāṃ jvalantīṃ tāṃ śubhāṃ sabhām
viviśus tāṃ surāḥ sarve brahmaṇā saha bhārata
jagmus tatra niṣedus te sā niḥśabdam abhūt tadā
bhūmiḥ

pure pure ca nṛpatiḥ koṭisaṃkhyair balair vṛtaḥ

yadā divi vibhus tāta na reme bhagavān asau

gandharvāpsarasaś caiva rudrādityāṃs tathāśvinau
jāyadhvaṃ mānuṣe loke sarvabhūtamaheśvarāḥ
jaṅgamāni viśālākṣo hy ātmānaṃ hy ātmanāsṛjat
jāyatām iti govindas tiryagyonigatair api
tāni sarvāṇi sarvajñaḥ sasurāṇi sureśvaraḥ
ta evam uktāḥ kṛṣṇena sarva eva divaukasaḥ
daityadānavahantāraḥ saṃbhūtā bhuvaneśvarāḥ
yayātivaṃśajasyātha vasudevasya dhīmataḥ

sāgarāḥ samakampanta mudā celuś ca parvatāḥ
jajvaluś cāgnayaḥ śāntā jāyamāne janārdane
śivāḥ saṃpravavur vātāḥ praśāntam abhavad rajaḥ
jyotīṃṣi saṃprakāśante jāyamāne janārdane
devadundubhayaś cāpi sasvanur bhṛśam ambare
abhyavarṣat tadāgamya nāradaḥ puṣpavṛṣṭibhiḥ
gīrbhir maṅgalayuktābhir astuvan madhusūdanam
upatasthus tadā prītāḥ prādurbhāve maharṣayaḥ
tatas tān abhisaṃprekṣya nāradapramukhān ṛṣīn
upānṛtyann upajagur gandharvāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ
upatasthe ca govindaṃ sahasrākṣaḥ śacīpatiḥ
abhyabhāṣata tejasvī maharṣīn pūjayaṃs tadā
kṛtyāni devakāryāṇi kṛtvā lokahitāya ca
svaṃ lokaṃ lokakṛd devaḥ punar gacchati tejasā
ity uktvā munibhiḥ sārdhaṃ jagāma tridiveśvaraḥ
abhyanujñāya tān sarvāñ chādayan prakṛtiṃ parām
nandagopakule kṛṣṇa uṣitvā bahulāḥ samāḥ
vasudevas tato jātaṃ bālam ādityasaṃnibham
nandagopakule rājan bhayāt pracchādayad dharim
tataḥ kadācit suptaṃ taṃ śakaṭasya tv adhaḥ śiśum
yaśodā saṃparityajya jagāma yamunāṃ nadīm
śiśulīlāṃ tataḥ kurvan svahastacaraṇau kṣipan
ruroda madhuraṃ kṛṣṇaḥ pādāv ūrdhvaṃ prasārayan
pādāṅguṣṭhena śakaṭaṃ dhārayann atha keśavaḥ
tatrāthaikena pādena pātayitvā tadā śiśuḥ
nyubjaṃ payodharākāṅkṣī cakāra ca ruroda ca
pātitaṃ śakaṭaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhinnabhāṇḍaghaṭīghaṭam
janās te śiśunā tena vismayaṃ paramaṃ yayuḥ
pratyakṣaṃ śūrasenānāṃ dṛśyate mahad adbhutam
śayānena hataḥ pakṣī śiśunā tigmatejasā
pūtanā cāpi nihatā mahākāyā mahāstanī
paśyatāṃ sarvadevānāṃ vāsudevena bhārata
tataḥ kāle mahārāja saṃsaktau rāmakeśavau
kṛṣṇaḥ saṃkarṣaṇaś cobhau riṅkhiṇau samapadyatām
anyonyakiraṇagrastau candrasūryāv ivāmbare
visarpayetāṃ sarvatra sarpabhogabhujau tadā
rejatuḥ pāṃsudigdhāṅgau rāmakṛṣṇau tadā nṛpa
kva cic ca jānubhiḥ spṛṣṭau krīḍamānau kva cid vane
pibantau dadhikulyāś ca mathyamāne ca bhārata
tataḥ sa bālo govindo navanītaṃ tadākṣayam
grasamānas tu tatrātha gopībhir dadṛśe 'tha vai
dāmnātholūkhale kṛṣṇo gopastrībhiś ca bandhitaḥ
tadātha śiśunā tena rājaṃs tāv arjunāv ubhau
samūlaviṭapau bhagnau tad adbhutam ivābhavat
tatas tau bālyam uttīrṇau kṛṣṇasaṃkarṣaṇāv ubhau
tasminn eva vrajasthāne saptavarṣau babhūvatuḥ
nīlapītāmbaradharau pītaśvetānulepanau
babhūvatur vatsapālau kākapakṣadharāv ubhau
parṇavādyaṃ śrutisukhaṃ vādayantau varānanau
śuśubhāte vanagatāv udīrṇāv iva pannagau
mayūrāṅgajakarṇau tau pallavāpīḍadhāriṇau
vanamālāparikṣiptau sālapotāv ivodgatau
aravindakṛtāpīḍau rajjuyajñopavītinau
śikyatumbadharau vīrau gopaveṇupravādakau
kva cid dhasantāv anyonyaṃ krīḍamānau kva cid vane
parṇaśayyāsu saṃsuptau kva cin nidrāntaraiṣiṇau
tau vatsān pālayantau hi śobhayantau mahad vanam
cañcūryantau ramantau sma rājann evaṃ tadā śubhau
tato vṛndāvanaṃ gatvā vasudevasutāv ubhau
bhīṣmaḥ
govrajaṃ tatra kaunteya cārayantau vijahratuḥ
tataḥ kadā cid govindo jyeṣṭhaṃ saṃkarṣaṇaṃ vinā
cacāra tad vanaṃ ramyaṃ ramyarūpo varānanaḥ
kākapakṣadharaḥ śrīmāñ śyāmaḥ padmanibhekṣaṇaḥ
śrīvatsenorasā yuktaḥ śaśāṅka iva lakṣmaṇā
rajjuyajñopavītī sa pītāmbaradharo yuvā
śvetagandhena liptāṅgo nīlakuñcitamūrdhajaḥ
rājatā barhipatreṇa mandamārutakampinā
kva cid gāyan kva cit krīḍan kva cin nṛtyan kva cid dhasan
gopaveṇuṃ sa madhuraṃ kāmaṃ tad api vādayan
prahlādanārthaṃ tu gavāṃ kva cid vanagato yuvā
gokule meghakāle tu cacāra dyutimān prabhuḥ
bahuramyeṣu deśeṣu vanasya vanarājiṣu
tāsu kṛṣṇo mudaṃ lebhe krīḍayā bharatarṣabha
sa kadā cid vane tasmin gobhiḥ saha parivrajan
bhāṇḍīraṃ nāma dṛṣṭvātha nyagrodhaṃ keśavo mahān
tasya chāyānivāsāya matiṃ cakre tadā prabhuḥ
sa tatra vayasā tulyair vatsapālaiḥ sahānagha
reme sa divasān kṛṣṇaḥ purā svargapure yathā
taṃ krīḍamānaṃ gopālāḥ kṛṣṇaṃ bhāṇḍīravāsinaḥ
ramayanti sma bahavo mānyaiḥ krīḍanakais tadā
anye sma parigāyanti gopā muditamānasāḥ
gopālāḥ kṛṣṇam evānye gāyanti sma vanapriyāḥ
teṣāṃ sa gāyatām eva vādayām āsa keśavaḥ
parṇavādyāntare veṇuṃ tumbavīṇāṃ ca tatra vai
evaṃ krīḍāntaraiḥ kṛṣṇo gopālair vijahāra saḥ
tena bālena kaunteya kṛtaṃ lokahitaṃ tadā
paśyatāṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ vāsudevena bhārata
hrade nīpavane tatra krīḍitaṃ nāgamūrdhani
śāsayitvā tu kālīyaṃ sarvalokasya paśyataḥ
vijahāra tataḥ kṛṣṇo baladevasahāyavān
dhenuko dāruṇo daityo rājan rāsabhavigrahaḥ
tadā tālavane rājan baladevena vai hataḥ
tataḥ kadā cit kaunteya rāmakṛṣṇau vanaṃ gatau
cārayantau pravṛddhāni godhanāni śubhānanau
viharantau mudā yuktau vīkṣamāṇau vanāni vai
kṣvelayantau pragāyantau vicinvantau ca pādapān
nāmabhir vyāharantau ca vatsān gāś ca paraṃtapau
ceratur lokasiddhābhiḥ krīḍābhir aparājitau
tau devau mānuṣīṃ dīkṣāṃ vahantau surapūjitau
tajjātiguṇayuktābhiḥ krīḍābhiś ceratur vanam
tataḥ kṛṣṇo mahātejās tadā gatvā tu govrajam
giriyajñaṃ tam evaiṣa prakṛtaṃ gopadārakaiḥ
bubhuje pāyasaṃ śaurir īśvaraḥ sarvabhūtakṛt
taṃ dṛṣṭvā gopakāḥ sarve kṛṣṇam eva samarcayan
pūjyamānas tato gopair divyaṃ vapur adhārayat
dhṛto govardhano nāma saptāhaṃ parvatas tadā
śiśunā vāsudevena gavārtham arimardana
krīḍamānas tadā kṛṣṇaḥ kṛtavān karma duṣkaram
tad adbhutam ivātrāsīt sarvalokasya bhārata
devadevaḥ kṣitiṃ gatvā kṛṣṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā mudānvitaḥ
