ity uktvāśliṣya govindaṃ puruhūto 'bhyayād divam
athāriṣṭa iti khyātaṃ daityaṃ vṛṣabhavigraham
jaghāna tarasā kṛṣṇaḥ paśūnāṃ hitakāmyayā
keśinaṃ nāma daiteyaṃ rājan vai hayavigraham
tathā vanagataṃ pārtha gajāyutabalaṃ hayam
pragṛhya bhojaputrasya jaghāna puruṣottamaḥ
āndhraṃ mallaṃ ca cāṇūraṃ nijaghāna mahāsuram
sunāmānam amitraghnaḥ sarvasainyapuraskṛtam
mṛgarūpeṇa govindaṃ trāsayām āsa bhārata
baladevena cāyatnāt samāje muṣṭiko hataḥ
trāsitaś ca tadā kaṃsaḥ sa hi kṛṣṇena bhārata
airāvataṃ yuyutsantaṃ mātaṅgānām ivarṣabham
kṛṣṇaḥ kuvalayāpīḍaṃ hatavāṃs tasya paśyataḥ
hatvā kaṃsam amitraghnaḥ sarveṣāṃ paśyatāṃ tadā
abhiṣicyograsenaṃ taṃ pitroḥ pādam avandata
evamādīni karmāṇi kṛtavān vai janārdanaḥ
bhīṣmaḥ
evaṃ bālye 'pi gopālaiḥ krīḍābhis tau vijahratuḥ
tatas tau jagmatus tāta guruṃ sāndīpaniṃ punaḥ
guruśuśrūṣayā yuktau dharmajñau dharmacāriṇau
vratam ugraṃ mahātmānau vicarantāv avantiṣu
ahorātraiś catuḥṣaṣṭyā ṣaḍaṅgaṃ vedam āpatuḥ
lekhyaṃ ca gaṇitaṃ cobhau prāpnutāṃ yadunandanau
gāndharvavedaṃ citraṃ ca sakalaṃ samavāpatuḥ
hastiśikṣāśvaśikṣāṃ ca dvādaśāhena cāpatuḥ
tāv ubhau jagmatur vīrau guruṃ sāndīpaniṃ punaḥ
dhanurvedacikīrṣārthaṃ dharmajñau dharmacāriṇau
tāv iṣvastravarācāryam abhigamya praṇamya ca
tena tau satkṛtau rājan vicarantāv avantiṣu
pañcāśadbhir ahorātrair daśāṅgaṃ supratiṣṭhitam
sarahasyaṃ dhanurvedaṃ sakalaṃ tāv avāpatuḥ
dṛṣṭvā kṛtārthau viprendro gurvarthe tāv acodayat
ayācatārthaṃ govindaṃ tataḥ sāndīpanir vibhuḥ
mama putraḥ samudre 'smiṃs timinā cāpavāhitaḥ
putram ānaya bhadraṃ te bhakṣitaṃ timinā mama
ārtāya gurave tatra pratiśuśrāva duṣkaram
aśakyaṃ triṣu lokeṣu kartum anyena kena cit
yaś ca sāndīpaneḥ putraṃ jaghāna bharatarṣabha
so 'suraḥ samare tābhyāṃ samudre vinipātitaḥ
tataḥ sāndīpaneḥ putraḥ prasādād amitaujasaḥ
dīrghakālaṃ gataḥ pretaḥ punar āsīc charīravān
tad aśakyam acintyaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā sumahad adbhutam
sarveṣām eva bhūtānāṃ vismayaḥ samajāyata
aiśvaryāṇi ca sarvāṇi gavāśvaṃ ca dhanāni ca
sarvaṃ tad upajahrāte gurave rāmakeśavau
gadāparighayuddheṣu sarvāstreṣu ca keśavaḥ
paramāṃ mukhyatāṃ prāptaḥ sarvalokeṣu viśrutaḥ
kaś ca nārāyaṇād anyaḥ sarvaratnavibhūṣitam
ratham ādityasaṃkāśam ātiṣṭheta śacīpateḥ
tasya cāpratimo yantā vajrapāṇeḥ priyaḥ sakhā
mātaliḥ saṃgṛhītā syād anyatra puruṣottamāt
bhojarājatanūjo 'pi kaṃsas tāta yudhiṣṭhira
astrajñāne bale vīrye kārtavīryasamo 'bhavat
tasya bhojapateḥ putrād bhojarājanyavardhanāt
udvijante sma rājānaḥ suparṇād iva pannagāḥ
citrakārmukanistriṃśavimalaprāsayodhinaḥ
śataṃ śatasahasrāṇi pādātās tasya bhārata
aṣṭau śatasahasrāṇi śūrāṇām anivartinām
abhavan bhojarājasya jāmbūnadamayadhvajāḥ
rukmakāñcanakakṣyās tu gajās tasya yudhiṣṭhira
tāvanty eva sahasrāṇi gajānām anivartinām
te ca parvatasaṃkāśāś citradhvajapatākinaḥ
babhūvur bhojarājasya nityaṃ pramuditā gajāḥ
svalaṃkṛtānāṃ śīghrāṇāṃ kareṇūnāṃ yudhiṣṭhira
abhavad bhojarājasya dvis tāvad dhi mahad balam
ṣoḍaśāśvasahasrāṇi kiṃśukābhāni tasya vai
aparas tu mahāvyūhaḥ kiśorāṇāṃ yudhiṣṭhira
ārohavarasaṃpanno durdharṣaḥ kena cid balāt
sa ca ṣoḍaśasāhasraḥ kaṃsabhrātṛpuraḥsaraḥ
sunāmā sarvatas tv enaṃ sa kaṃsaṃ paryapālayat
ya āsan sarvavarṇās tu hayās tasya yudhiṣṭhira
sa gaṇo miśrako nāma ṣaṣṭisāhasra ucyate
kaṃsaroṣamahāvegāṃ dhvajānūpamahādrumām
mattadvipamahāgrāhāṃ vaivasvatavaśānugām
śastrajālamahāphenāṃ sādivegamahājalām
gadāparighapāṭhīnāṃ nānākavacaśaivalām
rathanāgamahāvartāṃ nānārudhirakardamām
citrakārmukanistriṃśāṃ rathāśvakalilahradām
mahāmṛdhanadīṃ ghorāṃ yudhāvartananisvanām
ko vā nārāyaṇād ekaḥ kaṃsahantā yudhiṣṭhira
eṣa śakrarathe tiṣṭhaṃs tāny anīkāni bhārata
vyadhamad bhojaputrasya mahābhrāṇīva mārutaḥ
taṃ sabhāsthaṃ sahāmātyaṃ hatvā kaṃsaṃ sahānvayam
mānayām āsa mānārhāṃ devakīṃ sasuhṛdgaṇām
yaśodāṃ rohiṇīṃ caiva abhivādya punaḥ punaḥ
ugrasenaṃ ca rājānam abhiṣicya janārdanaḥ
arcito yadumukhyais tu bhagavān vāsavānujaḥ
tataḥ pārthivam āyāntaṃ sahitaṃ sarvarājabhiḥ
bhīṣmaḥ
sarasvatyāṃ jarāsaṃdham ajayat puruṣottamaḥ
śūrasenapuraṃ tyaktvā sarvayādavanandanaḥ
dvārakāṃ bhagavān kṛṣṇaḥ pratyapadyata keśavaḥ
pratyapadyata yānāni ratnāni ca bahūni ca
yathārhaṃ puṇḍarīkākṣo nairṛtān pratyapadyata
tatra vighnaṃ caranti sma daiteyāḥ saha dānavaiḥ
tāñ jaghāna mahābāhur varadattān mahāsurān
sa vighnam akarot tatra narako nāma nairṛtaḥ
trāsanaḥ surasaṃghānāṃ vidito vaḥ prabhāvataḥ
sa bhūmyāṃ mūrtiliṅgasthaḥ sarvadevāsurāntakaḥ
mānuṣāṇām ṛṣīṇāṃ ca pratīpam akarot tadā
tvaṣṭur duhitaraṃ bhaumaḥ kaśerum agamat tadā
gajarūpeṇa jagrāha rucirāṅgīṃ caturdaśīm
pramathya ca jahāraināṃ hṛtvā ca narako 'bravīt
narakaḥ
naṣṭaśokabhayābādhaḥ prāgjyotiṣapatis tadā
yāni devamanuṣyeṣu ratnāni vividhāni ca
bibharti ca mahī kṛtsnā sāgareṣu ca yad vasu
adyaprabhṛti tad devi sahitāḥ sarvanairṛtāḥ
tavaivopahariṣyanti daityāś ca saha dānavaiḥ
evam uttamaratnāni bahūni vividhāni ca
sa jahāra tadā bhaumaḥ strīratnāni ca bhārata
gandharvāṇāṃ ca yāḥ kanyā jahāra narako balāt
yāś ca devamanuṣyāṇāṃ sapta cāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ
caturdaśasahasrāṇām ekaviṃśacchatāni ca
ekaveṇīdharāḥ sarvāḥ satāṃ mārgam anuvratāḥ
tāsām antaḥpuraṃ bhaumo 'kārayan maṇiparvate
audakāyām adīnātmā murasya viṣayaṃ prati
tāś ca prāgjyotiṣo rājā murasya daśa cātmajāḥ
nairṛtāś ca yathā mukhyāḥ pālayanta upāsate
sa eṣa tapasaḥ pāre varadatto mahīsutaḥ
aditiṃ dharṣayām āsa kuṇḍalārthaṃ yudhiṣṭhira
na cāsuragaṇaiḥ sarvaiḥ sahitaiḥ karma tat purā
kṛtapūrvaṃ mahāghoraṃ yad akārṣīn mahāsuraḥ
yaṃ mahī suṣuve devī yasya prāgjyotiṣaṃ puram
viṣayāntapālāś catvāro yasyāsan yuddhadurmadāḥ
ādevayānam āvṛtya panthānaṃ paryavasthitāḥ
trāsanāḥ surasaṃghānāṃ virūpai rākṣasaiḥ saha
hayagrīvo nisumbhaś ca ghoraḥ pañcajanas tathā
muraḥ putrasahasraiś ca varadatto mahāsuraḥ
tadvadhārthaṃ mahābāhur eṣa cakragadāsidhṛk
jāto vṛṣṇiṣu devakyāṃ vāsudevo janārdanaḥ
tasyāsya puruṣendrasya lokaprathitatejasaḥ
nivāso dvārakā tāta vidito vaḥ pradhānataḥ
atīva hi purī ramyā dvārakā vāsavakṣayāt
ati vai rājate pṛthvyāṃ pratyakṣaṃ te yudhiṣṭhira
tasmin devapuraprakhye sā sabhā vṛṣṇyupāśrayā
yā dāśārhīti vikhyātā yojanāyatavistṛtā
tatra vṛṣṇyandhakāḥ sarve rāmakṛṣṇapurogamāḥ
lokayātrām imāṃ kṛtsnāṃ parirakṣanta āsate
tatrāsīneṣu sarveṣu kadā cid bharatarṣabha
divyagandhā vavur vātāḥ kusumānāṃ ca vṛṣṭayaḥ
tataḥ sūryasahasrābhas tejorāśir mahādbhutaḥ
muhūrtam antarikṣe 'bhūt tato bhūmau pratiṣṭhitaḥ
madhye tu tejasas tasya pāṇḍaraṃ gajam āsthitaḥ
vṛto devagaṇaiḥ sarvair vāsavaḥ pratyadṛśyata
rāmakṛṣṇau ca rājā ca vṛṣṇyandhakagaṇaiḥ saha
utpatya sahasā tasmai namaskāram akurvata
so 'vatīrya gajāt tūrṇaṃ pariṣvajya janārdanam
sasvaje baladevaṃ ca rājānaṃ ca tam āhukam
uddhavaṃ vasudevaṃ ca vikadruṃ ca mahāmatim
pradyumnasāmbaniśaṭhān aniruddhaṃ sasātyakim
gadaṃ sāraṇam akrūraṃ bhānujhilliviḍūrathān
kṛtavarmācārudeṣṇau dāśārhāṇāṃ purogamān
pariṣvajya ca dṛṣṭvā ca bhagavān bhūtabhāvanaḥ
vṛṣṇyandhakamahāmātrān pariṣvajyātha vāsavaḥ
pragṛhya pūjāṃ tair dattāṃ bhagavān pākaśāsanaḥ
so 'diter vacanāt tāta kuṇḍalārthe janārdana
uvāca paramaprīto jahi bhaumam iti prabho
bhīṣmaḥ
tam uvāca mahābāhuḥ priyamāṇo janārdanaḥ
nihatya narakaṃ bhaumam āhariṣyāmi kuṇḍale
evam uktvā tu govindo rāmam evābhyabhāṣata
pradyumnam aniruddhaṃ ca sāmbaṃ cāpratimaṃ bale
etāṃś coktvā tadā tatra vāsudevo mahāyaśāḥ
athāruhya suparṇaṃ vai śaṅkhacakragadāsidhṛt
yayau tadā hṛṣīkeśo devānāṃ hitakāmyayā
taṃ prayāntam amitraghnaṃ devāḥ sahapuraṃdarāḥ
pṛṣṭhato 'nuyayuḥ prītāḥ stuvanto viṣṇum acyutam
ugrān rakṣogaṇān hatvā narakasya mahāsurān
kṣurāntān mauravān pāśān ṣaṭsahasraṃ dadarśa saḥ
saṃchidya pāśāñ śastreṇa muraṃ hatvā sahānvayam
śilāsaṃghān atikramya niśumbham avapothayat
yaḥ sahasrasamas tv ekaḥ sarvān devān ayodhayat
taṃ jaghāna mahāvīryaṃ hayagrīvaṃ mahābalam
apāratejā durdharṣaḥ sarvayādavanandanaḥ
madhye lohitagaṅgāyāṃ bhagavān devakīsutaḥ
audakāyāṃ virūpākṣaṃ jaghāna madhusūdanaḥ
pañca pañcajanān ghorān narakasya mahāsurān
tataḥ prāgjyotiṣaṃ nāma dīpyamānam iva śriyā
puram āsādayām āsa tatra yuddham avartata
mahad devāsuraṃ yuddhaṃ yad vṛttaṃ bharatarṣabha
yuddhaṃ na syāt samaṃ tena lokavismayakārakam
cakralāṅgalasaṃchinnāḥ śaktikhaḍgahatās tadā
nipetur dānavās tatra samāsādya janārdanam
aṣṭau śatasahasrāṇi dānavānāṃ paraṃtapa
nihatya puruṣavyāghraḥ pātālavivaraṃ yayau
trāsanaṃ surasaṃghānāṃ narakaṃ puruṣottamaḥ
yodhayaty atitejasvī madhuvan madhusūdanaḥ
tad yuddham abhavad ghoraṃ tena bhaumena bhārata
kuṇḍalārthe sureśasya narakeṇa mahātmanā
muhūrtaṃ lālayitvātha narakaṃ madhusūdanaḥ
pravṛttacakraṃ cakreṇa pramamātha balād balī
cakrapramathitaṃ tasya papāta sahasā bhuvi
uttamāṅgaṃ hatāṅgasya vṛtre vajrahate yathā
bhūmis tu patitaṃ dṛṣṭvā te vai prādāc ca kuṇḍale
pradāya ca mahābāhum idaṃ vacanam abravīt
sṛṣṭas tvayaiva madhuhaṃs tvayaiva nihataḥ prabho
yathecchasi tathā krīḍan prajās tasyānupālaya
vāsudevaḥ
devānāṃ ca munīnāṃ ca pitṝṇāṃ ca mahātmanām
udvejanīyo bhūtānāṃ brahmadviṭ puruṣādhamaḥ
lokadviṣṭaḥ sutas tubhyaṃ devārir lokakaṇṭakaḥ
sarvalokanamaskāryām aditiṃ bādhate balī
kuṇḍale darpasaṃpūrṇas tato me nihato 'suraḥ
naiva manyus tvayā kāryo yat kṛtaṃ mayi bhāmini
matprabhāvāc ca te putro labdhavān gatim uttamām
tasmād gaccha mahābhāge bhārāvataraṇaṃ kṛtam
bhīṣmaḥ
nihatya narakaṃ bhaumaṃ satyabhāmāsahāyavān
sahito lokapālaiś ca dadarśa narakālayam
athāsya gṛham āsādya narakasya yaśasvinaḥ
dadarśa dhanam akṣayyaṃ ratnāni vividhāni ca
maṇimuktāpravālāni vaiḍūryavikṛtāni ca
aśmasārān arkamaṇīn vimalān sphāṭikān api
jāmbūnadamayāny eva śātakumbhamayāni ca
pradīptajvalanābhāni śītaraśmiprabhāṇi ca
hiraṇyavarṇaṃ ruciraṃ śvetam abhyantaraṃ gṛham
yat tad arthaṃ gṛhe dṛṣṭaṃ narakasya dhanaṃ bahu
na hi rājñaḥ kuberasya tāvad dhanasamucchrayaḥ
dṛṣṭapūrvaḥ purā sākṣān mahendrasadaneṣv api
hate bhaume nisumbhe ca vāsavaḥ sagaṇo 'bravīt
dāśārhapatim āsīnam āhṛtya maṇikuṇḍale
imāni maṇiratnāni vividhāni vasūni ca
hemasūtrā mahākakṣyās tomarair vīryaśālinaḥ
bhīmarūpāś ca mātaṅgāḥ pravālavikṛtāḥ kuthāḥ
vimalāni patākāni vāsāṃsi vividhāni ca
te ca viṃśatisāhasrā dvis tāvatyaḥ kareṇavaḥ
aṣṭau śatasahasrāṇi deśajāś cottamā hayāḥ
gobhiś cāvikṛtair yānaiḥ kāmaṃ tava janārdana
etat te prāpayiṣyāmi vṛṣṇyāvāsam ariṃdama
āvikāni ca sūkṣmāṇi śayanāny āsanāni ca
kāmavyāhāriṇaś cāpi pakṣiṇaḥ priyadarśanāḥ
candanāgarumiśrāṇi yānāni vividhāni ca
tac ca te prāpayiṣyāmi vṛṣṇyāvāsam ariṃdama
vasu yat triṣu lokeṣu dharmeṇaivārjitaṃ tvayā
devagandharvaratnāni daiteyāsurajāni ca
yāni santīha ratnāni narakasya niveśane
etat tu garuḍe sarvaṃ kṣipram āropya vāsavaḥ
dāśārhapatinā sārdham upāyān maṇiparvatam
tatra puṇyā vavur vātāḥ prabhāś citrāḥ samujjvalāḥ
prekṣatāṃ surasaṃghānāṃ vismayaḥ samapadyata
tridaśā ṛṣayaś caiva candrādityau tathā divi
prabhayā tasya śailasya nirviśeṣam ivābhavat
anujñātas tu rāmeṇa vāsavena ca keśavaḥ
prīyamāṇo mahābāhur viveśa maṇiparvatam
tatra vaiḍūryavarṇāni dadarśa madhusūdanaḥ
satoraṇapatākāni dvārāṇi śaraṇāni ca
citragrathitameghābhaḥ prababhau maṇiparvataḥ
hemacitrapatākaiś ca prāsādair upaśobhitaḥ
harmyāṇi ca viśālāni maṇisopānavanti ca
tatrasthā varavarṇābhā dadarśa madhusūdanaḥ
gandharvāsuramukhyānāṃ priyā duhitaras tadā
triviṣṭapasame deśe tiṣṭhantam aparājitam
parivavrur mahābāhum ekaveṇīdharāḥ striyaḥ
sarvāḥ kāṣāyavāsinyaḥ sarvāś ca niyatendriyāḥ
vratasaṃtāpajaḥ śoko nātra kāś cid apīḍayat
arajāṃsi ca vāsāṃsi bibhratyaḥ kauśikāny api
sametya yadusiṃhasya cakrur asyāñjaliṃ striyaḥ
ūcuś cainaṃ hṛṣīkeśaṃ sarvās tāḥ kamalekṣaṇāḥ
nāradena samākhyātam asmākaṃ puruṣottama
āgamiṣyati govindaḥ surakāryārthasiddhaye
so 'suraṃ narakaṃ hatvā nisumbhaṃ muram eva ca
bhaumaṃ ca saparīvāraṃ hayagrīvaṃ ca dānavam
tathā pañcajanaṃ caiva prāpsyate dhanam akṣayam
so 'cireṇaiva kālena yuṣmadbhartā bhaviṣyati
evam uktvāgamad dhīmān devarṣir nāradas tadā
tvāṃ cintayānāḥ satataṃ tapo ghoram upāsmahe
kāle 'tīte mahābāhuṃ kadā drakṣyāma mādhavam
ity evaṃ hṛdi saṃkalpaṃ kṛtvā puruṣasattama
tapaś carāma satataṃ rakṣyamāṇā hi dānavaiḥ
gāndharveṇa vivāhena vivāhaṃ kuru naḥ priyam
tato 'smatpriyakāmārthaṃ bhagavān mārutaḥ svayam
yathoktaṃ nāradenātha nacirāt tad bhaviṣyati
tāsāṃ paramanārīṇām ṛṣabhākṣaṃ puraskṛtam
dadṛśur devagandharvā gṛṣṭīnām iva gopatim
tasya candropamaṃ vaktram udīkṣya muditendriyāḥ
saṃprahṛṣṭā mahābāhum idaṃ vacanam abruvan
satyaṃ bata purā vāyur idam asmān ihābravīt
sarvabhūtakṛtajñaś ca maharṣir api nāradaḥ
viṣṇur nārāyaṇo devaḥ śaṅkhacakragadāsidhṛk
sa bhaumaṃ narakaṃ hatvā bhartā vo bhavitā hi saḥ
diṣṭyā tasyarṣimukhyasya nāradasya mahātmanaḥ
vacanaṃ darśanād eva satyaṃ bhavitum arhati
yat priyaṃ bata paśyāma vaktraṃ candropamaṃ tu te
darśanena kṛtārthāḥ sma vayam adya mahātmanaḥ
uvāca sa yaduśreṣṭhaḥ sarvās tā jātamanmathāḥ
yathā brūta viśālākṣyas tat sarvaṃ vo bhaviṣyati
tāni sarvāṇi ratnāni gamayitvātha kiṃkaraiḥ
striyaś ca gamayitvātha devarṣinṛpakanyakāḥ
vainateyabhuje kṛṣṇo maṇiparvatam uttamam
kṣipram āropayāṃ cakre bhagavān devakīsutaḥ
sapakṣigaṇamātaṅgaṃ savyālamṛgapannagam
śākhāmṛgagaṇair juṣṭaṃ saprastaraśilātalam
nyaṅkubhiś ca varāhaiś ca rurubhiś ca niṣevitam
saprapātamahāsānuṃ vicitraśikhisaṃkulam
taṃ mahendrānujaḥ śauriś cakāra garuḍopari
paśyatāṃ sarvabhūtānām utpāṭya maṇiparvatam
upendraṃ baladevaṃ ca vāsavaṃ ca mahābalam
taṃ ca ratnaugham atulaṃ parvataṃ ca mahābalaḥ
varuṇasyāmṛtaṃ divyaṃ chatraṃ candropamaṃ śubham
svapakṣabalavikṣepair mahādriśikharopamaḥ
dikṣu sarvāsu saṃrāvaṃ sa cakre garuḍo vahan
ārujan parvatāgrāṇi pādapāṃś ca samutkṣipan
saṃjahāra mahābhrāṇi vaiśvānarapathaṃ gataḥ
grahanakṣatratārāṇāṃ saptarṣigaṇatejasām
prabhājālam atikramya candrasūryapathaṃ yayau
meroḥ śikharam āsādya madhyamaṃ madhusūdanaḥ
devasthānāni sarvāṇi dadarśa bharatarṣabha
viśveṣāṃ marutāṃ caiva sādhyānāṃ ca yudhiṣṭhira
bhrājamānāny atikramya aśvinoś ca paraṃtapa
prāpya puṇyatamaṃ sthānaṃ devalokam ariṃdamaḥ
śakrasadma samāsādya avaruhya janārdanaḥ
so 'bhivādya diteḥ pādāv arcitaḥ sarvadaivataiḥ
brahmadakṣapurogaiś ca prajāpatibhir eva ca
aditeḥ kuṇḍale divye dadāvātha tadā vibhuḥ
ratnāni ca parārdhyāṇi rāmeṇa saha keśavaḥ
pratigṛhya ca tat sarvam aditir vāsavānujam
pūjayām āsa dāśārhaṃ rāmaṃ ca vigatajvarā
śacī mahendramahiṣī kṛṣṇasya mahiṣīṃ tadā
satyabhāmāṃ tu saṃgṛhya adityai vai nyavedayat
sā tasyāḥ satyabhāmāyāḥ kṛṣṇapriyacikīrṣayā
aditiḥ
varaṃ prādād devamātā satyāyai vigatajvarā
jarāṃ na yāsyasi śubhe yāvad vai kṛṣṇamānuṣam
bhīṣmaḥ
sarvagandhaguṇopetā bhaviṣyasi varānane
vihṛtya satyabhāmā vai saha śacyā sumadhyamā
śacyāpi samanujñātā yayau kṛṣṇaniveśanam
saṃpūjyamānas tridaśair maharṣigaṇasevitaḥ
dvārakāṃ prayayau kṛṣṇo devalokād ariṃdamaḥ
so 'tipatya mahābāhur dīrgham adhvānam acyutaḥ
vardhamānapuradvāram āsasāda purottamam
bhīṣmaḥ
tāṃ purīṃ dvārakāṃ dṛṣṭvā vibhur nārāyaṇo hariḥ
hṛṣṭaḥ sarvārthasaṃpannāṃ praveṣṭum upacakrame
so 'paśyad vṛkṣaṣaṇḍāṃś ca ramyān ārāmajān bahūn
samantato dvāravatyāṃ nānāpuṣpaphalānvitān
arkacandrapratīkāśair merukūṭanibhair gṛhaiḥ
dvārakā racitā ramyaiḥ sukṛtā viśvakarmaṇā
padmaṣaṇḍākulābhiś ca haṃsasevitavāribhiḥ
gaṅgāsindhuprakāśābhiḥ parighābhir alaṃkṛtā
prākāreṇārkavarṇena pāṇḍareṇa virājatā
viyanmūrdhni niviṣṭena dyaur ivābhraparicchadā
nandanapratimaiś cāpi miśrakapratimair vanaiḥ
bhāti caitrarathaṃ divyaṃ pitāmahavanaṃ yathā
vaibhrājapratimaiś caiva sarvartukusumotkaṭaiḥ
bhāti tārāparikṣiptā dvārakā dyaur ivāmbare
bhāti raivatakaḥ śailo ramyasānur mahājiraḥ
pūrvasyāṃ diśi ramyāyāṃ dvārakāyāṃ vibhūṣaṇam
dakṣiṇasyāṃ latāveṣṭaḥ pañcavarṇo virājate
indraketupratīkāśaḥ paścimāṃ diśam āśritaḥ
sukakṣo rājataḥ śailaś citrapuṣpamahāvanaḥ
uttarasyāṃ diśi tathā veṇumanto virājate
mandarādripratīkāśaḥ pāṇḍaraḥ pāṇḍavarṣabha
citrakambalavarṇābhaṃ pāñcajanyavanaṃ tathā
sarvartukavanaṃ caiva bhāti raivatakaṃ prati
latāveṣṭaṃ samantāt tu meruprabhavanaṃ mahat
bhāti tālavanaṃ caiva puṣpakaṃ puṇḍarīki ca
sukakṣaṃ parivāryainaṃ citrapuṣpaṃ mahāvanam
śatapatravanaṃ caiva karavīrakusumbhi ca
bhāti caitrarathaṃ caiva nandanaṃ ca mahāvanam
ramaṇaṃ bhāvanaṃ caiva veṇumantaṃ samantataḥ
bhāti puṣkariṇī ramyā pūrvasyāṃ diśi bhārata
dhanuḥśataparīṇāhā keśavasya mahātmanaḥ
mahāpurīṃ dvāravatīṃ pañcāśadbhir mukhair yutām
praviṣṭo dvārakāṃ ramyāṃ bhāsayantīṃ samantataḥ
aprameyāṃ mahotsedhāṃ mahāgādhapariplavām
prāsādavarasaṃpannāṃ śvetaprāsādaśālinīm
tīkṣṇayantraśataghnībhir yantrajālaiḥ samanvitām
āyasaiś ca mahācakrair dadarśa dvārakāṃ purīm
aṣṭau rathasahasrāṇi prākāre kiṅkiṇīkinaḥ
samucchritapatākāni yathā devapure tathā
aṣṭayojanavistīrṇām acalāṃ dvādaśāyatām
dviguṇopaniveśāṃ ca dadarśa dvārakāṃ purīm
aṣṭamārgāṃ mahākakṣyāṃ mahāṣoḍaśacatvarām
evaṃ mārgaparikṣiptāṃ sākṣād uśanasā kṛtām
vyūhānām antarā mārgāḥ sapta caiva mahāpathāḥ
tatra sā vihitā sākṣān nagarī viśvakarmaṇā
kāñcanair maṇisopānair upetā janaharṣiṇī
gītaghoṣamahāghoṣaiḥ prāsādapravaraiḥ śubhā
tasmin puravaraśreṣṭhe dāśārhāṇāṃ yaśasvinām
veśmāni jahṛṣe dṛṣṭvā bhagavān pākaśāsanaḥ
samucchritapatākāni pāriplavanibhāni ca
kāñcanāgrāṇi bhāsvanti merukūṭanibhāni ca
sudhāpāṇḍaraśṛṅgaiś ca śātakumbhaparicchadaiḥ
ratnasānuguhāśṛṅgaiḥ sarvaratnavibhūṣitaiḥ
saharmyaiḥ sārdhacandraiś ca saniryūhaiḥ sapañjaraiḥ
sayantragṛhasaṃbādhaiḥ sadhātubhir ivādribhiḥ
maṇikāñcanabhaumaiś ca sudhāmṛṣṭatalais tathā
jāmbūnadamayair dvārair vaiḍūryavikṛtārgalaiḥ
sarvartusukhasaṃsparśair mahādhanaparicchadaiḥ
ramyasānuguhāśṛṅgair vicitrair iva parvataiḥ
pañcavarṇasuvarṇaiś ca puṣpavṛṣṭisamaprabhaiḥ
tulyaiḥ parjanyanirghoṣair nānāvarṇair ivāmbudaiḥ
mahendraśikharaprakhyair vihitair viśvakarmaṇā
ālikhadbhir ivākāśam aticandrārkabhāsvaraiḥ
tair dāśārhamahānāgair babhāse bhavanahradaiḥ
caṇḍanāgākulair ghorair hradair bhogavatī yathā
kṛṣṇadhvajopavāhyaiś ca dāśārhāyudharohitaiḥ
vṛṣṇimattamayūraiś ca strīsahasraprajākulaiḥ
vāsudevendraparjanyair gṛhameghair alaṃkṛtā
dadṛśe dvārakātīva meghair dyaur iva saṃvṛtā
sākṣād bhagavato veśma vihitaṃ viśvakarmaṇā
dadṛśur devadevasya caturyojanam āyatam
tāvad eva ca vistīrṇam aprameyaṃ mahādhanaiḥ
prāsādavarasaṃpannaṃ yuktaṃ jagatiparvataiḥ
yaṃ cakāra mahābāhus tvaṣṭā vāsavacoditaḥ
prāsādaṃ padmanābhasya sarvato yojanāyatam
meror iva gireḥ śṛṅgam ucchritaṃ kāñcanāyutam
rukmiṇyāḥ pravaro vāso vihitaḥ sa mahātmanā
satyabhāmā punar veśma sadā vasati pāṇḍaram
vicitramaṇisopānaṃ yaṃ viduḥ śītavān iti
vimalādityavarṇābhiḥ patākābhir alaṃkṛtam
vyaktabaddhaṃ vanoddeśaiś caturdiśi mahādhvajam
sa ca prāsādamukhyo 'tra jāmbavatyā vibhūṣitaḥ
prabhayā bhūṣaṇaiś citrais trailokyam iva bhāsayan
yas tu pāṇḍaravarṇābhas tayor antaram āśritaḥ
viśvakarmākarod enaṃ kailāsaśikharopamam
jāmbūnadapradīptāgraḥ pradīptajvalanopamaḥ
sāgarapratimo 'tiṣṭhan merur ity abhiviśrutaḥ
tasmin gāndhārarājasya duhitā kulaśālinī
sukeśī nāma vikhyātā keśavena niveśitā
padmakūṭa iti khyātaḥ padmavarṇo mahāprabhaḥ
suprabhāyā mahābāho nivāsaḥ paramārcitaḥ
yas tu sūryaprabho nāma prāsādavara ucyate
lakṣmaṇāyāḥ kuruśreṣṭha sa dattaḥ śārṅgadhanvanā
vaiḍūryavaravarṇābhaḥ prāsādo haritaprabhaḥ
setujālāni yatraiva tatraiva ca niveśitaḥ
yaṃ viduḥ sarvabhūtāni harir ity eva bhārata
sa mitravindayā vāso devarṣigaṇapūjitaḥ
mahiṣyā vāsudevasya bhūṣaṇaṃ sarvaveśmanām
yas tu prāsādamukhyo 'tra vihitaḥ sarvaśilpibhiḥ
atīva ramyaḥ so 'py atra prahasann iva tiṣṭhati
sudattāyāḥ suvāsas tu pūjitaḥ sarvaśilpibhiḥ
mahiṣyā vāsudevasya ketumān iti viśrutaḥ
prāsādo virajo nāma virajasko mahātmanaḥ
upasthānagṛhaṃ tāta keśavasya mahātmanaḥ
yas tu prāsādamukhyo 'tra yaṃ tvaṣṭā vyadadhāt svayam
yojanāyataviṣkambhaṃ sarvaratnamayaṃ vibhoḥ
teṣāṃ tu vihitāḥ sarve rukmadaṇḍāḥ patākinaḥ
sadane vāsudevasya mārgasaṃjananā dhvajāḥ
ghaṇṭājālāni tatraiva sarveṣāṃ ca niveśane
āhṛtya yadusiṃhena vaijayanty acalo mahān
haṃsakūṭasya yac chṛṅgam indradyumnasaro mahat
ṣaṣṭitālasamutsedham ardhayojanavistṛtam
sakiṃnaramahānādaṃ tad apy amitatejasaḥ
paśyatāṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam
ādityapathagaṃ yat tan meroḥ śikharam uttamam
jāmbūnadamayaṃ divyaṃ triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam
tad apy utpāṭya kṛṣṇena svaṃ niveśanam āhṛtam
bhrājamānaṃ purā tatra sarvauṣadhivibhūṣitam
yam indrabhavanāc chaurir ājahāra paraṃtapaḥ
pārijātaḥ sa tatraiva keśavena niveśitaḥ
lepahastaśatair juṣṭo vimānaiś ca hiraṇmayaiḥ
vihitā vāsudevena brahmasthalamahādrumāḥ
padmākulajalopetā ratnasaugandhikotpalāḥ
maṇimauktikavālūkāḥ puṣkariṇyaḥ sarāṃsi ca
tāsāṃ paramakūlāni śobhayanti mahādrumāḥ
sālatālāśvakarṇāś ca śataśākhāś ca rohiṇaḥ
bhallātakāḥ kapitthāś ca candravṛkṣāś ca campakāḥ
kharjūrāḥ ketakāś caiva samantāt pariropitāḥ
ye ca haimavatā vṛkṣā ye ca nandanajās tathā
āhṛtya yadusiṃhena te 'pi tatra niveśitāḥ
raktapītāruṇaprakhyāḥ sitapuṣpāś ca pādapāḥ
sarvartuphalapūrṇās te teṣu kānanasaṃdhiṣu
sahasrapatrapadmāś ca mandārāś ca sahasraśaḥ
aśokāḥ karṇikārāś ca tilakā nāgamallikāḥ
kuravā nāgapuṣpāś ca campakās tṛṇagulmakāḥ
saptaparṇāḥ kadambāś ca nīpāḥ kuravakās tathā
ketakyaḥ kesarāś caiva hintālatalatāṭakāḥ
tālāḥ priyaṅguvakulāḥ piṇḍikā bījapūrakāḥ
drākṣāmalakakharjūrā mṛdvīkā jambukās tathā
āmrāḥ panasavṛkṣāś ca aṅkolās tilatindukāḥ
likucāmrātakāś caiva kṣīrikā kaṇṭakīs tathā
nālikereṅgudāś caiva utkrośakavanāni ca
vanāni ca kadalyāś ca jātimallikapāṭalāḥ
kumudotpalapūrṇāś ca vāpyaḥ kūpāḥ sahasraśaḥ
bhallātakakapitthāś ca taitabhā bandhujīvakāḥ
priyaṅgvaśokakāśmaryaḥ prācīnāś cāpi sarvaśaḥ
priyaṅgubadarībhiś ca yavaiḥ spandanacandanaiḥ
śamībilvapalāśaiś ca pālāśavaṭapippalaiḥ
udumbaraiś ca bilvaiś ca pālāśaiḥ pāribhadrakaiḥ
indravṛkṣārjunaiś caiva aśvatthaiś ciribilvakaiḥ
saubhañjanakavṛkṣaiś ca bhallaṭair aśvasāhvayaiḥ
sarjais tāmbūlavallībhir lavaṅgaiḥ kramukais tathā
vaṃśaiś ca vividhais tatra samantāt pariropitaiḥ
ye ca nandanajā vṛkṣā ye ca caitrarathe vane
sarve te yadunāthena samantāt pariropitāḥ
samākulā mahāvāpyaḥ pītā lohitavālukāḥ
tasmin gṛhavare nadyaḥ prasannasalilā hradāḥ
phullotpalajalopetā nānādrumasamākulāḥ
tasmin gṛhavare nadyo maṇiśarkaravālukāḥ
mattabarhiṇasaṃghāś ca kokilāś ca madodvahāḥ
babhūvuḥ paramopetāḥ sarve jagatiparvatāḥ
tatraiva gajayūthāni tatra gomahiṣās tathā
nivāsāś ca kṛtās tatra varāhamṛgapakṣiṇām
viśvakarmakṛtaḥ śailaḥ prākāras tasya veśmanaḥ
vyaktaṃ kiṣkuśatodyāmaḥ sudhākarasamaprabhaḥ
tena te ca mahāśailāḥ saritaś ca sarāṃsi ca
parikṣiptāni harmyasya vanāny upavanāni ca
bhīṣmaḥ
evam ālokayāṃ cakrur dvārakām ṛṣabhās trayaḥ
upendrabaladevau ca vāsavaś ca mahāyaśāḥ
tatas taṃ pāṇḍaraṃ śaurir mūrdhni tiṣṭhan garutmataḥ
prītaḥ śaṅkham upādadhmau vidviṣāṃ romaharṣaṇam
tasya śaṅkhasya śabdena sāgaraś cukṣubhe bhṛśam
rarāsa ca nabhaḥ sarvaṃ tac citram abhavat tadā
pāñcajanyasya nirghoṣaṃ niśamya kukurāndhakāḥ
viśokāḥ samapadyanta garuḍasya ca darśanāt
śaṅkhacakragadāpāṇiṃ suparṇaśirasi sthitam
dṛṣṭvā jahṛṣire kṛṣṇaṃ bhāskarodayatejasam
tatas tūryapraṇādaś ca bherīṇāṃ ca mahāsvanaḥ
siṃhanādaś ca saṃjajñe sarveṣāṃ puravāsinām
tatas te sarvadāśārhāḥ sarve ca kukurāndhakāḥ
prīyamāṇāḥ samājagmur ālokya madhusūdanam
vāsudevaṃ puraskṛtya veṇuśaṅkharavaiḥ saha
ugraseno yayau rājā vāsudevaniveśanam
ānandituṃ paryacaran sveṣu veśmasu devakī
rohiṇī ca yathoddeśam āhukasya ca yā striyaḥ
hatā brahmadviṣaḥ sarve jayanty andhakavṛṣṇayaḥ
evam uktaḥ saha strībhir akṣatair madhusūdanaḥ
tataḥ śauriḥ suparṇena svaṃ niveśanam abhyayāt
cakārātha yathoddeśam īśvaro maṇiparvatam
tato dhanāni ratnāni sabhāyāṃ madhusūdanaḥ
nidhāya puṇḍarīkākṣaḥ pitur darśanalālasaḥ
tataḥ sāndīpiniṃ pūrvam upaspṛṣṭvā mahāyaśāḥ
vavande pṛthutāmrākṣaḥ prīyamāṇo mahābhujaḥ
tathāśruparipūrṇākṣam ānandagatacetasam
vavande saha rāmeṇa pitaraṃ vāsavānujaḥ
tābhyāṃ ca mūrdhny upāghrātaḥ keśavaḥ paravīrahā
yathāśreṣṭham upāgamya sātvatān yadunandanaḥ
sarveṣāṃ nāma jagrāha dāśārhāṇām adhokṣajaḥ
tataḥ sarvāṇi vittāni sarvaratnamayāni ca
bhīṣmaḥ
vyabhajat tāni tebhyo 'tha sarvebhyo yadunandanaḥ
sā keśavamahāmātrair mahendrapramukhaiḥ saha
śuśubhe vṛṣṇiśārdūlaiḥ siṃhair iva girer guhā
athāsanagatān sarvān uvāca vibudhādhipaḥ
śubhayā harṣayan vācā mahendras tān mahāyaśāḥ
kukurāndhakamukhyāṃś ca taṃ ca rājānam āhukam
yadarthaṃ janma kṛṣṇasya mānuṣeṣu mahātmanaḥ
yat kṛtaṃ vāsudevena tad vakṣyāmi samāsataḥ
ayaṃ śatasahasrāṇi dānavānām ariṃdamaḥ
nihatya puṇḍarīkākṣaḥ pātālavivaraṃ yayau
yac ca nādhigataṃ pūrvaiḥ prahlādabaliśambaraiḥ
tad idaṃ śauriṇā vittaṃ prāpitaṃ bhavatām iha
sapāśaṃ muram ākramya pāñcajanyaṃ ca dhīmatā
śilāsaṃghān atikramya nisumbhaḥ sagaṇo hataḥ
hayagrīvaś ca vikrānto dānavo nihato balī
mathitaś ca mṛdhe bhaumaḥ kuṇḍale cāhṛte punaḥ
prāptaṃ ca divi deveṣu keśavena mahad yaśaḥ
vītaśokabhayābādhāḥ kṛṣṇabāhubalāśrayāḥ
yajanto vividhaiḥ somair makhair andhakavṛṣṇayaḥ
punar bāṇavadhe śaurim ādityā vasubhiḥ saha
manmukhābhigamiṣyanti sādhyāś ca madhusūdanam
evam uktvā tataḥ sarvān āmantrya kukurāndhakān
sasvaje rāmakṛṣṇau ca vasudevaṃ ca vāsavaḥ
pradyumnasāmbaniśaṭhān aniruddhaṃ ca sāraṇam
babhruṃ jhilliṃ gadaṃ bhānuṃ cārudeṣṇaṃ ca vṛtrahā
satkṛtya sāraṇākrūrau punar ābhāṣya sātyakim
sasvaje vṛṣṇirājānam āhukaṃ kukurādhipam
bhojaṃ ca kṛtavarmāṇam anyāṃś cāndhakavṛṣṇiṣu
āmantrya devapravaro vāsavo vāsavānujam
tataḥ śvetācalaprakhyaṃ gajam airāvataṃ prabhuḥ
paśyatāṃ sarvabhūtānām āruroha śacīpatiḥ
pṛthivīṃ cāntarikṣaṃ ca divaṃ ca varavāraṇam
mukhāḍambaranirghoṣaiḥ pūrayantam ivāsakṛt
haimayantramahākakṣyaṃ hiraṇmayaviṣāṇinam
manoharakuthāstīrṇaṃ sarvaratnavibhūṣitam
anekaśataratnābhiḥ patākābhir alaṃkṛtam
nityasrutamadāsrāvaṃ kṣarantam iva toyadam
diśāgajaṃ mahāmātraṃ kāñcanasrajam āsthitaḥ
prababhau mandarāgrasthaḥ pratapan bhānumān iva
tato vajramayaṃ bhīmaṃ pragṛhya paramāṅkuśam
yayau balavatā sārdhaṃ pāvakena śacīpatiḥ
taṃ kareṇugajavrātair vimānaiś ca marudgaṇāḥ
pṛṣṭhato 'nuyayuḥ prītāḥ kuberavaruṇagrahāḥ
sa vāyupatham āsthāya vaiśvānarapathaṃ gataḥ
bhīṣmaḥ
prāpya sūryapathaṃ devas tatraivāntaradhīyata
tataḥ sarvadaśārhāṇām āhukasya ca yāḥ striyaḥ
nandagopasya mahiṣī yaśodā lokaviśrutā
revatī ca mahābhāgā rukmiṇī ca pativratā
satyā jāmbavatī cobhe gāndhārī śiṃśumāpi ca
viśokā lakṣmaṇā sādhvī sumitrā ketumā tathā
vāsudevamahiṣyo 'nyāḥ śriyā sārdhaṃ yayus tadā
vibhūtiṃ draṣṭumanasaḥ keśavasya varāṅganāḥ
prīyamāṇāḥ sabhāṃ jagmur ālokayitum acyutam
devakī sarvadevīnāṃ rohiṇī ca puraskṛtā
dadṛśur devam āsīnaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ halabhṛtā saha
tau tu pūrvam upakramya rohiṇīm abhivādya ca
abhyavādayatāṃ devau devakīṃ rāmakeśavau
devakīṃ saptadevīnāṃ yathāśreṣṭhaṃ ca mātaraḥ
vavande saha rāmeṇa bhagavān vāsavānujaḥ
athāsanavaraṃ prāpya vṛṣṇidārapuraskṛtā
ubhāv aṅkagatau cakre devakī rāmakeśavau
sā tābhyām ṛṣabhākṣābhyāṃ putrābhyāṃ śuśubhe tadā
devakī devamāteva mitreṇa varuṇena ca
tataḥ prāptā yaśodāyā duhitā vai kṣaṇena hi
jājvalyamānā vapuṣā prabhayātīva bhārata
ekānaṅgeti yām āhuḥ kanyāṃ tāṃ kāmarūpiṇīm
yatkṛte sagaṇaṃ kaṃsaṃ jaghāna puruṣottamaḥ
tataḥ sa bhagavān rāmas tām upākramya bhāminīm
mūrdhny upāghrāya savyena parijagrāha pāṇinā
tāṃ ca tatropasaṃgṛhya priyām iva sakhīṃ samām
dakṣiṇena karāgreṇa parijagrāha mādhavaḥ
dadṛśus tāṃ sabhāmadhye bhaginīṃ rāmakṛṣṇayoḥ
rukmapadmaśayāṃ padmāṃ śrīm ivottamanāgayoḥ
athākṣatamahāvṛṣṭyā lājapuṣpaghṛtair api
vṛṣṇayo 'vākiran prītāḥ saṃkarṣaṇajanārdanau
sabālāḥ sahavṛddhāś ca sajñātikulabāndhavāḥ
upopaviviśuḥ prītā vṛṣṇayo madhusūdanam
pūjyamāno mahābāhuḥ paurāṇāṃ rativardhanaḥ
viveśa puruṣavyāghraḥ svaveśma madhusūdanaḥ
rukmiṇyā sahito devyā pramumoda sukhī sukham
tadanantaraṃ ca satyāyā jāmbavatyāś ca bhārata
sarvāsāṃ ca yaduśreṣṭhaḥ sarvakālavihāravān
jagāma ca hṛṣīkeśo rukmiṇyāḥ sa niveśanam
eṣa tāta mahābāho vijayaḥ śārṅgadhanvanaḥ
etadarthaṃ ca janmāhur mānuṣeṣu mahātmanaḥ
bhīṣmaḥ
dvārakāyāṃ tataḥ kṛṣṇaḥ svadāreṣu divāniśam
sukhaṃ labdhvā mahārāja pramumoda mahāyaśāḥ
pautrasya kāraṇāc cakre vibudhānāṃ hitaṃ tadā
savāsavaiḥ suraiḥ sarvair dustaraṃ bharatarṣabha
bāṇo nāmābhavad rājā baler jyeṣṭhasuto balī
vīryavān bharataśreṣṭha sa ca bāhusahasravān
tataś cakre tapas tīvraṃ satyena manasā nṛpa
rudram ārādhayām āsa sa ca bāṇaḥ samā bahu
tasmai bahuvarā dattāḥ śaṃkareṇa mahātmanā
tasmāl labdhvā varān bāṇo durlabhān asurair bhuvi
sa śoṇitapure rājyaṃ cakārāpratimo bale
trāsitāś ca surāḥ sarve tena bāṇena pāṇḍava
vijitya vibudhān sarvān sendrān bāṇaḥ samā bahu
aśāsata mahad rājyaṃ kubera iva bhārata
ṛddhyarthaṃ kurute yatnaṃ tasya caivośanā kaviḥ
tato rājann uṣā nāma bāṇasya duhitā tathā
rūpeṇāpratimā loke menakāyāḥ sutā yathā
athopāyena kaunteya aniruddho mahādyutiḥ
prādyumnis tām uṣāṃ prāpya pracchannaḥ pramumoda ha
atha bāṇo mahātejās tadā tatra yudhiṣṭhira
taṃ guhyanilayaṃ jñātvā prādyumniṃ sutayā saha
gṛhītvā kārayām āsa vastuṃ kārāgṛhe balāt
sukumāraḥ sukhārho 'tha tadā duḥkham avāpa saḥ
bāṇena khedito rājann aniruddho mumoha ca
etasminn eva kāle tu nārado munipuṅgavaḥ
dvārakāṃ prāpya kaunteya kṛṣṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā vaco 'bravīt
kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa mahābāho yadūnāṃ kīrtivardhana
tvatpautro bādhyamāno 'tha bāṇenāmitatejasā
kṛcchraṃ prāpto 'niruddho vai śete kanyāgṛhe sadā
evam uktvā surarṣir vai bāṇasyātha puraṃ yayau
nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā tato rājañ janārdanaḥ
āhūya baladevaṃ vai pradyumnaṃ ca mahādyutim
āruroha garutmantaṃ tābhyāṃ saha janārdanaḥ
tataḥ suparṇam āruhya trayas te puruṣarṣabhāḥ
jagmuḥ kruddhā mahāvīryā bāṇasya nagaraṃ prati
athāsādya mahārāja tat puraṃ dadṛśuś ca te
tāmraprākārasaṃvītāṃ rūpyadvāraiś ca śobhitām
hemaprāsādasaṃbādhāṃ muktāmaṇivicitritām
udyānavanasaṃpannāṃ nṛttagītaiś ca śobhitām
toraṇaiḥ pakṣibhiḥ kīrṇāṃ puṣkariṇyaiś ca śobhitām
tāṃ purīṃ svargasaṃkāśāṃ hṛṣṭapuṣṭajanākulām
dṛṣṭvā mudā yutāṃ haimāṃ vismayaṃ paramaṃ yayuḥ
tasya bāṇapurasyāsan dvārasthā devatāḥ sadā
maheśvaro guhaś caiva bhadrakālī ca pāvakaḥ
etā vai devatā rājan rarakṣus tāṃ purīṃ sadā
atha kṛṣṇo balāj jitvā dvārapālān yudhiṣṭhira
susaṃkruddho mahātejāḥ śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ
āsasādottaradvāraṃ śaṃkareṇābhipālitam
tatra tasthau mahātejāḥ śūlapāṇir maheśvaraḥ
pinākaṃ saśaraṃ gṛhya bāṇasya hitakāmyayā
jñātvā tam āgataṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vyāditāsyam ivāntakam
tatas tau cakratur yuddhaṃ vāsudevamaheśvarau
tad yuddham abhavad ghoram acintyaṃ romaharṣaṇam
anyonyaṃ tau tatakṣetām anyonyajayakāṅkṣiṇau
divyāstrāṇi ca tau devau kruddhau mumucatuś ca tau
tataḥ kṛṣṇo raṇaṃ kṛtvā muhūrtaṃ śūlapāṇinā
vijitya taṃ mahādevaṃ tato yuddhe janārdanaḥ
anyāṃś ca jitvā dvārasthān praviveśa purottamam
praviśya bāṇam āsādya sa tatrātha janārdanaḥ
cakre yuddhaṃ mahat kruddhas tena bāṇena pāṇḍava
bāṇo 'pi sarvaśastrāṇi śitāni bharatarṣabha
susaṃkruddhas tadā yuddhe pātayām āsa keśave
punar udyamya śastrāṇāṃ sahasraṃ sarvabāhubhiḥ
mumoca bāṇaḥ saṃkruddhaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ prati raṇājire
tataḥ kṛṣṇas tadā chitvā sarvaśastrāṇi bhārata
kṛtvā muhūrtaṃ bāṇena yuddhaṃ rājann adhokṣajaḥ
cakram udyamya rājan vai divyaṃ śastrottamaṃ tataḥ
sahasrabāhūṃś ciccheda bāṇasyāmitatejasaḥ
tato bāṇo mahārāja kṛṣṇena bhṛśapīḍitaḥ
chinnabāhuḥ papātāśu viśākha iva pādapaḥ
sa pātayitvā bāleyaṃ bāṇaṃ kṛṣṇas tvarānvitaḥ
prādyumniṃ mokṣayām āsa kṣiptaṃ rājagṛhe tadā
mokṣayitvātha govindaḥ prādyumniṃ saha bhāryayā
bāṇasya sarvaratnāni asaṃkhyāni jahāra saḥ
godhanāny atha sarvasvaṃ sa bāṇasyālaye balāt
jahāra ca hṛṣīkeśo yadūnāṃ kīrtivardhanaḥ
tataḥ sa sarvaratnāni cāhṛtya madhusūdanaḥ
kṣipram āropayāṃ cakre sarvasvaṃ garuḍopari
tvarayātha sa kaunteya baladevaṃ mahābalam
pradyumnaṃ ca mahāvīryam aniruddhaṃ mahādyutim
uṣāṃ ca sundarīṃ rājan bhṛtyadāsīgaṇaiḥ saha
sarvān etān samāropya ratnāni vividhāni ca
mudā yukto mahātejāḥ pītāmbaradharo balī
divyābharaṇacitrāṅgaḥ śaṅkhacakragadāsidhṛk
āruroha garutmantam udayaṃ bhāskaro yathā
athāruhya suparṇaṃ sa prayayau dvārakāṃ prati
praviśya svapuraṃ kṛṣṇo yādavaiḥ sahitas tadā
bhīṣmaḥ
pramumoda tadā rājan svargastho vāsavo yathā
sūditā mauravāḥ pāśā niśumbhanarakau hatau
kṛtakṣemaḥ punaḥ panthāḥ puraṃ prāgjyotiṣaṃ prati
śauriṇā pṛthivīpālās trāsitā bharatarṣabha
dhanuṣaś ca praṇādena pāñcajanyasvanena ca
meghaprakhyair anīkaiś ca dākṣiṇātyābhisaṃvṛtam
rukmiṇaṃ trāsayām āsa keśavo bharatarṣabha
tataḥ parjanyaghoṣeṇa rathenādityavarcasā
uvāha mahiṣīṃ bhojyām eṣa cakragadādharaḥ
jārūthyām āhṛtiḥ krāthaḥ śiśupālaś ca nirjitaḥ
vakraś ca saha śaibyena śatadhanvā ca kṣatriyaḥ
indradyumno hataḥ kopād yavanaś ca kaśerumān
hataḥ saubhapatiḥ sālvaḥ sahaiva krathadhanvanā
parvatānāṃ sahasraṃ ca cakreṇa puruṣottamaḥ
vibhidya puṇḍarīkākṣo dyumatsenam ayodhayat
mahendraśikhare caiva nimeṣāntaracāriṇau
jagrāha bharataśreṣṭha varuṇasyābhitaś carau
irāvatyām ubhau caitāv agnisūryasamau bale
gopatis tālaketuś ca nihatau śārṅgadhanvanā
akṣaprapatane caiva nemihaṃsapatheṣu ca
ubhau tāv api kṛṣṇena surāṣṭrau vinipātitau
dagdhā vārāṇasī tāta keśavena mahātmanā
sānubandhaḥ sarāṣṭraś ca kāśīnām ṛṣabho hataḥ
prāgjyotiṣaṃ puraśreṣṭham asurair bahubhir vṛtam
prāpya lohitakūṭāni kṛṣṇena varuṇo jitaḥ
ajeyo duṣpradharṣaś ca lokapālo mahādyutiḥ
indradvīpo mahendreṇa gupto maghavatā svayam
pārijāto hṛtaḥ pārtha keśavena balīyasā
pāṇḍyaṃ pauṇḍraṃ ca mātsyaṃ ca kaliṅgaṃ ca janārdanaḥ
jaghāna sahitān sarvān aṅgarājaṃ ca mādhavaḥ
eṣa caikaśataṃ hatvā rathena kṣatrapuṃgavān
gāndhārīm avahat kṛṣṇo mahiṣīṃ yādavarṣabhaḥ
atha gāṇḍīvadhanvānaṃ krīḍārthaṃ madhusūdanaḥ
jigāya bharataśreṣṭha kuntyāś ca pramukhe vibhuḥ
droṇaṃ drauṇiṃ kṛpaṃ karṇaṃ bhīmasenaṃ suyodhanam
vakrānuyāne sahitāñ jigāya bharatarṣabha
babhroś ca priyam anvicchann eṣa cakragadādharaḥ
veṇudārivṛtāṃ bhāryām unmamātha yudhiṣṭhira
paryāptāṃ pṛthivīṃ sarvāṃ sāśvāṃ sarathakuñjarām
veṇudārivaśe yuktāṃ jigāya madhusūdanaḥ
avāpya tapasā vīryaṃ balam ojaś ca bhārata
trāsitāḥ sagaṇāḥ sarve bāṇena vibudhādhipāḥ
vajrāśanigadāpāśais trāsayadbhir anekaśaḥ
tasya nāsīd raṇe mṛtyur devair api savāsavaiḥ
so 'bhibhūtaś ca kṛṣṇena nihataś ca mahātmanā
chittvā bāhusahasraṃ tad govindena mahātmanā
eṣa pīṭhaṃ mahābāhuḥ kaṃsaṃ ca madhusūdanaḥ
paiṭhakaṃ cātilomānaṃ nijaghāna janārdanaḥ
jambham airāvataṃ caiva virūpaṃ ca mahāyaśāḥ
jaghāna bharataśreṣṭha śambaraṃ cārimardanam
eṣa bhogavatīṃ gatvā vāsukiṃ bharatarṣabha
nirjitya puṇḍarīkākṣo rauhiṇeyam amocayat
evaṃ bahūni karmāṇi śiśur eva janārdanaḥ
kṛtavān puṇḍarīkākṣaḥ saṃkarṣaṇasahāyavān
evam eṣo 'surāṇāṃ ca surāṇāṃ cāpi sarvaśaḥ
bhayābhayakaraḥ kṛṣṇaḥ sarvalokeśvaraḥ prabhuḥ
evam eṣa mahābāhuḥ śāstā sarvadurātmanām
kṛtvā devārtham amitaṃ svasthānaṃ pratipatsyate
eṣa bhogavatīṃ ramyām ṛṣīkāntāṃ mahāyaśāḥ
dvārakām ātmasāt kṛtvā sāgaraṃ gamayiṣyati
bahupuṇyavatīṃ ramyāṃ caityayūpavatīṃ śubhām
dvārakāṃ varuṇāvāsaṃ pravekṣyati sakānanām
tāṃ sūryasadanaprakhyāṃ manojñāṃ śārṅgadhanvanaḥ
visṛṣṭāṃ vāsudevena sāgaraḥ plāvayiṣyati
surāsuramanuṣyeṣu nāsīn na bhavitā kva cit
yas tām adhyavasad rājā anyatra madhusūdanāt
bhrājamānās tu śiśavo vṛṣṇyandhakamahārathāḥ
taj juṣṭaṃ pratipatsyante nākapṛṣṭhaṃ gatāsavaḥ
evam eṣa daśārhāṇāṃ vidhāya vidhinā vidhim
viṣṇur nārāyaṇaḥ somaḥ sūryaś ca bhavitā svayam
aprameyo 'niyojyaś ca yatrakāmagamo vaśī
modate bhagavān bhūtair bālaḥ krīḍanakair iva
naiṣa garbhatvam āpede na yonyām āvasat prabhuḥ
ātmanas tejasā kṛṣṇaḥ sarveṣāṃ kurute gatim
yathā budbuda utthāya tatraiva tu nilīyate
carācarāṇi bhūtāni tathā nārāyaṇe sadā
na pramātuṃ mahābāhuḥ śakyo bhārata keśavaḥ
paraṃ hy aparam etad viśvarūpān na vidyate
vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca
evam uktvā tato bhīṣmo virarāma mahāyaśāḥ
vyājahārottaraṃ tatra sahadevo 'rthavad vacaḥ
keśavaṃ keśihantāram aprameyaparākramam
pūjyamānaṃ mayā yo vaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ na sahate nṛpāḥ
sarveṣāṃ balināṃ mūrdhni mayedaṃ nihitaṃ padam
evam ukte mayā samyag uttaraṃ prabravītu saḥ
matimantas tu ye ke cid ācāryaṃ pitaraṃ gurum
arcyam arcitam arcārham anujānantu te nṛpāḥ
tato na vyājahāraiṣāṃ kaś cid buddhimatāṃ satām
mānināṃ balināṃ rājñāṃ madhye saṃdarśite pade
tato 'patat puṣpavṛṣṭiḥ sahadevasya mūrdhani
adṛśyarūpā vācaś cāpy abruvan sādhu sādhv iti
āvidhyad ajinaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ bhaviṣyadbhūtajalpakaḥ
sarvasaṃśayanirmoktā nāradaḥ sarvalokavit
tatrāhūtāgatāḥ sarve sunīthapramukhā gaṇāḥ
saṃprādṛśyanta saṃkruddhā vivarṇavadanās tathā
yudhiṣṭhirābhiṣekaṃ ca vāsudevasya cārhaṇam
abruvaṃs tatra rājāno nirvedād ātmaniścayāt
suhṛdbhir vāryamāṇānāṃ teṣāṃ hi vapur ābabhau
āmiṣād apakṛṣṭānāṃ siṃhānām iva garjatām
taṃ balaugham aparyantaṃ rājasāgaram akṣayam
kurvāṇaṃ samayaṃ kṛṣṇo yuddhāya bubudhe tadā
pūjayitvā tu pūjārhaṃ brahmakṣatraṃ viśeṣataḥ
sahadevo nṛṇāṃ devaḥ samāpayata karma tat
tasminn abhyarcite kṛṣṇe sunīthaḥ śatrukarṣaṇaḥ
atitāmrekṣaṇaḥ kopād uvāca manujādhipān
sthitaḥ senāpatir vo 'haṃ manyadhvaṃ kiṃ nu sāṃpratam
yudhi tiṣṭhāma saṃnahya sametān vṛṣṇipāṇḍavān
iti sarvān samutsāhya rājñas tāṃś cedipuṃgavaḥ
yajñopaghātāya tataḥ so 'mantrayata rājabhiḥ
vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca
tataḥ sāgarasaṃkāśaṃ dṛṣṭvā nṛpatisāgaram
roṣāt pracalitaṃ sarvam idam āha yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
bhīṣmaṃ matimatāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ vṛddhaṃ kurupitāmaham
bṛhaspatiṃ bṛhattejāḥ puruhūta ivārihā
asau roṣāt pracalito mahān nṛpatisāgaraḥ
atra yat pratipattavyaṃ tan me brūhi pitāmaha
yajñasya ca na vighnaḥ syāt prajānāṃ ca śivaṃ bhavet
yathā sarvatra tat sarvaṃ brūhi me 'dya pitāmaha
ity uktavati dharmajñe dharmarāje yudhiṣṭhire
uvācedaṃ vaco bhīṣmas tataḥ kurupitāmahaḥ
mā bhais tvaṃ kuruśārdūla śvā siṃhaṃ hantum arhati
śivaḥ panthāḥ sunīto 'tra mayā pūrvataraṃ vṛtaḥ
prasupte hi yathā siṃhe śvānas tatra samāgatāḥ
bhaṣeyuḥ sahitāḥ sarve tatheme vasudhādhipāḥ
vṛṣṇisiṃhasya suptasya tatheme pramukhe sthitāḥ
bhaṣante tāta saṃkruddhāḥ śvānaḥ siṃhasya saṃnidhau
na hi saṃbudhyate tāvat suptaḥ siṃha ivācyutaḥ
tena siṃhīkaroty etān nṛsiṃhaś cedipuṃgavaḥ
pārthivān pārthivaśreṣṭha śiśupālo 'lpacetanaḥ
sarvān sarvātmanā tāta netukāmo yamakṣayam
nūnam etat samādātuṃ punar icchaty adhokṣajaḥ
yad asya śiśupālasthaṃ tejas tiṣṭhati bhārata
viplutā cāsya bhadraṃ te buddhir buddhimatāṃ vara
cedirājasya kaunteya sarveṣāṃ ca mahīkṣitām
ādātuṃ hi naravyāghro yaṃ yam icchaty ayaṃ yadā
tasya viplavate buddhir evaṃ cedipater yathā
caturvidhānāṃ bhūtānāṃ triṣu lokeṣu mādhavaḥ
prabhavaś caiva sarveṣāṃ nidhanaṃ ca yudhiṣṭhira
iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā tataś cedipatir nṛpaḥ
bhīṣmaṃ rūkṣākṣarā vācaḥ śrāvayām āsa bhārata
śiśupāla uvāca
vibhīṣikābhir bahvībhir bhīṣayan sarvapārthivān
na vyapatrapase kasmād vṛddhaḥ san kulapāṃsanaḥ
yuktam etat tṛtīyāyāṃ prakṛtau vartatā tvayā
vaktuṃ dharmād apetārthaṃ tvaṃ hi sarvakurūttamaḥ
nāvi naur iva saṃbaddhā yathāndho vāndham anviyāt
tathābhūtā hi kauravyā bhīṣma yeṣāṃ tvam agraṇīḥ
pūtanāghātapūrvāṇi karmāṇy asya viśeṣataḥ
tvayā kīrtayatāsmākaṃ bhūyaḥ pracyāvitaṃ manaḥ
avaliptasya mūrkhasya keśavaṃ stotum icchataḥ
kathaṃ bhīṣma na te jihvā śatadheyaṃ vidīryate
yatra kutsā prayoktavyā bhīṣma bālatarair naraiḥ
tam imaṃ jñānavṛddhaḥ san gopaṃ saṃstotum icchasi
yady anena hatā bālye śakuniś citram atra kim
tau vāśvavṛṣabhau bhīṣma yau na yuddhaviśāradau
cetanārahitaṃ kāṣṭhaṃ yady anena nipātitam
pādena śakaṭaṃ bhīṣma tatra kiṃ kṛtam adbhutam
valmīkamātraḥ saptāhaṃ yady anena dhṛto 'calaḥ
tadā govardhano bhīṣma na tac citraṃ mataṃ mama
bhuktam etena bahv annaṃ krīḍatā nagamūrdhani
iti te bhīṣma śṛṇvānāḥ paraṃ vismayam āgatāḥ
yasya cānena dharmajña bhuktam annaṃ balīyasaḥ
sa cānena hataḥ kaṃsa ity etan na mahādbhutam
na te śrutam idaṃ bhīṣma nūnaṃ kathayatāṃ satām
yad vakṣye tvām adharmajña vākyaṃ kurukulādhama
strīṣu goṣu na śastrāṇi pātayed brāhmaṇeṣu ca
yasya cānnāni bhuñjīta yaś ca syāc charaṇāgataḥ
iti santo 'nuśāsanti sajjanā dharmiṇaḥ sadā
bhīṣma loke hi tat sarvaṃ vitathaṃ tvayi dṛśyate
jñānavṛddhaṃ ca vṛddhaṃ ca bhūyāṃsaṃ keśavaṃ mama
ajānata ivākhyāsi saṃstuvan kurusattama
goghnaḥ strīghnaś ca san bhīṣma kathaṃ saṃstavam arhati
asau matimatāṃ śreṣṭho ya eṣa jagataḥ prabhuḥ
saṃbhāvayati yady evaṃ tvadvākyāc ca janārdanaḥ
evam etat sarvam iti sarvaṃ tad vitathaṃ dhruvam
na gāthā gāthinaṃ śāsti bahu ced api gāyati
prakṛtiṃ yānti bhūtāni bhūliṅgaśakunir yathā
nūnaṃ prakṛtir eṣā te jaghanyā nātra saṃśayaḥ
ataḥ pāpīyasī caiṣāṃ pāṇḍavānām apīṣyate
yeṣām arcyatamaḥ kṛṣṇas tvaṃ ca yeṣāṃ pradarśakaḥ
dharmavāk tvam adharmajñaḥ satāṃ mārgād avaplutaḥ
ko hi dharmiṇam ātmānaṃ jānañ jñānavatāṃ varaḥ
kuryād yathā tvayā bhīṣma kṛtaṃ dharmam avekṣatā
anyakāmā hi dharmajña kanyakā prājñamāninā
ambā nāmeti bhadraṃ te kathaṃ sāpahṛtā tvayā
yāṃ tvayāpahṛtāṃ bhīṣma kanyāṃ naiṣitavān nṛpaḥ
bhrātā vicitravīryas te satāṃ vṛttam anuṣṭhitaḥ
dārayor yasya cānyena miṣataḥ prājñamāninaḥ
tava jātāny apatyāni sajjanācarite pathi
na hi dharmo 'sti te bhīṣma brahmacaryam idaṃ vṛthā
yad dhārayasi mohād vā klībatvād vā na saṃśayaḥ
na tv ahaṃ tava dharmajña paśyāmy upacayaṃ kva cit
na hi te sevitā vṛddhā ya evaṃ dharmam abruvan
iṣṭaṃ dattam adhītaṃ ca yajñāś ca bahudakṣiṇāḥ
sarvam etad apatyasya kalāṃ nārhati ṣoḍaśīm
vratopavāsair bahubhiḥ kṛtaṃ bhavati bhīṣma yat
sarvaṃ tad anapatyasya moghaṃ bhavati niścayāt
so 'napatyaś ca vṛddhaś ca mithyādharmānuśāsanāt
haṃsavat tvam apīdānīṃ jñātibhyaḥ prāpnuyā vadham
evaṃ hi kathayanty anye narā jñānavidaḥ purā
bhīṣma yat tad ahaṃ samyag vakṣyāmi tava śṛṇvataḥ
vṛddhaḥ kila samudrānte kaś cid dhaṃso 'bhavat purā
dharmavāg anyathāvṛttaḥ pakṣiṇaḥ so 'nuśāsti ha
dharmaṃ carata mādharmam iti tasya vacaḥ kila
pakṣiṇaḥ śuśruvur bhīṣma satataṃ dharmavādinaḥ
haṃsasya tad vacaḥ śrutvā muditāḥ sarvapakṣiṇaḥ
pakṣiṇaḥ
ūcuś cainaṃ khagā haṃsaṃ parivārya ca sarvaśaḥ
kathayasva bhavān dharmaṃ pakṣiṇāṃ tat samāsataḥ
ko hi nāma dvijaśreṣṭha brūhi no dharmam uttamam
haṃsaḥ
prajāsv ahiṃsā dharmo vai hiṃsādharmaḥ khagavrajāḥ
etad evānuboddhavyaṃ dharmādharmaḥ samāsataḥ
vṛddhahaṃsavacaḥ śrutvā pakṣiṇas te susaṃhitāḥ
pakṣiṇaḥ
ūcuś ca dharmalubdhās te smayamānā ivāṇḍajāḥ
dharmaṃ yaḥ kurute nityaṃ loke dhīrataro 'ṇḍajaḥ
haṃsaḥ
sa yatra gacched dharmātmā tan no brūhīha tattvataḥ
dharmaṃ yaḥ kurute nityaṃ loke sadvṛttim āsthitaḥ
pakṣiṇaḥ
sa gacchet sarvalokān vai tathā vai niyataṃ khagāḥ
jñātvā hi dharmādharmaṃ ca nityaṃ loke dvijottama
haṃsaḥ
durlabhaṃ svargalokaṃ tu taṃ kasmāt tvaṃ na gacchasi
bālā yūyaṃ na jānīdhvaṃ dharmasūkṣmaṃ vihaṃgamāḥ
dharmaṃ yaḥ kurute loke satataṃ śubhabuddhinā
sa cāyuṣo 'nte svaṃ dehaṃ tyaktvā svargaṃ tu gacchati
sa cāham api ca tyaktvā kāle deham imaṃ dvijāḥ
śiśupālaḥ
svargalokaṃ gamiṣyāmi iyaṃ dharmasya vai gatiḥ
evaṃ dharmakathāṃ cakre sa haṃsaḥ pakṣiṇāṃ bhṛśam
pakṣiṇaḥ śuśruvur bhīṣma satataṃ dharmam eva te
athāsya bhakṣyam ājahruḥ samudrajalacāriṇaḥ
aṇḍajā bhīṣma tasyānye dharmārtham iti śuśruma
tasya caiva samabhyāśe nikṣipyāṇḍāni sarvaśaḥ
samudrāmbhasy amodanta caranto bhīṣma pakṣiṇaḥ
teṣām aṇḍāni sarveṣāṃ bhakṣayām āsa pāpakṛt
sa haṃsaḥ saṃpramattānām apramattaḥ svakarmaṇi
tataḥ prakṣīyamāṇeṣu teṣv aṇḍeṣv aṇḍajo 'paraḥ
aśaṅkata mahāprājñas taṃ kadā cid dadarśa ha
tataḥ sa kathayām āsa dṛṣṭvā haṃsasya kilbiṣam
teṣāṃ paramaduḥkhārtaḥ sa pakṣī sarvapakṣiṇām
tataḥ pratyakṣato dṛṣṭvā pakṣiṇas te samāgatāḥ
nijaghnus taṃ tadā haṃsaṃ mithyāvṛttaṃ kurūdvaha
te tvāṃ haṃsasadharmāṇam apīme vasudhādhipāḥ
nihanyur bhīṣma saṃkruddhāḥ pakṣiṇas tam ivāṇḍajam
gāthām apy atra gāyanti ye purāṇavido janāḥ
bhīṣma yāṃ tāṃ ca te samyak kathayiṣyāmi bhārata
antarātmani vinihite; rauṣi patraratha vitatham
aṇḍabhakṣaṇam aśuci te; karma vācam atiśayate
śiśupāla uvāca
sa me bahumato rājā jarāsaṃdho mahābalaḥ
yo 'nena yuddhaṃ neyeṣa dāso 'yam iti saṃyuge
keśavena kṛtaṃ yat tu jarāsaṃdhavadhe tadā
bhīmasenārjunābhyāṃ ca kas tat sādhv iti manyate
advāreṇa praviṣṭena chadmanā brahmavādinā
dṛṣṭaḥ prabhāvaḥ kṛṣṇena jarāsaṃdhasya dhīmataḥ
yena dharmātmanātmānaṃ brahmaṇyam abhijānatā
naiṣitaṃ pādyam asmai tad dātum agre durātmane
bhujyatām iti tenoktāḥ kṛṣṇabhīmadhanaṃjayāḥ
jarāsaṃdhena kauravya kṛṣṇena vikṛtaṃ kṛtam
yady ayaṃ jagataḥ kartā yathainaṃ mūrkha manyase
kasmān na brāhmaṇaṃ samyag ātmānam avagacchati
idaṃ tv āścaryabhūtaṃ me yad ime pāṇḍavās tvayā
apakṛṣṭāḥ satāṃ mārgān manyante tac ca sādhv iti
atha vā naitad āścaryaṃ yeṣāṃ tvam asi bhārata
strīsadharmā ca vṛddhaś ca sarvārthānāṃ pradarśakaḥ
vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca
tasya tad vacanaṃ śrutvā rūkṣaṃ rūkṣākṣaraṃ bahu
cukopa balināṃ śreṣṭho bhīmasenaḥ pratāpavān
tasya padmapratīkāśe svabhāvāyatavistṛte
bhūyaḥ krodhābhitāmrānte rakte netre babhūvatuḥ
triśikhāṃ bhrukuṭīṃ cāsya dadṛśuḥ sarvapārthivāḥ
lalāṭasthāṃ trikūṭasthāṃ gaṅgāṃ tripathagām iva
dantān saṃdaśatas tasya kopād dadṛśur ānanam
yugānte sarvabhūtāni kālasyeva didhakṣataḥ
utpatantaṃ tu vegena jagrāhainaṃ manasvinam
bhīṣma eva mahābāhur mahāsenam iveśvaraḥ
tasya bhīmasya bhīṣmeṇa vāryamāṇasya bhārata
guruṇā vividhair vākyaiḥ krodhaḥ praśamam āgataḥ
nāticakrāma bhīṣmasya sa hi vākyam ariṃdamaḥ
samuddhūto ghanāpāye velām iva mahodadhiḥ
śiśupālas tu saṃkruddhe bhīmasene narādhipa
nākampata tadā vīraḥ pauruṣe sve vyavasthitaḥ
utpatantaṃ tu vegena punaḥ punar ariṃdamaḥ
na sa taṃ cintayām āsa siṃhaḥ kṣudramṛgaṃ yathā
prahasaṃś cābravīd vākyaṃ cedirājaḥ pratāpavān
bhīmasenam atikruddhaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhīmaparākramam
muñcainaṃ bhīṣma paśyantu yāvad enaṃ narādhipāḥ
matpratāpāgninirdagdhaṃ pataṃgam iva vahninā
tataś cedipater vākyaṃ tac chrutvā kurusattamaḥ
bhīmasenam uvācedaṃ bhīṣmo matimatāṃ varaḥ
bhīṣma uvāca
cedirājakule jātas tryakṣa eṣa caturbhujaḥ
rāsabhārāvasadṛśaṃ rurāva ca nanāda ca
tenāsya mātāpitarau tresatus tau sabāndhavau
vaikṛtaṃ tac ca tau dṛṣṭvā tyāgāya kurutāṃ matim
tataḥ sabhāryaṃ nṛpatiṃ sāmātyaṃ sapurohitam
cintāsaṃmūḍhahṛdayaṃ vāg uvācāśarīriṇī
eṣa te nṛpate putraḥ śrīmāñ jāto mahābalaḥ
tasmād asmān na bhetavyam avyagraḥ pāhi vai śiśum
na caivaitasya mṛtyus tvaṃ na kālaḥ pratyupasthitaḥ
mṛtyur hantāsya śastreṇa sa cotpanno narādhipa
saṃśrutyodāhṛtaṃ vākyaṃ bhūtam antarhitaṃ tataḥ
putrasnehābhisaṃtaptā jananī vākyam abravīt
yenedam īritaṃ vākyaṃ mamaiva tanayaṃ prati
prāñjalis taṃ namasyāmi bravītu sa punar vacaḥ
śrotum icchāmi putrasya ko 'sya mṛtyur bhaviṣyati
antarhitaṃ tato bhūtam uvācedaṃ punar vacaḥ
yenotsaṅge gṛhītasya bhujāv abhyadhikāv ubhau
patiṣyataḥ kṣititale pañcaśīrṣāv ivoragau
tṛtīyam etad bālasya lalāṭasthaṃ ca locanam
nimajjiṣyati yaṃ dṛṣṭvā so 'sya mṛtyur bhaviṣyati
tryakṣaṃ caturbhujaṃ śrutvā tathā ca samudāhṛtam
dharaṇyāṃ pārthivāḥ sarve abhyagacchan didṛkṣavaḥ
tān pūjayitvā saṃprāptān yathārhaṃ sa mahīpatiḥ
ekaikasya nṛpasyāṅke putram āropayat tadā
evaṃ rājasahasrāṇāṃ pṛthaktvena yathākramam
śiśur aṅke samārūḍho na tat prāpa nidarśanam
tataś cedipuraṃ prāptau saṃkarṣaṇajanārdanau
yādavau yādavīṃ draṣṭuṃ svasāraṃ tāṃ pitus tadā
abhivādya yathānyāyaṃ yathājyeṣṭhaṃ nṛpāṃś ca tān
kuśalānāmayaṃ pṛṣṭvā niṣaṇṇau rāmakeśavau
abhyarcitau tadā vīrau prītyā cābhyadhikaṃ tataḥ
putraṃ dāmodarotsaṅge devī saṃnyadadhāt svayam
nyastamātrasya tasyāṅke bhujāv abhyadhikāv ubhau
petatus tac ca nayanaṃ nimamajja lalāṭajam
tad dṛṣṭvā vyathitā trastā varaṃ kṛṣṇam ayācata
dadasva me varaṃ kṛṣṇa bhayārtāyā mahābhuja
tvaṃ hy ārtānāṃ samāśvāso bhītānām abhayaṃkaraḥ
pitṛṣvasāraṃ mā bhaiṣīr ity uvāca janārdanaḥ
dadāni kaṃ varaṃ kiṃ vā karavāṇi pitṛṣvasaḥ
śakyaṃ vā yadi vāśakyaṃ kariṣyāmi vacas tava
evam uktā tataḥ kṛṣṇam abravīd yadunandanam
śiśupālasyāparādhān kṣamethās tvaṃ mahābala
kṛṣṇa uvāca
aparādhaśataṃ kṣāmyaṃ mayā hy asya pitṛṣvasaḥ
putrasya te vadhārhāṇāṃ mā tvaṃ śoke manaḥ kṛthāḥ
bhīṣma uvāca
evam eṣa nṛpaḥ pāpaḥ śiśupālaḥ sumandadhīḥ
tvāṃ samāhvayate vīra govindavaradarpitaḥ
bhīṣma uvāca
naiṣā cedipater buddhir yayā tvāhvayate 'cyutam
nūnam eṣa jagadbhartuḥ kṛṣṇasyaiva viniścayaḥ
ko hi māṃ bhīmasenādya kṣitāv arhati pārthivaḥ
kṣeptuṃ daivaparītātmā yathaiṣa kulapāṃsanaḥ
eṣa hy asya mahābāho tejoṃśaś ca harer dhruvam
tam eva punar ādātum icchat pṛthuyaśā hariḥ
yenaiṣa kuruśārdūla śārdūla iva cedirāṭ
garjaty atīva durbuddhiḥ sarvān asmān acintayan
vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca
tato na mamṛṣe caidyas tad bhīṣmavacanaṃ tadā
uvāca cainaṃ saṃkruddhaḥ punar bhīṣmam athottaram
śiśupāla uvāca
dviṣatāṃ no 'stu bhīṣmaiṣa prabhāvaḥ keśavasya yaḥ
yasya saṃstavavaktā tvaṃ bandivat satatotthitaḥ
saṃstavāya mano bhīṣma pareṣāṃ ramate sadā
yadi saṃstauṣi rājñas tvam imaṃ hitvā janārdanam
daradaṃ stuhi bāhlīkam imaṃ pārthivasattamam
jāyamānena yeneyam abhavad dāritā mahī
vaṅgāṅgaviṣayādhyakṣaṃ sahasrākṣasamaṃ bale
stuhi karṇam imaṃ bhīṣma mahācāpavikarṣaṇam
droṇaṃ drauṇiṃ ca sādhu tvaṃ pitāputrau mahārathau
stuhi stutyāv imau bhīṣma satataṃ dvijasattamau
yayor anyataro bhīṣma saṃkruddhaḥ sacarācarām
imāṃ vasumatīṃ kuryād aśeṣām iti me matiḥ
droṇasya hi samaṃ yuddhe na paśyāmi narādhipam
aśvatthāmnas tathā bhīṣma na caitau stotum icchasi
śalyādīn api kasmāt tvaṃ na stauṣi vasudhādhipān
stavāya yadi te buddhir vartate bhīṣma sarvadā
kiṃ hi śakyaṃ mayā kartuṃ yad vṛddhānāṃ tvayā nṛpa
purā kathayatāṃ nūnaṃ na śrutaṃ dharmavādinām
ātmanindātmapūjā ca paranindā parastavaḥ
anācaritam āryāṇāṃ vṛttam etac caturvidham
yad astavyam imaṃ śaśvan mohāt saṃstauṣi bhaktitaḥ
keśavaṃ tac ca te bhīṣma na kaś cid anumanyate
kathaṃ bhojasya puruṣe vargapāle durātmani
samāveśayase sarvaṃ jagat kevalakāmyayā
atha vaiṣā na te bhaktiḥ pakṛtiṃ yāti bhārata
mayaiva kathitaṃ pūrvaṃ bhūliṅgaśakunir yathā
bhūliṅgaśakunir nāma pārśve himavataḥ pare
bhīṣma tasyāḥ sadā vācaḥ śrūyante 'rthavigarhitāḥ
mā sāhasam itīdaṃ sā satataṃ vāśate kila
sāhasaṃ cātmanātīva carantī nāvabudhyate
sā hi māṃsārgalaṃ bhīṣma mukhāt siṃhasya khādataḥ
dantāntaravilagnaṃ yat tad ādatte 'lpacetanā
icchataḥ sā hi siṃhasya bhīṣma jīvaty asaṃśayam
tadvat tvam apy adharmajña sadā vācaḥ prabhāṣase
icchatāṃ pārthivendrāṇāṃ bhīṣma jīvasy asaṃśayam
lokavidviṣṭakarmā hi nānyo 'sti bhavatā samaḥ
vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca
tataś cedipateḥ śrutvā bhīṣmaḥ sa kaṭukaṃ vacaḥ
uvācedaṃ vaco rājaṃś cedirājasya śṛṇvataḥ
icchatāṃ kila nāmāhaṃ jīvāmy eṣāṃ mahīkṣitām
yo 'haṃ na gaṇayāmy etāṃs tṛṇānīva narādhipān
evam ukte tu bhīṣmeṇa tataḥ saṃcukrudhur nṛpāḥ
ke cij jahṛṣire tatra ke cid bhīṣmaṃ jagarhire
ke cid ūcur maheṣvāsāḥ śrutvā bhīṣmasya tad vacaḥ
pāpo 'valipto vṛddhaś ca nāyaṃ bhīṣmo 'rhati kṣamām
hanyatāṃ durmatir bhīṣmaḥ paśuvat sādhv ayaṃ nṛpaiḥ
sarvaiḥ sametya saṃrabdhair dahyatāṃ vā kaṭāgninā
iti teṣāṃ vacaḥ śrutvā tataḥ kurupitāmahaḥ
uvāca matimān bhīṣmas tān eva vasudhādhipān
uktasyoktasya nehāntam ahaṃ samupalakṣaye
yat tu vakṣyāmi tat sarvaṃ śṛṇudhvaṃ vasudhādhipāḥ
paśuvad ghātanaṃ vā me dahanaṃ vā kaṭāgninā
kriyatāṃ mūrdhni vo nyastaṃ mayedaṃ sakalaṃ padam
eṣa tiṣṭhati govindaḥ pūjito 'smābhir acyutaḥ
yasya vas tvarate buddhir maraṇāya sa mādhavam
kṛṣṇam āhvayatām adya yuddhe śārṅgagadādharam
yāvad asyaiva devasya dehaṃ viśatu pātitaḥ
pṛthivyāṃ sāgarāntāyāṃ yo vai pratisamo bhavet
duryodhanaṃ ca rājendram atikramya mahābhujam
jayadrathaṃ ca rājānaṃ kṛtāsraṃ dṛḍhavikramam
drumaṃ kiṃpuruṣācāryaṃ loke prathitavikramam
atikramya mahāvīryaṃ kiṃ praśaṃsasi keśavam
vṛddhaṃ ca bhāratācāryaṃ tathā śāradvataṃ kṛpam
atikramya mahāvīryaṃ kiṃ praśaṃsasi keśavam
dhanurdharāṇāṃ pravaraṃ rukmiṇaṃ puruṣottamam
atikramya mahāvīryaṃ kiṃ praśaṃsasi keśavam
bhīṣmakaṃ ca mahāvīryaṃ dantavakraṃ ca bhūmipam
bhagadattaṃ yūpaketuṃ jayatsenaṃ ca māgadham
virāṭadrupadau cobhau śakuniṃ ca bṛhadbalam
vindānuvindāv āvantyau pāṇḍyaṃ śvetam athottamam
śaṅkhaṃ ca sumahābhāgaṃ vṛṣasenaṃ ca māninam
ekalavyaṃ ca vikrāntaṃ kāliṅgaṃ ca mahāratham
atikramya mahāvīryaṃ kiṃ praśaṃsasi keśavam
vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca
tataḥ śrutvaiva bhīṣmasya cedirāḍ uruvikramaḥ
yuyutsur vāsudevena vāsudevam uvāca ha
āhvaye tvāṃ raṇaṃ gaccha mayā sārdhaṃ janārdana
yāvad adya nihanmi tvāṃ sahitaṃ sarvapāṇḍavaiḥ
saha tvayā hi me vadhyāḥ pāṇḍavāḥ kṛṣṇa sarvathā
nṛpatīn samatikramya yair arājā tvam arcitaḥ
ye tvāṃ dāsam arājānaṃ bālyād arcanti durmatim
anarham arhavat kṛṣṇa vadhyās ta iti me matiḥ
ity uktvā rājaśārdūlas tasthau garjann amarṣaṇaḥ
paśyatāṃ bhūmipālānāṃ śiśupālaḥ pratāpavān
sa raṇāyaiva saṃkruddhaḥ saṃnaddhaḥ sarvarājabhiḥ
sunīthaḥ prayayau kṣipraṃ pārthayajñajighāṃsayā
tataś cakragadāpāṇiḥ keśavaḥ keśihā hariḥ
sadhvajaṃ ratham āsthāya dārukeṇa susatkṛtam
bhīṣmeṇa dattahasto 'sau yuddhāya samupasthitaḥ
tena pāpasvabhāvena kopitān sarvapārthivān
āsasāda tadā kṛṣṇaḥ sajjitaikarathe sthitaḥ
tataḥ puṣkarapatrākṣaṃ garuḍadhvajam acyutam
divākaram ivodyantaṃ dadṛśuḥ sarvapārthivāḥ
dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇam athāyāntaṃ pratapantam ivaujasā
sthitaṃ puṣparathe divye puṣpaketum ivāparam
yathārhaṃ keśave vṛttim avaśāḥ pratipedire
tān uvāca mahābāhur mahāsuranibarhaṇaḥ
vṛṣṇivīras tadā rājan sāntvayan paravīrahā
apeta sabalāḥ sarva āśvastā mama śāsanāt
mā duṣṭān dūṣayet pāpa eṣa vai sarvapārthivān
evam ukte tataḥ kṛṣṇo mṛdupūrvam idaṃ vacaḥ
uvāca pārthivān sarvāṃs tatsamakṣaṃ ca pāṇḍavān
eṣa naḥ śatrur atyantaṃ pārthivāḥ sātvatīsutaḥ
sātvatānāṃ nṛśaṃsātmā na hito 'napakāriṇām
prāgjyotiṣapuraṃ yātān asmāñ jñātvā nṛśaṃsakṛt
babhror bhāryām athādatte mamāpaśyanta yādavāḥ
tadānīṃ hantum ārabdho na bhajyenam athānyatā
tasyarthe va bhavo vadhdmā (sic) tadāsan saṃvṛtaṃ nṛpān
atiprasaṃgadoṣeṇa tām ādāya ca kevalam
babhrave dattavān pūrvaṃ yuṣmākaṃ paśyatāṃ mithaḥ
gomante parvate pūrvaṃ nihate māgadhe 'pi ca
anena ca sṛgālena na vai pādidaṃ (sic) kila
tataḥ kuṇḍinayātrāyāṃ kṛtavān vipriyāṇi me
tāni sarvāṇi saṃkhyātuṃ na śakṣyāmi narādhipāḥ
kākatālīyanyāyena sarvaṃ me ripunāśanam
etasmin kalahe bhūpāḥ koṭiśas tu mayā hatāḥ
kṣamā lālajjayāmy adya (sic) duṣṭastrīharaṇaṃ yathā
pitṛṣvasre priyaṃ bhūpāḥ kariṣye 'nyaṃ mahattaram
adahad dvārakām eṣa svasrīyaḥ san narādhipāḥ
krīḍato bhojarājanyān eṣa raivatake girau
hatvā baddhvā ca tān sarvān upāyāt svapuraṃ purā
aśvamedhe hayaṃ medhyam utsṛṣṭaṃ rakṣibhir vṛtam
pitur me yajñavighnārtham aharat pāpaniścayaḥ
sauvīrān pratipattau ca babhror eṣa yaśasvinaḥ
bhāryām abhyaharan mohād akāmāṃ tām ito gatām
eṣa māyāpraticchannaḥ karūṣārthe tapasvinīm
jahāra bhadrāṃ vaiśālīṃ mātulasya nṛśaṃsakṛt
viśālarājño duhitāṃ mama pitrā vṛtāṃ satīm
anena kṛtvā saṃdhānaṃ karūśena jihīrṣayā
vṛṣṇidārān vilupyaiṣa hatvā ca kukurāndhakān
pāpabuddhir upātiṣṭhat saṃpraviśya sasaṃbhramam
jarāsaṃdhaṃ samāśritya kṛtavān vipriyāṇi me
tāni sarvāṇi saṃkhyātuṃ na śakṣyāmi narādhipāḥ
evam etad aparyantam eṣa vṛṣṇiṣu kilbiṣī
asmākam ayam ārambhāc cakāra paramānṛjuḥ
śataṃ kṣantavyam asmābhir vadhārhāṇāṃ kilāgasām
baddho 'smi samayair ghorair māturasyaiva saṃgare
tat tathā śatam asmākaṃ kṣāntaṃ kṣayakaraṃ mayā
dvau tu me vadhakāle 'smin na kṣantavyau kathaṃ cana
yajñavighnakaraṃ hanyāṃ pāṇḍavānāṃ ca durhṛdam
iti me vartate bhāvas tam atīyāṃ kathaṃ nv aham
pitṛṣvasuḥ kṛte duḥkhaṃ sumahan marṣayāmy aham
diṣṭyā tv idaṃ sarvarājñāṃ saṃnidhāv adya vartate
paśyanti hi bhavanto 'dya mayy atīva vyatikramam
kṛtāni tu parokṣaṃ me yāni tāni nibodhata
imaṃ tv asya na śakṣyāmi kṣantum adya vyatikramam
ākālikaṃ puṣpaphalaṃ rāṣṭrakṣobhaṃ vinirdiśet
vanaspatiḥ pūjyamānaḥ pūjito 'pūjito 'pi vā
yadā bhajyeta vātena bhidyate namito 'pi vā
agnivāyubhayaṃ vidyāc chreṣṭho vāpi vinaśyati
diśaḥ sarvāś ca dīpyante jāyante rājavibhramāḥ
bhidyamāno yadā vṛkṣo ninadec cāpi pātitaḥ
saha rāṣṭraṃ ca patitaṃ na taṃ vṛkṣaṃ prapātayet
athainaṃ chedayet kaś cit pratikruddho vanaspatiḥ
chettā bhettā patiś caiva kṣipram eva naśiṣyati
devatānāṃ ca patanaṃ maṇṭapānāṃ ca pātanam
acalānāṃ prakampaś ca tat parābhavalakṣaṇam
arcā yatra pranṛtyanti nadanti ca hasanti ca
unmīlanti nimīlanti rāṣṭrakṣobhaṃ vinirdiśet
śilā yadi prasiñcanti snehāṃś codakasaṃbhavān
anyad vā vikṛtaṃ kiṃ cit tad bhayasya nidarśanam
mriyante vā mahāmātrā rājā saparivārakaḥ
purasya vā bhaved vyādhī rāṣṭre deśe ca vibhramāḥ
devatānāṃ yadāvāse rājñāṃ vā yatra veśmani
bhāṇḍāgārāyudhāgāre niviśeta yadā madhu
sarvaṃ tadā bhavet sthānaṃ hanyamānaṃ balīyasā
āgantukaṃ bhayaṃ tatra bhaved ity eva nirdiśet
pādapaś caiva yo yatra raktaṃ sravati śoṇitam
dantāgrāt kuñjaro vāpi śṛṅgād vā vṛṣabhas tathā
pādapād rāṣṭravibhraṃśaḥ kuñjarād rājavibhramaḥ
gobrāhmaṇavināśaḥ syād vṛṣabhasyeti nirdiśet
chatraṃ narapater yatra nipatet pṛthivītale
sarāṣṭro nṛpatī rājan kṣipram eva vinaśyati
devāgāreṣu vā yatra rājño vā yatra veśmani
vikṛtaṃ yadi dṛśyeta nāgāvāseṣu vā punaḥ
tasya deśasya pīḍā syād rājño janapadasya vā
anāvṛṣṭibhayaṃ ghoram atidurbhikṣam ādiśet
avalepād vadhārhasya samagre rājamaṇḍale
rukmiṇyām asya mūḍhasya prārthanāsīn mumūrṣataḥ
na ca tāṃ prāptavān mūḍhaḥ śūdro vedaśrutiṃ yathā
evamādi tataḥ sarve sahitās te narādhipāḥ
vāsudevavacaḥ śrutvā cedirājaṃ vyagarhayan
vihāya paramodvignāś cedirājaṃ camūmukhe
tāṃs tu vipradrutān sarvān sāśvapattirathadvipān
dāritān vṛṣṇivīreṇa trāsitān uruvikramān
kṛṣṇatejohatān sarvān samīkṣya vasudhādhipān
śiśupālo rathenaikaḥ pratyupāyāt sa keśavam
ruṣā tāmrekṣaṇo rājañ śalabhaḥ pāvakaṃ yathā
vaiśaṃpāyanaḥ
tato yuddhāya saṃnaddhaṃ cedirājaṃ yudhiṣṭhiraḥ

antarikṣe ca bhūmau ca na te 'sty aviditaṃ kva cit

nāradaḥ
pṛcchataḥ sarvam avyagram ācacakṣe mahāyaśāḥ
parākramaṃ ca mārgaṃ ca saṃnipātaṃ samucchrayam
ārohaṇaṃ kuruśreṣṭha anyonyaṃ prati sarpaṇam
raśmīnāṃ vyatisaṃsargaṃ vyāyāmaṃ vṛttipīḍanam
darśanādarśanaṃ caiva adṛśyānāṃ ca darśanam
hāniṃ vṛddhiṃ ca hrāsaṃ ca varṇasthānaṃ balābalam
sarvam etat parīkṣeta grahāṇāṃ grahakovidaḥ
bhaumāḥ pūrvaṃ pravartante khecarāś ca tataḥ param
utpadyante ca loke 'sminn utpātā devanirmitāḥ
yadā tu sarvabhūtānāṃ chāyā na parivartate
apareṇa gate sūrye tat parābhavalakṣaṇam
acchāye vimalacchāyā praticchāyeva lakṣyate
yatra caityakavṛkṣāṇāṃ tatra vidyān mahad bhayam
śīrṇaparṇapravālāś ca śuṣkaparṇāś ca caityakāḥ
apabhraṣṭapravālāś ca tatrābhāvaṃ vinirdiśet
snigdhapatrapravālāś ca dṛśyante yatra caityakāḥ
īhamānāś ca dṛṣṭāś ca bhāvas tatra na saṃśayaḥ
puṣpe puṣpaṃ prajāyeta phale vā phalam āśritam
rājā vā rājamātro vā maraṇāyopapadyate
prāvṛṭ charadi hemante vasante vāpi sarvaśaḥ
akālajaṃ puṣpaphalaṃ rāṣṭrakṣobhaṃ vinirdiśet
nadīnāṃ srotaso 'kāle dyotayanti mahābhayam
vanaspatiḥ pūjyamānaḥ pūjito 'pūjito 'pi vā

agnivāyubhayaṃ vidyāc chreṣṭho vātra vinaśyati

devatānāṃ ca patanaṃ maṇḍapānāṃ ca ghuṣṭanam
acalānāṃ prakampaś ca tat parābhavalakṣaṇam
niśi cendradhanur dṛṣṭaṃ tato 'pi ca mahad bhayam
tad draṣṭur eva bhītiḥ syān nānyeṣāṃ bharatarṣabha
rātrāv indradhanur dṛṣṭvā tad rāṣṭraṃ parivarjayet
devatā yatra nṛtyanti nadanti ca hasanti ca
unmīlanti nimīlanti rāṣṭrakṣobhaṃ vinirdiśet
śilā yatra prasiñcanti snehāṃś codakasaṃbhavān

devāgāreṣu vā yatra rājño vā yatra veśmani
vikṛtaṃ yadi dṛśyeta nāgāvāseṣu vā punaḥ
tasya deśasya pīḍā syād rājño janapadasya vā
anāvṛṣṭibhayaṃ ghoraṃ durbhikṣam iti nirdiśet
bāhubhaṅge tu devānāṃ grahasthānāṃ bhayaṃ bhavet
bhagne praharaṇe vidyāt senāpativināśanam
āgantukā ca pratimā sthānaṃ yatra na vindati
abhyantareṇa ṣaṇmāsād rājā tyajati tat puram
pradīryate mahī yatra vinadaty api pātyate
mriyate tatra rājā ca tac ca rāṣṭraṃ vinaśyati
eṇīpadān vā sarpān vā ḍuṇḍubhān atha dīpyakān
maṇḍūko grasate yatra tatra rājā vinaśyati
abhinnaṃ vāpy apakvaṃ vā yatrānnam upacīyate
jīryante vā mriyante vā tad annaṃ nopabhujyate
udapāne ca yatrāpo vivardhante yudhiṣṭhira
sthāvareṣu pravartante nirgacchec ca punas tataḥ
apādaṃ vā tripādaṃ vā dviśīrṣaṃ vā caturbhujam
striyo yatra prasūyante brūyāt tatra parābhavam
hastinī mahiṣī gaur vā kharoṣṭram atha sūkaram
īdṛśāni prajāyante vidyāt tatra parābhavam
ajaiḍakāḥ striyo gāvo 'vayaś cānye 'pi yonayaḥ
vikṛtāni prajāyante tatra tatra parābhavaḥ
nadī yatra pratisrotam āvahet kaluṣodakam
nāradaḥ
diśaś ca na prakāśante tat parābhavalakṣaṇam
etāni tu nimittāni yāni cānyāni bhārata
keśavād eva jāyante bhaumāni ca khagāni ca
candrādityau grahāś caiva nakṣatrāṇi ca bhārata
vāyur agnis tathaivāpaḥ pṛthivī ca janārdanāt
yasya deśasya hāniṃ vā vṛddhiṃ vā kartum icchati
tasmin deśe nimittāni tāni tāni karoty ayam
yo 'sau cedipates tāta vināśaḥ samupasthitaḥ
nivedayati govindaḥ svair upāyair na saṃśayaḥ
iyaṃ pracalitā bhūmir aśivaṃ vānti mārutāḥ
rāhuś cāpy apatat somam aparvaṇi viśāṃ pate
sanirghātāḥ patanty ulkās tamaḥ saṃjāyate bhṛśam
vaiśaṃpāyanaḥ
cedirājavināśāya harir eṣa vijṛmbhate
evam uktvā tu bhagavān nārado virarāma ha
tābhyāṃ puruṣasiṃhābhyāṃ tasmin yuddha upasthite
dadṛśur bhūmipālās te ghorān autpātikān bahūn
tatra tair dṛśyamānānāṃ dikṣu sarvāsu bhārata
aśrūyanta tadā rājañ śivānām aśivā giraḥ
rarāsa ca mahī kṛtsnā savṛkṣapuraparvatā
aparvaṇi ca madhyāhne sūryaṃ svarbhānur agrasat
dhvajāgre cedirājasya sarvaratnapariṣkṛte

āraṇyaiḥ saha saṃhṛṣṭā grāmyāś ca mṛgapakṣiṇaḥ
cakruśur bhairavaṃ tatra tasmin yuddha upasthite
